Descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analyses for business use cases.

Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Quantitative Economics. High level of English proficiency preferred.

About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves.

Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what’s next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Link instagram, tiktok, cultura.

Role Mission

As a Social Listening - Data Analyst at SAMY, you’ll transform campaign and business data into clear, actionable insights that help teams and clients make better decisions and improve performance.

New project coming!

Join the team behind one of the world's most iconic beauty portfolios and help define how global brands win in today's creator economy.

Beauty is one of the fastest-moving and most influential industries in the world. Trends are born overnight, creators shape consumer behaviour, and communities decide what products become tomorrow's icons. Working on this account means having a front-row seat to everything happening across social, culture, creators and innovation.

At SAMY, you'll help global beauty brands stay ahead of what's next. You'll turn cultural shifts into strategy, identify the creators driving conversations, and build advocacy programmes that connect brands with millions of people in authentic ways.

You'll work at the intersection of social, culture, AI, technology and creativity, where every day brings new trends, new platforms and new opportunities to shape the future of beauty marketing.

If you're passionate about creators, obsessed with culture and excited by the idea of working on one of the most prestigious global beauty accounts in the industry, we'd love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze campaign and business performance data to identify trends, patterns, drivers, and optimization opportunities.
Utilize tools like Sprinklr and Brandwatch to gather consumer, cultural, and competitive intelligence.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
Develop and maintain benchmarks, KPIs, and measurement frameworks aligned with client and business objectives.
Prepare regular and ad-hoc performance reports, turning data into compelling and easy-to-understand narratives.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through data-driven recommendations.
Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, Account, and other teams to ensure data informs decision-making.
Contribute to improving reporting methodologies, analytical processes, and data storytelling standards.


,

Skills & Experience


Experience in data analysis, digital marketing analytics, or a similar role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.
Understanding of digital marketing, social media, and campaign performance metrics.
Strong communication skills and ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive, curious, and solution-oriented mindset.
English full working proficiency (written and verbal).


Benefits


Work your way – Flexible schedule, hybrid work, and the opportunity to work up to 3 weeks a year from any SAMY office around the world.
Time that matters – Celebrate your birthday with a day off, plus company holidays on December 24th and 31st to recharge.
Grow with us – Global mobility opportunities, mentorship, parenthood support, and a transparent performance-driven compensation framework.
Be part of the journey – – Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.


The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder?

Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We’re not looking for people who think the same, we’re looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Be Kind — because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

Go Beyond — because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together — because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey — because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It — because real impact starts with accountability.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it’s what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier-free environment where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to thrive. And if you need support or adjustments along the way, we’ll make sure you have what you need to do your best work.

Workday Reporting Data Analyst - Full remote Spain or Portugal

We’re looking for a Workday Reporting Data Analyst to transform HR data into reliable reporting, meaningful metrics, and actionable insights. This role is central to maintaining data integrity, improving reporting quality, and helping Colleague Resources teams make informed decisions across global operations.

You’ll design and maintain Workday reports, analyse complex HR datasets, support system administration and releases, and translate business needs into practical reporting solutions. Working with international HRIS, Colleague Resources, IT, and business stakeholders, you’ll combine technical expertise with a strong understanding of HR processes.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Workday reports ranging from simple operational reports to matrix, trended, and composite reports.
Deliver meaningful HR metrics, trends, dashboards, charts, and analytical insights to support Colleague Resources operations and decision-making.
Translate business requirements into clear, scalable, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, data discrepancies, improvement opportunities, and areas for partnership with internal stakeholders.
Support HRIS administration through group data updates, imports, exports, data clean-up, and investigation of data quality issues.
Contribute to Workday releases, upgrades, implementations, and functional testing, ensuring reporting continuity and process quality.
Act as a liaison between HRIS and functional teams, combining system knowledge with an understanding of HR processes and business priorities.
Coordinate reporting guidance and training, and respond to stakeholder questions in a clear and practical way.
Engage with the Workday Community, monitor relevant developments, and share useful insights with Colleague Resources leadership.
Ensure reporting and data-handling activities align with security, privacy, and data governance standards.


The skills you will have when you apply


Strong Workday reporting experience – hands-on experience creating and maintaining custom reports, including matrix, trended, and composite reports, using Workday Report Writer and standard reporting functionality.
Data analytics capability – experience analysing complex datasets, identifying trends and discrepancies, and presenting meaningful metrics and insights; knowledge of data mining, operational analytics, data models, and SQL is preferred.
HRIS and systems understanding – strong knowledge of Workday administration, data integrity, reporting processes, and HR systems, with the ability to support testing, releases, and process improvements.
Advanced Microsoft tools – strong Excel capability, including formulas and macros, together with proficiency in PowerPoint and Visio.
Business analysis and problem-solving – able to translate requirements into functional solutions, investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend sustainable improvements.
Clear communication and stakeholder partnership – able to explain data and technical topics in a simple, practical way, deliver presentations, coordinate training, and build effective relationships with HRIS, HR, IT, and business teams.
International collaboration and adaptability – comfortable working in a global, fast-moving environment, managing priorities, adapting to change, and contributing effectively within a team.


Experience and education


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Five years of related experience, including three years working with database migration and/or integration and large-scale, complex datasets, with a focus on reporting and analytics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in business operations or human resources is preferred, together with Workday administration, custom reporting, and troubleshooting experience.
A basic understanding of ServiceNow and case management is an advantage.


Working context


This role is fully remote and based in Spain or Portugal.
You will collaborate with international HRIS, Colleague Resources, IT, and business teams across countries and time zones.
You will help strengthen reporting standards, data quality, and the use of HR analytics to support better business decisions.

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. Our colleagues support people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Title: Technical Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

MRM Madrid is looking to expand its Data team with a Technical Data Analyst.

Key Responsibilities


Technical Support & Production Deployment: Work closely with the Advanced Analytics team to transform prototypes, scripts, and experimental models (notebooks) into automated, stable, efficient, and production-ready services.
Data Engineering & ETL/ELT: Design, optimize, and maintain robust data pipelines. Ensure data sources are properly structured, clean, and continuously available so analytical models can consume high-quality data.
Analytical & Business Insight: Actively participate in the analysis phase by understanding the analytical objectives of each project, performing exploratory data analysis, validating data quality, and ensuring technical outputs address specific business questions.
Robustness & Best Practices: Introduce software engineering standards into the analytics workflow, including version control, data testing, modular development, and technical documentation.
Model Monitoring: Support the monitoring of variables feeding deployed models to detect data drift and ensure long-term model performance.


Desired Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in Python with a strong focus on data manipulation and optimization (Pandas, NumPy, production-ready scripting).
Expert-level SQL skills for querying, extracting, transforming, and modeling complex data in data warehouses.
Solid experience building and automating data ingestion and processing pipelines using ETL/ELT tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar.
Familiarity with deployment workflows, APIs (FastAPI/Flask), containerized environments (Docker), and version control systems (Git).
Proven ability to analyze metrics, formulate hypotheses, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.


What We Offer


permanent contract
#Hybrid model
Flexible schedule
Training plans in our extensive training platform.
23 working days of vacation, plus 2 long weekends of your choice, plus 3 days at Easter, plus 3 days at Christmas.
The day of your birthday off!
Incorporation in a multinational company with high professional, economic and financial solvency that leads new, innovative and large-scale projects.


Who We Are

MRM is a modern relationship marketing agency that builds enduring brand relationships. MRM's core capabilities help grow relationship lifetime value and span across CRM & Loyalty, Customer Experience, Commerce and MarTech, underpinned by Data & Analytics. MRM operates in a borderless, integrated way to allow for greater collaboration and velocity. MRM is part of McCann Worldgroup and the Interpublic Group of companies (NYSE: IPG), and spans 35 offices across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific.

Title: Data Analyst - Fincrime Reporting
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analyst - FCC Reporting

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Compliance team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Regulatory FinCrime Compliance domain!

Our data mission is to enable effective risk detection, monitoring and regulatory compliance through robust data models, scalable analytics and high quality reporting.

The team works closely with Compliance, Risk and Product to design and implement data-driven controls, detection mechanisms, and investigative tools across multiple jurisdictions.

Projects range from building curated data models to cover global key risk indicators for financial crime compliance and automating into standardised board packs, to scaling our regulatory reporting engine to incorporate datasets specific to transaction monitoring, screening and client KYC.

As part of the team you will


Design and maintain data models and datasets used for transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, and financial crime investigations.
Own end-to-end delivery of FinCrime analytics solutions: requirements gathering, data extraction, transformation, validation, and deployment.
Develop and optimise detection logic and monitoring rules (e.g. transaction monitoring scenarios, anomaly detection, behavioural patterns).
Perform data quality checks and controls to ensure completeness, accuracy, and auditability of FinCrime datasets.
Build dashboards and analytical tools (Looker / Looker Studio or similar) for monitoring risk exposure, alerts, and investigation pipelines.
Support regulatory and internal audits, providing traceability of data, methodologies, and controls.
Contribute to the automation and continuous improvement of FinCrime processes (screening, monitoring, alert handling).


What We’re Looking For


2-5 years Experience in Data/Business Analytics – preferably within FinCrime, Compliance, Risk, or Financial Services.
Advanced SQL skills – able to read and write queries across complex datasets.
Experience with our modern data stack tools is a plus: dbt, Google Cloud BigQuery, Looker / Looker Studio, Git.
Experience building data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets.
Solid understanding of financial crime frameworks.
Experience working with Python is desirable.
Knowledge of payment flows, FX, or banking products is desirable.
Strong analytical thinking with focus on data quality, controls, and risk interpretation.
Experience working with transaction monitoring systems or alerting frameworks is a plus.
Ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into data logic.
Fluency in English (Spanish, a plus)


What Ebury Offers You


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment (hybrid model, 4 days office / 1 day remote)
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off and all the Málaga public holidays.
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Title: Data Analyst - BigQuery
Description:
¡En Ayesa Digital crecemos Contigo!




Cada profesional de nuestra empresa es importante para nosotros, nos ayudan a crecer de manera diversa y gracias a ellos somos más de 11.000 personas trabajando con el mismo objetivo internacionalmente.




Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!




Buscamos ampliar nuestro equipo con un/a Data Analyst / BI Consultant, para participar en proyectos de analítica de datos, reporting y evolución del ecosistema analítico corporativo. La persona seleccionada trabajará en modalidad de teletrabajo híbrido en Madrid.




¡Anímate a dar el salto! ¡Te estamos esperando!




¿Qué vas a hacer?

Actuar como referente analítico y nexo entre las áreas de Negocio y Tecnología.
Gestionar la transformación, modelado y explotación de datos, garantizando la calidad y disponibilidad de la información para la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos orientados a negocio.
Definir, documentar y evolucionar KPIs, métricas e indicadores de gestión.
Desarrollar lógica de negocio mediante DAX y modelos semánticos.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes en Power BI.
Construir visualizaciones que faciliten el análisis y la toma de decisiones de las distintas áreas de negocio.
Asegurar la correcta integración y explotación de datos entre BigQuery y Power BI.
Recopilar, analizar y documentar requisitos funcionales de las áreas usuarias.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas y de reporting.
Participar en la migración de procesos y modelos actualmente desarrollados en SAS hacia tecnologías Google Cloud y Microsoft.
Colaborar en la evolución de la arquitectura analítica y en la mejora continua de herramientas, procesos y modelos de datos.
Establecer mecanismos de control y seguimiento de la calidad del dato.
Identificar incidencias, inconsistencias y riesgos asociados a la información.
Gestionar iniciativas analíticas, coordinando diferentes equipos y asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos y entregables.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia como Data Analyst, BI Consultant o en posiciones similares relacionadas con Business Intelligence y Analítica de Datos.
Dominio avanzado de SQL.
Experiencia trabajando con BigQuery.
Conocimientos sólidos de Power BI, diseño de informes y cuadros de mando.
Experiencia desarrollando modelos semánticos y cálculos mediante DAX.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos y procesos ETL/ELT.
Capacidad para analizar necesidades funcionales y transformarlas en soluciones analíticas.
Experiencia actuando como interlocutor/a entre negocio y equipos técnicos.
Orientación a la calidad del dato y a la mejora continua.
Capacidad de organización, gestión de prioridades y trabajo en entornos dinámicos.
Valorable experiencia en proyectos de migración desde SAS hacia entornos Google Cloud o Microsoft.




Te Ofrecemos Un Camino Lleno De Aventuras




¡Llega hasta donde tú quieras! ¡Crece con nuestros programas de desarrollo! Te ayudaremos a marcar tu itinerario de futuro anualmente participando en proyectos vanguardistas con los mejores profesionales del sector.




Porque lo importante sois tú y los tuyos : contamos con políticas que facilitan la conciliación entre la vida profesional y personal: Flexibilidad horaria, Smart Job y jornada intensiva en verano.

Tú decides cómo usar tu dinero: disfruta de nuestra retribución flexible, contamos con: Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurant, Guardería y Transporte.

Plan Bienestar descuentos en viajes, tecnología, formación, deporte, belleza y ¡muchos más!

Diviértete participando en los diferentes concursos y actividades que organizamos: ¿te gusta el deporte, escribir, la fotografía? Todo tiene cabida.

¡Actualízate! apostamos por un aprendizaje continuo, contamos con formación especializada, certificaciones e idiomas.

¡Deja tu huella! Impacta con nuestros proyectos de voluntariado social.




¡Únete a la multinacional española tecnológica referente en el mundo!

Title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Workload 80 - 100%

The role is designed to:


Support early-stage ideation initiatives and existing product teams.
Generate insights from usage data and customer behavior.
Focus on exploratory analysis, identifying meaningful product and usage metrics.
Develop indicators for evidence-based product decisions.
Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ensure actionable insights.



What will you do


Analyze usage data and customer behavior to generate insights during early‑stage ideation
Support discovery and experimentation with exploratory analyses and rapid insights
Define and evolve product and usage metrics that indicate success and value
Work closely with product managers to translate questions and hypotheses into analyses
Advise engineering teams on where and how data should be collected within applications
Automate relevant metrics and analyses as products mature
Take analytical ownership for products emerging from ideation initiatives
Stay current with modern analytics techniques and AI‑enabled analytical approaches



What You Bring & Who You Are


Strong experience in data analysis, analytics, or a similar hands‑on role
Excellent analytical thinking and ability to turn data into clear insights
Proficiency with common analytics tools and languages (e.g. Python, SQL, BI tools)
Experience working with product, usage, or behavioral data
Proven interest in AI‑enabled products and modern analytical approaches
Curiosity and motivation to continuously learn and experiment
Comfortable working in early‑stage, exploratory environments
Strong communication skills with technical and non‑technical stakeholders
Fluent in English; German is a plus

At our company, we strive to create a culture of continuous learning, personal growth, and inter- national community involvement. We're passionate about providing our employees with the tools and resources they need to succeed, and we're confident that you'll love being part of our team!

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
Formar parte de Aire es unirte a una compañía tecnológica ágil e innovadora. Tenemos el propósito de impulsar a nuestros clientes B2B para que hagan crecer su negocio.

Ofrecemos soluciones avanzadas de Cloud, telecomunicaciones, UCaaS, ciberseguridad y servicios gestionados para empresas, con un modelo centrado en pymes, corporaciones, administraciones públicas y operadores de telecomunicaciones en España y Portugal.

Nos diferenciamos por desarrollar soluciones tecnológicas propias, buscando la excelencia y la cercanía con nuestros clientes. Para ello apostamos por el talento como motor de este proyecto.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

El analista senior de datos, deberá reforzar el equipo de BI aportando un alto nivel técnico en el desarrollo y evolución del ecosistema de datos de negocio y en la generación de informes para dirección y otras áreas, garantizando el cumplimiento de los entregables. Es una posición con un fuerte componente de automatización: se espera que lidere técnicamente la transformación de procesos manuales en procesos automatizados y repetibles, incorporando soluciones de automatización avanzada (incluida la IA) allí donde aporten eficiencia.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?


Trabajar sobre las tablas y el modelo del ecosistema de datos de negocio, colaborando con el equipo en su evolución y mantenimiento.
Construir, mantener y evolucionar informes y cuadros de mando en Power BI y Excel para dirección y otras áreas de negocio.
Interactuar con la capa directiva y con responsables de otras áreas para recoger, entender y priorizar sus necesidades de información.
Garantizar la entrega de los informes y análisis en plazo, recurriendo a soluciones manuales cuando sea necesario para no comprometer el entregable.
Liderar de forma proactiva la automatización de procesos: una vez resuelta la primera entrega, es responsabilidad clave del puesto rediseñar y automatizar el proceso (scripts, programación de tareas, herramientas de automatización e IA cuando aporten valor) para que las siguientes ejecuciones no requieran intervención manual.
Identificar de forma proactiva procesos manuales o repetitivos del equipo susceptibles de automatización, y proponer e implementar soluciones.
Apoyar y coordinarse con el resto del equipo (ETL/Python y Power BI) para repartir y sacar adelante la carga de trabajo mensual.


¿Qué requisitos necesitamos?


Entre 4 y 5 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, analítica de datos o similar.
Nivel avanzado de SQL y MySQL.
Nivel medio de Python.
Nivel avanzado de Power BI (modelado de datos y DAX).
Nivel avanzado de Excel.
Inglés nivel medio (uso ocasional, no intensivo).
Capacidad de interlocución con dirección y con responsables de otras áreas.
Experiencia demostrable automatizando procesos de datos e informes (scripting, programación de tareas, herramientas de automatización).


¿Qué valoramos?


Conocimiento o experiencia aplicando IA para la automatización de procesos (por ejemplo, generación de scripts, agentes o herramientas de IA aplicadas a tareas repetitivas).
Experiencia previa liderando o coordinando equipos.
Experiencia en el sector de las telecomunicaciones (Telco).


¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?


Contrato indefinido y jornada completa.
Modalidad de trabajo híbrido
Flexibilidad de entrada
Jornada intensiva durante los meses de verano
23 días hábiles de vacaciones anuales para que te desconectes y recargues energías
¡No te pierdas nada con nuestro Campus Aire University! Accede a toda la formación disponible y revisa las formaciones pasadas para impulsar tu carrera en telecomunicaciones y cloud
Acceso a descuentos del Club Aire, con ofertas increíbles en moda, viajes, entretenimiento, hostelería, motor y electrónica. ¡Aprovecha!
¡Muy buen ambiente de trabajo!


En Aire, creemos firmemente que los equipos diversos e inclusivos impulsan la innovación, la transformación y mejores resultados. Por ello, promovemos y garantizamos la inclusión de todas las personas, sin importar su género, edad, orientación e identidad sexual, cultura, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal. Nuestro compromiso es construir un entorno donde cada persona pueda aportar su talento y crecer profesionalmente.

En Aire, la igualdad nos une, la diversidad nos fortalece.

Title: Data Analyst (with focus on AI)
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain

We are looking to add to the Analytics team a profile 100% focused on data analysis and business impact, with a strong sensitivity towards the world of applied Artificial Intelligence, capable of transforming complex data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement, and clearly communicating conclusions in an executive manner to different stakeholders.

We are not looking for a purely academic or AI research profile, but for someone who knows how to use AI as a lever to elevate analysis quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve decision-making.

Analyze large volumes of data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities with direct business impact.
Generate actionable insights by connecting technical metrics with business KPIs and strategic objectives.
Apply AI / advanced analytics techniques (predictive models, clustering, analysis automation, insight generation, etc.) with a practical, results-oriented approach.
Drive continuous improvement by proposing hypotheses, tests, and data-driven recommendations.
Design and create executive presentations (slides, dashboards, one-pagers) for committees and senior stakeholders, with clear, structured, and decision-oriented messaging.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (product, technology, operations, business), acting as a bridge between data and decision-making.

Degree in quantitative fields: Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar.
Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation of business KPIs.
Knowledge and practical experience with analytics tools (SQL, Python, Power BI / Tableau or similar).
Interest and experience in applying AI techniques and advanced models, always with a business focus (not an academic profile).
High ability to synthesize complex information and convert it into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Experience creating executive presentations and presenting conclusions to senior stakeholders.
Continuous improvement mindset, critical thinking, and impact orientation.
Strong communication skills, autonomy, and an end-to-end vision of data.

A role with real impact on business decisions.
An environment where AI is applied in a practical, not experimental, way.

Collect, clean, validate, and analyse procurement data from multiple sources
Create recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses for procurement stakeholders

Skills

English B2

Profile




Data-driven and analytical

Collaborative and team-oriented

Be part of a company actively transforming its business towards a more sustainable energy model

Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Si para ti un dato no es solo un número en una celda, sino el inicio de una historia que puede cambiar el rumbo de un negocio, tenemos que hablar.

En WAM sabemos que tener la mejor infraestructura de datos no sirve de nada si nadie sabe interpretarla. Buscamos a un/a Marketing Data Analyst que sea la pieza clave que conecte el trabajo técnico con las decisiones estratégicas de nuestros clientes.

Bajo el liderazgo del Data Lead, y trabajando codo con codo con Data Engineering, serás la persona encargada de transformar datos complejos en insights accionables, cuadros de mando interactivos y conclusiones de negocio brillantes.

Tu misión será convertir la complejidad del dato en claridad estratégica. Diseñarás dashboards avanzados y modelos analíticos que aporten luz a los clientes, demostrando el ROI y apoyando el crecimiento transversal de nuestros estudios a través de la evidencia innegable del dato.

Lo Que Harás (de Verdad)

Análisis 360º del Negocio:


Desarrollar modelos analíticos que permitan analizar el impacto de cada canal de marketing durante todo el ciclo de vida digital del cliente.
Estandarizar la estrategia de analítica y reporting unificando la metodología a nivel compañía y facilitando el discurso de las distintas áreas de marketing y ventas.
Realizar análisis tanto globales de negocio como por área (adquisición, conversión, retención o loyalty).
Ser capaz de integrar y analizar datos de canales offline y online para facilitar la toma de decisiones de negocio.


Visualización De Datos


Diseñar, evolucionar y mantener cuadros de mando interactivos en herramientas líderes (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) que permitan identificar oportunidades de negocio, detectar tendencias y facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos.
Asegurar que la capa visual sea intuitiva, accionable y cuente la historia correcta.


Implementación Técnica


Ser capaz de definir junto con los equipos de estrategia la implementación necesaria para garantizar una correcta captación del dato para posteriormente convertirlo en reportes para el cliente.
Coordinar junto al equipo técnico la implementación técnica en las distintas plataformas del cliente (eCommerce, Web, App, etc).


Consultoría y Calidad


Asesorar a dirección y equipos de Creatividad, Marketing y Ventas en la toma de decisiones basadas en datos para impulsar el crecimiento y eficiencia de nuestros clientes.
Apoyar al Data Lead en la interpretación de los datos para reuniones ejecutivas, traduciendo la complejidad técnica en recomendaciones estratégicas claras para el cliente.
Trabajarás de la mano con el Data Engineer para asegurar la calidad y veracidad absoluta de los datos.
Documentar la lógica de negocio y mantener el glosario de KPIs de cada proyecto.


Crecemos Contigo, Cuidamos De Ti


Horario flexible: Conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional.
Modelo híbrido: Nos gusta vernos 1-2 días a la semana en la oficina, pero siempre con máxima flexibilidad.
Salario: entre 34K - 40K € brutos anuales, dependiendo de tu experiencia.
Días especiales: Día libre en tu cumpleaños y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.
Plan de Igualdad: Entorno inclusivo, respetuoso y con oportunidades justas para todas las personas.
Retribución Flexible: Accede a nuestro plan con Cobee.
Desarrollo profesional: Plan de desarrollo adaptado a tu perfil e inquietudes.
Jornada intensiva: Viernes hasta las 15:00h. Además en verano (22/06 al 11/09) y Navidad (desde el 21/12 al 8/01) trabajamos de 8 a 15.


Imprescindible (si No Lo Tienes, No Es Tu Rol)


Formación en Data e IA.
Experiencia Analítica: Al menos 2-3 años de experiencia real en un rol de Marketing Data Analyst, BI Analyst o similar, preferiblemente en ecosistemas digitales o consultoras.
Dominio de GA4, Google Tag Manager y herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau o Looker.
Mentalidad de Negocio: Capacidad demostrable para calcular y entender métricas clave de negocio (ROI, LTV, CAC, Tasa de Conversión, Engagement, etc) relacionadas con áreas como Marketing Automation, Paid Media, UX/UI o SEO entre otros.
Experiencia en analítica para eCommerce B2C y B2B de al menos 2 años.
Comunicación: Tienes que saber explicar un dashboard complejo a alguien que no sabe de datos.
Idiomas: Inglés nivel B2/C1 (necesario para manejar documentación técnica y presentar a clientes internacionales).


Nice to have


Experiencia en análisis avanzados con modelos de atribución y modelos predictivos.
Experiencia en A/B testing.
Experiencia con el ecosistema Salesforce (Marketing Cloud) y su modelo de datos.


Con nuestro talento y experiencia, llevamos la transformación organizacional a otro nivel, preparándo a las empresas para liderar el futuro.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo.

Por eso, si tienes experiencia como Analista de Datos / Analista Digital y te apasiona transformar datos en insights que impulsen la toma de decisiones, nos comprometemos a potenciar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana? ¡Sigue leyendo!




Formarás parte de un proyecto estratégico de analítica digital, enfocado en el análisis de tráfico, consumo y engagement de usuarios, colaborando con diferentes áreas de negocio para convertir los datos en conocimiento accionable y generar impacto real en la estrategia digital.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Dar apoyo al equipo en la elaboración y presentación en PowerPoint de los resultados obtenidos a través del análisis de datos de Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.
Colaborar en la documentación y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado completas (eventos, parámetros, conversiones y dimensiones personalizadas), garantizando la coherencia y escalabilidad de la medición.
Gestionar y explotar Google Analytics 4 (GA4) como principal herramienta de análisis mediante datos almacenados en BigQuery dentro de un entorno Data Proc.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
Experiencia trabajando con KPIs y métricas enfocadas a objetivos de negocio.
Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
Alta capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y atención al detalle.




Modalidad: Híbrido en Madrid.




¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España contamos con una facturación de 217 millones de euros, 9 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.240 profesionales.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Tus tareas

El equipo de Asesoria AVM forma parte de la unidad de Inteligencia Inmobiliaria de Accumin Intelligence y es el responsable del desarrollo, mantenimiento y entrega de modelos automáticos de valoración (AVM) bajo el marco normativo vigente en España, principalmente de la Orden ECO 805/2003 y la regulación del Banco de España aplicable a entidades tasadoras homologadas.




El departamento trabaja en estrecha colaboración con entidades financieras, fondos y servicers, proporcionando valoraciones masivas de activos inmobiliarios con los estándares de calidad, trazabilidad y documentación exigidos por el regulador. La apertura de este proceso responde a la necesidad de reforzar el equipo con un perfil senior que contribuya al análisis y mejora continua de los modelos, la validación de datos y la elaboración análisis de las valoraciones, en un contexto de crecimiento de la demanda por parte de nuestros clientes y de expansión de las capacidades del área. Además que contribuya al crecimiento del equipo tanto en España como internacional, ampliando capacidades y clientes.




Tu perfil




¿En qué consistirán sus tareas principales?

Gestión, apoyo y supervisión al equipo de asesoría de carteras y AVM consistente en 6 personas.
Análisis y revisión de resultados de valoración inmobiliaria AVM. Participación en el diseño, calibración y actualización de modelos estadísticos para la valoración automática masiva de activos inmobiliarios (residencial, terciario, suelo).
Análisis y control de calidad del dato. Exploración, limpieza y validación de bases de datos inmobiliarias (testigos de mercado, registros públicos, datos internos), identificando inconsistencias, outliers y gaps que puedan afectar a la representatividad y fiabilidad de los modelos.
Monitorización y estudio del error de los modelos. Seguimiento periódico de las métricas de desempeño de los modelos en producción (MAPE, mediana de error, ratio hit rate, etc.), detección de desviaciones y elaboración de propuestas de mejora.
Elaboración de análisis de mercado y resultados de valoración de carteras. Redacción de dossieres de modelo, fichas metodológicas, informes de validación y registros de cambios.
Automatización de procesos. Desarrollo de scripts y flujos de trabajo en Python y/o SQL para la automatización de cargas de datos, ejecución de modelos y generación de informes de calidad, contribuyendo a la puesta en producción de los procesos del área.
Análisis ad-hoc para clientes. Soporte en la elaboración de estudios y análisis específicos requeridos por entidades financieras, fondos o servicers, incluyendo segmentaciones de cartera, análisis de mercado local y comparativas de valor.
Reporting e interpretación de resultados. Preparación de presentaciones y reportes que trasladen de forma clara los outputs de los modelos y los análisis realizados, tanto para uso interno como para interlocutores externos no técnicos.




¿Qué esperamos de tí?

Titulación de Grado en Economía, ADE, Ingeniería o Matemáticas.
Valorable otros cursos relacionados con este ámbito.
Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años en puesto similar.
Conocimiento del mercado de carteras NPL
Nivel básico de Python, y nivel avanzado de Excel y PPT.
Valorable el uso de herramientas de visualización de datos.
Inglés C1 y español C2.




¿Qué tipo de persona buscamos?

Buscamos a una persona con alta capacidad analítica y de razonamiento.
Que sea planificada y organizada.
Capaz de adaptarse a cambios, adoptando una actitud flexible.
Tenga gran capacidad comunicativa.
Orientada a la calidad en su trabajo y mucha iniciativa.




¿Por qué nosotros?

Contrato indefinido.
Incorporación inmediata.
Trabajo en equipo que permite estar en continuo aprendizaje.
Modalidad de teletrabajo híbrida al 40%, que permanecerá vigente mientras la empresa no decida modificarlo de manera general, en base a la productividad de la Compañía.
Horario flexible de 9:00 a 19:00 de lunes a viernes.
Servicio de menú diario incluido.
Compromiso a fomentar un entorno inclusivo donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y alcanzar su máximo potencial, porque creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades

Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)

Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko is an AI shopping app that helps millions of users save time and money when shopping online or in-store. With Juno, our shopping assistant, they can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds.

What sets Joko’s AI apart is how well it knows its users. Its shopping recommendations feel personal from day one and get sharper the more they use it. It draws on unique assets to deliver the best experience: one of the largest product catalogs in the world, and unique shopping data no one else has to personalize every recommendation.

Users can also track the price of their favorite products and earn cash back almost everywhere. All in one free app.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 120+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with us.

Job Description

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are


State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.


🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.


Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.


👀 Who we're looking for


Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:


Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.


On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks


💸 Top-market compensation
📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
…and much more, check the full list here!


🤝 Our hiring process


Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information


Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Paris, Barcelona
Possible full remote
Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

MSX International es un líder global en servicios para el sector de automoción, presente en más de 80 países. Desde nuestra sede en Barcelona trabajamos con diferentes fabricantes internacionales para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras que impulsan la eficiencia, la calidad y el rendimiento de sus operaciones.

Si buscas un entorno dinámico, analítico, internacional y orientado a la mejora continua, este es tu sitio.

Descripción del empleo

Como Analista de Datos, serás responsable de gestionar, analizar y transformar datos clave relacionados con proyectos del sector automoción. Tu misión será convertir grandes volúmenes de datos en insights claros y accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones, la optimización de procesos y el rendimiento general del negocio.

Requisitos


Realizar análisis diarios, semanales y mensuales utilizando herramientas como Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Identificar tendencias, variaciones y oportunidades de mejora
Preparar informes avanzados alineados con KPIs y requisitos del proyecto
Mantener, actualizar y asegurar la calidad de la documentación y reportes en herramientas como SharePoint y Office365
Identificar patrones en los datos y proponer acciones correctivas u oportunidades de optimización
Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para convertir insights en acciones concretas
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis

Desarrollo, mantenimiento y evolución de cuadros de mando y dashboards en Power BI.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




🎯 Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, using data to recommend customer experience optimization strategies.
Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments that support product development.
Work with Operations Program leadership to define measurement strategies for program health and operational performance.
Establish comprehensive metrics, develop clear reporting, and create regular monitoring processes.
Analyze key customer experience and operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities for deeper research.
Develop and present concise narratives from analytical findings to senior Operations leaders, highlighting problems and proposed solutions.
Support the development and maintenance of core reporting abstractions built in dbt, business intelligence reporting, and AI semantic layers.

🛠️ Requirements

At least 4 years of experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision-making.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment design.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and results to business partners clearly, concisely, and meaningfully.
Ability to independently translate stakeholder questions into clear, actionable analytical problems.
Experience building data abstractions with tools such as dbt or Airflow.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Mode, Looker, Periscope, or Tableau.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including the ability to confidently review code written by other analysts and data scientists.

➕ Nice to have

Master’s degree in a quantitative field or professional experience applying statistics.
Ability to code in Python or R.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for analytics.
Experience working with customer service datasets, such as Zendesk.
Experience with workforce forecasting.

💰 Compensation

First-year salary range in the greater Barcelona area: €47,124–€60,319.
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout.
Benefits are available to full-time employees.
Cash compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities demonstrated throughout the interview and hiring process.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
1. Propósito del Puesto (Misión)

Garantizar la explotación estratégica de la información y la evolución del entorno de datos en Netquest, identificando oportunidades de mejora, desarrollando herramientas analíticas y siendo una pieza técnica clave para la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.




2. Responsabilidades Principales

Interpretar datos e indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para ayudar a la empresa a maximizar el valor de la información.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas de negocio para definir y priorizar necesidades de información.
Proporcionar soluciones de informes y herramientas de BI para partes interesadas internas y externas.
Desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando (dashboards) en herramientas de BI (ej. Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipular datos y realizar análisis ad-hoc utilizando Python y consultas avanzadas en SQL.
Identificar, analizar e interpretar patrones y tendencias en grandes volúmenes de datos (millones de registros).
Monitorizar fuentes de datos y colaborar con Data Engineers para resolver inconsistencias y garantizar las políticas de calidad.
Trabajar de manera colaborativa dentro del área de Datos con Data Scientists, Data Engineers y otros analistas.




3. Relaciones Clave (Interfaces)

Internas: Equipo de Datos (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) y responsables de diversas áreas de negocio.
Externas: Clientes y colaboradores externos receptores de herramientas de análisis o informes ad-hoc.




4. Requisitos del Perfil

Formación y Experiencia:
Educación: Grado Universitario en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Informática o campo cuantitativo similar.
Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia previa desempeñando funciones como Data Analyst.
Conocimientos Técnicos e Idiomas:
Dominio de Python (librerías como pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Sólidos conocimientos y optimización en SQL.
Experiencia en herramientas de Business Intelligence (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Idiomas: Fluidez en inglés (comunicación verbal y escrita clara).
Valorables: Experiencia en servicios Cloud (especialmente AWS) y herramientas de gestión de datos como dbt.
Competencias Y Habilidades:
Excelente pensamiento analítico y capacidad para la resolución de problemas.
Habilidades de storytelling para comunicar hallazgos complejos de forma sencilla.
Trabajo en equipo, adaptabilidad y enfoque orientado a la calidad de los datos.




5. Qué Ofrecemos

Ubicación: Barcelona
Modelo de trabajo: Híbrido (2 días en la oficina y 3 días de teletrabajo)
Beneficios sociales:
Contrato indefinido.
Seguro médico privado con cuadro médico o reembolso (50% cubierto para el empleado).
Plan de retribución flexible: vales de comida (tickets restaurante), transporte y guardería.
Horario flexible (entrada de 8:00 a 10:00, salida de 17:00 a 19:00) y viernes de jornada intensiva.




6. Igualdad de Oportunidades

En Netquest, nos enorgullece ser una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y tenemos el compromiso de crear un entorno inclusivo para todos nuestros empleados, independientemente de su género, edad, origen, nacionalidad, raza, religión, orientación sexual o discapacidad.




--




1. Purpose of the Role (Mission)

Ensure the strategic exploitation of information and the evolution of Netquest's data ecosystem, identifying improvement opportunities, developing analytical tools, and serving as a key technical contributor for data-driven decision-making.




2. Key Responsibilities

Interpret data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to help the organization leverage its data assets effectively.
Partner with various business units to define and prioritize reporting and data needs.
Provide reporting solutions and BI tools to support decision-making for both internal and external stakeholders.
Build and maintain accurate, user-friendly dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipulate data for ad-hoc queries and reporting using Python and advanced SQL.
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns within large and complex datasets (millions of records).
Monitor data sources and collaborate with Data Engineers to resolve discrepancies and uphold Data Quality standards.
Work collaboratively with the broader Data team (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and fellow Data Analysts).




3. Key Interfaces

Internal: Data team (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) and key business department stakeholders.
External: External clients or partners receiving analytical tools and ad-hoc reporting.




4. Requirements & Profile

Education & Experience:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience in a Data Analyst role.
Technical Skills & Languages:
Proficiency in Python (including libraries such as pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Strong SQL knowledge and query optimization.
Experience with BI tools (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Languages: Fluent in English with clear communication skills.
Desirable: Cloud experience (especially AWS) and data management tools like dbt.
Behavioral Skills:
Excellent analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities.
Strong storytelling skills to effectively present insights.
Team player with high attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.




5. What We Offer

Workplace Model: Hybrid model (2 days in the office, 3 days working from home)
Benefits:
Permanent contract.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - B2B
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

This role is embedded within either the B2B domain and is part of Preply’s Data Chapter. You will work closely with directors, B2B leaders, and cross-functional partners across finance and product teams, while collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers to strengthen analytical foundations and business impact.

What you’ll be doing:


Partner with senior stakeholders across Business and Operations to proactively identify where new analyses, metrics, or frameworks can unlock improvements in retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.
Build and own the analytical framework leadership uses to evaluate B2B trade-offs, and define the long-term measurement framework that identifies structural growth levers, not just incremental wins.
Lead high-complexity, end-to-end analytical initiatives — including retention and cohort analyses that answer specific open questions from B2B leadership — uncovering root causes behind revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, and cost efficiency, and turning findings into concrete pricing, product, or lifecycle recommendations.
Own impact modeling, scenario analysis, and KPI governance for B2B: resolve conflicting metric definitions across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Product, maintain a single source of truth, and feed directly into quarterly and annual planning.
Design the experimentation and analytics agenda, what gets tested, how success is measured, and translate results into executive-ready storytelling that aligns stakeholders on goals and trade-offs.
Partner with Directors and VPs to shape B2B strategy, embed analytics into daily decision-making, and mentor senior analysts to raise the analytical bar.


What you need to succeed:


5+ years of experience in analytics roles (ideally in B2B), with demonstrated ownership of KPI frameworks and measurable impact on retention, revenue, or efficiency.
You can point to specific decisions (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and one where your recommendation was rejected, with the judgment to explain why, in hindsight, that was right or wrong.
You've owned a metric or strategic framework other teams were required to use, and resolved a conflict between two teams who each wanted a different definition to win.
Deep understanding of retention and performance metrics (revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, cost efficiency), and the ability to build an LTV or cohort model from scratch, not just interpret one someone else built.
Strong, independent SQL, you're the person other analysts send their code to for review; proven ability to lead cross-functional analytical projects end-to-end.
Strong business acumen and stakeholder influence: comfortable saying no to a request that wasn't the right question, clarifying trade-offs in metrics and resourcing, and building forecast or scenario models that leadership uses to defend a bet to their own leadership.


Nice to have:


Background in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or account-based business models; exposure to customer support operations.
Experience building or scaling an analytics function (hiring, tooling, process, KPI frameworks).
Hands-on experience with Looker, Snowflake, Tableau, or Power BI.
Working knowledge of Python for analysis.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.


Why you’ll love it at Preply:


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Funciones

Compartir con los equipos EU5 la evolución de la cuenta de Amazon.
Configuración y elaboración de informes mediante herramientas destinadas a monitorizar contenidos.
Manejo de otras herramientas relacionadas con las ventas online.

Formación Universitaria: Ade, Economía, Marketing, Ingeniería, Matemáticas o similares.

Experiencia previa de mínimo 2 años como Data Analyst. Preferiblemente en una compañía multinacional en el sector de Mass Distribution/Retail/Farmacéutico.
Nivel alto de Excel.
Conocimientos de Qlik Sense, Power BI, Pacvue.
Capacidad para transformar datos en conclusiones relevantes para el negocio
Nivel alto de inglés: B2.2/C1.

Teletrabajo dos días a la semana.

Salario: salario base + variable + ticket restaurante + ayuda teletrabajo
Beneficios sociales: tarjeta Cobee, seguro médico, plan de pensiones, día de cumpleaños libre, descuento en nuestros productos y en otras firmas, office con víveres, fruta en la oficina,...

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At LittleBig Connection, we firmly believe in the transformative power of data analytics and AI to enhance business operations, drive informed decision-making and foster sustainable business growth.

To reinforce our young and ambitious Data and AI team we are seeking an experienced Data Analyst. You will own the semantic layer of our data platform: the models, metrics and definitions that the whole company relies on. Beyond reporting, you will be expected to explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next and what should be done about it. You will collaborate closely with key business stakeholders (Financial Partners, Head of Business, Product Managers) to develop impactful analytics solutions.




Key Responsibilities:




Design, build and maintain the semantic model of the platform with dbt: staging, marts, metrics, tests and documentation.
Own the definition of business metrics and make sure they are consistent, documented and unique across all consumption surfaces.
Contribute to data governance: ownership, naming conventions, data contracts, catalog and quality standards on the analytics layer.
Run diagnostic analyses: identify root causes behind business variations rather than only reporting them.
Build predictive analyses (forecasting, scoring, propensity) to anticipate business and product trends.
Turn those insights into prescriptive recommendations: scenarios, simulations and actionable next steps for stakeholders.
Deliver reporting and visualizations where they are the right answer, on top of the semantic model rather than beside it.
Collaborate with the data engineering team on pipelines and modelling, and act as a referent on analytics practices within the team.




Ideal profile:




Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, IT, or related field
At least 3 years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or related fields
Advanced SQL, and hands-on production experience with dbt
Strong background in data modelling: dimensional modelling, semantic layers, metric definitions
Comfortable with Python for statistical and predictive work
Experience with data governance practices (documentation, ownership, data quality)
Working knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, preferably Azure Databricks, and of a visualization tool (e.g. Microsoft Power BI)
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving aptitude, and a high standard of rigor and precision
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
Proactive and entrepreneurial, you are embracing challenges with enthusiasm
Fluent in English, both written and spoken




If you are interested in working in a fast growing company, on unique and innovative projects where you can use your creativity, this opportunity is tailored for you!




What We Offer




Grow your career in the new world of digital business.
Lead high-value strategic projects with a tangible business impact.
Work in a young, international, and multicultural environment, with teams across five continents.
Enjoy a flexible working environment, including hybrid work options.
Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities to continuously grow your skills.
Take part in the LittleBig Crew experience through afterworks, team-building activities, and internal and external events.




Diversity & Inclusion




LittleBig Connection is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within our teams and fostering an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, religion, age, marital status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.




Who are we?




The world of work is changing faster than ever. Companies need increasingly specialized expertise, while freelancers, consulting firms, and niche experts are reshaping the way organizations collaborate.




At LittleBig Connection, part of Mantu, our mission is simple: to create a direct, transparent, and efficient link between large organizations and the external experts who help them deliver their most important projects.




Through our international marketplace, we enable companies to quickly access the expertise they need, wherever they are. We help them identify, select, and contract with external experts while ensuring simplicity, compliance, and security throughout the process.




Today, LittleBig Connection brings together more than 400 employees across 50 countries, operates through 12 international offices, and facilitates over €500 million worth of projects every year through its platform.




Thousands of professionals from leading organizations rely on LittleBig Connection to collaborate with freelancers, consulting firms, and specialized experts around the world.




Joining LittleBig Connection means helping shape a new way for companies and experts to work together. It also means growing within an international, entrepreneurial, and fast-moving environment where ownership, accountability, transparency, and teamwork are part of everyday life.




At LittleBig Connection, everyone is encouraged to take initiative, create tangible impact, and contribute to a shared ambition: connecting the best expertise with the projects that matter most.




Team up with the world.
