Title: Experienced Data Analyst - Digital Sales (m/f/d)
Description:
Your Tasks

This position is part of the Digital Sales Data Foundation team, which drives data-driven decision making across our digital platforms by analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and measuring the impact of strategic initiatives with a strong focus on A/B testing to enhance customer experience and business performance. You will work closely with other Data Analysts, Data Engineers, a dedicated Product Owner, and colleagues from global and local business departments.

Your tasks:


Partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve analytics, tracking, and experimentation initiatives across digital areas.
Design, optimize, and document scalable tracking and measurement concepts, ensuring data quality, consistency, and usability for reporting, analysis, experimentation, and third-party integrations.
Define relevant KPIs, build dashboards, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support product optimization and data-driven decision-making.
Support and improve experimentation processes, including A/B test design, sample size planning, KPI alignment, analysis methodology, result interpretation, and rollout recommendations.
Contribute to scalable experimentation practices, tooling, automation, and knowledge management to support a growing number of experiments across markets, platforms, and product areas.
Work hands-on with complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud environments, and analytics tools, while collaborating closely with developers and data teams.
Act as a trusted sparring partner for stakeholders, working independently or within cross-functional teams, and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and continuous improvement.


Your Profile


Several years of experience in digital analytics, conversion analysis, product analytics, experimentation, or a similar data-focused role, ideally in an e-commerce or digital product environment.
Strong understanding of tracking concepts, KPI frameworks, data quality, reporting, and analytics tools such as Google Data Studio, Adobe Analytics, Firebase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong experience with A/B testing or experimentation methodologies, including test setup, sample size considerations, KPI definition, statistical evaluation, interpretation of results, and communication of conclusions.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL, complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud or data warehouse technologies such as Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, or similar solutions.
Experience working with developers and technical teams, including documentation of requirements, tracking concepts, data flows, and implementation logic.
Familiarity with modern collaboration and productivity tools such as GitHub, GitHub Copilot, AI agents, reusable skills/workflows, or similar tools.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions and explain complex topics clearly.
High level of ownership, self-organization, curiosity, and ability to work both independently and as part of technical and cross-functional teams.


About Us

MediaMarktSaturn is Europe’s leading consumer electronics retailer. It sees itself as a partner, daily companion and navigator for its customers in the digital world. Its over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores are closely integrated with their online shops. MediaMarktSaturn has a total headcount of more than 60,000.

MediaMarktSaturn Technology is working on making Europe's number one consumer electronics retailer the technology leader in its sector. To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 11 countries.

Technology Hub located in Barcelona, is one of the service units of MediaMarktSaturn Technology to deliver adequate staffing and engineering skills for the agreed deliveries of the global deployment plan for the entire group.

(*) Diversity and equal opportunities are important to us. Research shows that women and people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. If you are interested in this position but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Additional Benefits


Young environment, where not everything is written in stone, and where you are expected to contribute and co-create the culture of the Tech Hub and international collaboration model
You'll have a 10% discount on the entire MediaMarkt website, so you can treat yourself at a lower price whenever you want!
On top of your compensation package, you can request Flexible Pay “MediaFlex program” (a.e. Ticket Restaurant, Private Health Insurance with Adeslas, …)
Flexible working time and possibility to combine home office / presential working. Intensive workday every Friday and during summer
The possibility to choose between 2 offices: The first one is the MediaMarkt Spain HQ with a very attractive menu at a price. You'll eat for less than €4! And the second office is located at Pier01, in Barceloneta, right in the center of Barcelona.
There is a training budget so you can continue developing the skills you need most to keep growing professionally and personally!
We offer language classes: English, Spanish, and German
On your birthday, you won't work! It's a day for you to enjoy without thinking about work
You'll be working with the most cutting-edge technological stack of the moment

  • High level of ownership, self-organization, curiosity, and ability to work both independently and as part of technical and cross-functional teams.

MediaMarktSaturn is Europe’s leading consumer electronics retailer. It sees itself as a partner, daily companion and navigator for its customers in the digital world. Its over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores are closely integrated with their online shops. MediaMarktSaturn has a total headcount of more than 60,000.

To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 11 countries.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Serás responsable de analizar el rendimiento de campañas y acciones de comunicación, tanto digitales como offline, convirtiendo los datos en insights que permitan tomar mejores decisiones de negocio. Responsabilidades

Analizar el rendimiento de campañas de comunicación y marketing, evaluando su impacto sobre la marca y el negocio.

Diseñar, desarrollar e interpretar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para clientes y equipos internos.

Liderar la relación con clientes en materia de analítica, reporting y medición de resultados.

Integrar información procedente de diferentes fuentes para obtener una visión global del rendimiento de las acciones de marketing.

Colaborar estrechamente con equipos multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades de optimización.

Impulsar el uso del análisis de datos como herramienta para mejorar la efectividad de las campañas y la toma de decisiones.

Participar en la evolución de metodologías y procesos de medición dentro de la compañía.

Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics o Performance Analytics.

Experiencia previa en agencia o en entornos digitales de ritmo dinámico.

Conocimientos sólidos de marketing digital, comunicación y medición de campañas.

Experiencia trabajando con SQL, análisis de datos y estadística aplicada.

Capacidad para sintetizar grandes volúmenes de información y convertirlos en recomendaciones accionables.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación de resultados.

Nivel alto de inglés (C1).

Uso de herramientas de IA como Claude, Gemini o NotebookLM aplicadas al análisis de datos y automatización de procesos.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Expansion
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Expansion leadership on major transformation initiatives shaping the value proposition, business model, customer experience, monetization strategy, and operational playbook for new geographies, segments, and product lines.
Evaluate and prioritize new market entries, customer segments, and strategic bets through rigorous market sizing, competitive benchmarking, and customer analysis
Run focused, data-driven deep dives into expansion-stage customer behavior, unit economics, funnel performance, and competitive dynamics to surface where to double down and where to pivot.
Lead cross-functional performance analyses across Expansion workstreams — surfacing trends, explaining the drivers behind new-market KPIs, and delivering clear, actionable insights to the executive team.
Build the analytical models that underpin Expansion decisions: market sizing and TAM/SAM/SOM models, ramp and forecasting models for new launches, scenario models to pressure-test strategic options, and financial models to quantify the upside (and downside) of each bet.


What You Need To Succeed


5+ years of experience in business analytics, product analytics, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, capable of influencing Leadership-level stakeholders.
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
A proactive, curious mindset with a drive to investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives.
Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous, structured approach to analysis.
Proven Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills (e.g., driver-based modeling, sensitivity analysis, financial impact estimation).
Experience leading cross-functional analytics projects and engaging diverse stakeholders.


Nice to have


Experience in corporate strategy or strategic consulting, with a track record of supporting senior leadership on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives
Experience in fast-growing, data-driven startups, marketplaces, or subscription businesses
Hands-on experience with Looker and Snowflake


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance

  • Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
  • Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
  • Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
  • Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs

Experimentation Design & Governance

  • Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
  • Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
  • Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
  • Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations

Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights

  • Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
  • Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
  • Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
  • Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns

Data Integrity & Targeting Validation

  • Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
  • Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
  • Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
  • Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
  • Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
  • Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
  • Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
  • Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
  • Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
  • Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
  • Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.

Technical Skills

  • SQL (required)
  • Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
  • BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
  • Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Good to have

The best talent deserves the benefits

Title: Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
Description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth
Partner with business functions to gather, challenge, and refine reporting requirements, proposing better KPIs and smarter ways to analyze the data
Act as a BI business partner, running working sessions with stakeholders across functions to understand their priorities and translate them into analytical solutions
Define, standardize, and monitor core business KPIs (sales, margin, corporate finance, and beyond), ensuring consistency and a shared definition across reporting
Turn business questions into executive-ready dashboards and self-service analytics that drive decision making
Perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis, identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights
Promote data literacy and the adoption of self-service analytics across the organization


Qualifications


Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query (M), dataset and data model design, and report/dashboard development
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, interpret, and communicate complex data
Solid understanding of core business KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance
Strong business acumen, with the ability to engage, challenge, and advise stakeholders across different functions — this is a hybrid business-and-technical role, not a pure IT developer position
Proven experience in a similar BI / analytics role (~3 years)
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and lead requirement-gathering discussions
Proficiency in Excel
Experience in data modeling, data analysis, and data visualization
Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona


You will be joining a highly motivated and skilled team, providing a great environment to learn and grow. If you love working with data, building insights, and partnering with the business to drive better decisions, this is the position for you. We value a proactive approach and encourage continuous learning and development, ensuring that you will have ample opportunities to enhance your skills and contribute to our success.

Arxada has world class offerings in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Who we are:
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

About The Role
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering Rover’s customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.

The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.

You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience
Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers

At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists




Nice to Have:


Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R
Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting

The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process

About The Role
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering Rover’s customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.

The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.

You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience
  • Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
  • Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
  • Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
  • Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
  • Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers



What we're looking for (must-haves):

  • At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
  • Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
  • You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
  • You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
  • Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists

Tus tareas

Buscamos incorporar un/a Analista de Datos / Desarrollador/a BI que actúe como nexo entre las necesidades del negocio y las soluciones analíticas de la compañía.

La persona seleccionada participará en la evolución del ecosistema de datos y reporting, con foco en el análisis del reporting actual, el diseño de nuevos datamarts en BigQuery, la colaboración en el modelado semántico con Dataform y la transición progresiva desde Power BI hacia Looker / LookML.

Se trata de un rol con una fuerte componente analítica y funcional, orientado a hacer que los datos sean accesibles, comprensibles y útiles para los usuarios finales, garantizando al mismo tiempo consistencia métrica, escalabilidad y calidad del dato.

Tus principales responsabilidades serán:


Analizar los informes existentes en Power BI para entender métricas, dimensiones y lógica de negocio
Participar en el diseño y modelado de datamarts en BigQuery como fuente única de verdad para el reporting.
Colaborar en la creación, evolución y mantenimiento de la capa semántica en Dataform y, progresivamente, en LookML.
Simplificar, validar y estandarizar métricas e indicadores junto con las áreas de negocio.
Adaptar y reconstruir dashboards para consumir los nuevos datamarts y modelos semánticos.
Desarrollar y mantener informes y modelos en Power BI, participando en su evolución futura hacia Looker.
Documentar métricas, reglas de negocio, dimensiones y modelos de datos.
Ejecutar pruebas y validaciones funcionales del dato con usuarios finales.
Actuar como puente entre negocio y tecnología para traducir necesidades analíticas en soluciones claras y sostenibles.
Proponer mejoras en rendimiento, gobernanza del dato, consistencia semántica y usabilidad del reporting


Tu perfil

¿Qué buscamos en ti?


Experiencia en un rol similar dentro del ámbito de BI, analítica o reporting.
Conocimiento de Power BI, incluyendo modelado de datos, DAX y Power Query (M).
Experiencia con Looker y/o LookML.
Nivel avanzado de SQL y capacidad para trabajar con datos en BigQuery.
Experiencia en diseño de datamarts y modelos de datos para BI, especialmente esquemas en estrella.
Capacidad para traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones analíticas.
Experiencia en definición, validación y documentación de métricas e indicadores.
Habilidad para trabajar con usuarios finales en procesos de validación y adopción.
Excelente capacidad de comunicación y síntesis.

Conocimiento de Dataform

Experiencia en proyectos de migración o racionalización de reporting.

Experiencia en sector retail.

Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.
Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic.


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full

Title: Junior Data Analyst & AI Automation Specialist
Description:
En Rubió llevamos más de 55 años trabajando para que todas las personas tengan acceso a nuestros medicamentos, independientemente de la prevalencia de su patología, contribuyendo así a mejorar su calidad de vida.




Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst & Automation Specialist para Nutribrain, una compañía especializada en la fabricación y comercialización de suplementos alimenticios naturales, orientados al bienestar mental y físico, la nutrición y la mejora de la calidad de vida, con una fuerte apuesta por la innovación, la investigación y la calidad en el ámbito de la salud.




La posición estará ubicada en Barcelona y se integrará en un equipo pequeño y ágil, donde los datos tienen un papel clave en la toma de decisiones. La persona seleccionada trabajará directamente con el CEO, con autonomía y margen para proponer y desarrollar soluciones.




¿Cuál será tu rol?




La persona seleccionada tendrá un rol dinámico y transversal, combinando análisis de datos, desarrollo de herramientas y automatización de procesos.




Será responsable de transformar datos en información útil para el negocio y de desarrollar soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y automatizar procesos, trabajando con datos de ventas, previsiones, stock y diferentes plataformas y marketplaces.




Además del análisis técnico, la persona será capaz de interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio, entendiendo el impacto de variables como ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, stock, rotación de producto y previsiones, para aportar recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.




Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con tecnologías de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a diferentes áreas del negocio, participando en el desarrollo de soluciones y herramientas propias.




Funciones principales




Análisis de datos y automatización

Analizar datos de negocio, incluyendo ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales, identificando tendencias, estacionalidades e inconsistencias.
Desarrollar dashboards y herramientas de visualización que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y desarrollar automatizaciones e integraciones entre plataformas, APIs y bases de datos.
Crear flujos de datos automatizados y herramientas propias para obtener información de fuentes sin API oficial, mediante web scraping y automatización de navegadores.
Desarrollar aplicaciones y soluciones internas adaptadas a las necesidades del negocio.
Interpretar indicadores de negocio relacionados con ventas, rentabilidad, stock y catálogo de producto, identificando oportunidades de mejora y apoyando la toma de decisiones desde una perspectiva financiera y comercial.




IA y desarrollo de nuevas soluciones

Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a procesos y necesidades reales del negocio.
Integrar modelos de lenguaje y herramientas de IA en flujos de trabajo y automatizaciones.
Participar en el desarrollo de soluciones de IA audiovisual para generación de vídeo, voz e imagen.
Identificar nuevas oportunidades de automatización y proponer soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y aportar valor al negocio.




¿Qué requisitos buscamos?




Formación y experiencia: 2-4 años de experiencia en análisis de datos aplicado a negocio, con capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos y entornos dinámicos.
Análisis de datos: sólida capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico, con experiencia en análisis de ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales.
Programación y datos: buen dominio de SQL y Python (pandas), experiencia con datasets reales, Git/GitHub y APIs REST.
Automatización: experiencia con web scraping, automatización de navegadores y herramientas de integración y automatización de procesos.
Herramientas y tecnología: nivel avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets y, valorable, experiencia con herramientas de BI, bases de datos, n8n, Make, Zapier o tecnologías similares.
IA y nuevas tecnologías: Dominio de asistentes de programación y desarrollo basados en IA, como Codex, Claude Code, Cursor o herramientas similares, utilizándolos de forma habitual para acelerar el desarrollo y la automatización, curiosidad por mantenerse al día de la evolución de los modelos de IA, nuevas capacidades y herramientas emergentes, evaluando su aplicación práctica en el entorno empresarial.
Perfil personal: persona resolutiva, autónoma, organizada y con capacidad para gestionar proyectos propios y encontrar soluciones ante nuevos retos.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contratación estable.
Presencial de lunes, miércoles y jueves en oficinas de Barcelona.
Martes y viernes con posibilidad de teletrabajo.
Viernes con jornada intensiva.
Incorporación a un equipo en crecimiento con oportunidades reales de desarrollo profesional.




Si crees que encajas con el perfil y quieres formar parte de un equipo comprometido con la innovación y la excelencia, ¡te estamos buscando!




Si quieres saber más sobre nosotros, visita nuestra web:




www.laboratoriosrubio.com

https://www.nutribrain.eu/

Title: Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst, you work on global transformation and optimizing projects in Supply Chain. You contribute to successful project outcomes by focusing on the end-to-end data roadmap, from data querying and data quality review to data analysis, dashboarding, data modelling and communication with client business and IT teams.

In This Role You Will


Support master data management and data governance activities, including data preparation, validation, documentation and stakeholder alignment.
Query, analyse and model supply chain data, and review data quality across large datasets.
Support data architecture and integration between ERP, APS and reporting environments, including data migration, data factories and data warehousing.
Create dashboards and analyses that translate data into business insights.
Work closely with project teams, client business and IT teams, and support workshops to gather data requirements and promote best practices.


Job Requirements

About you


3+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics, data consulting or a related field, preferably working with large datasets from ERP or APS systems. Experience with OMP, Kinaxis or S/4HANA is a plus.
You have good proficiency in data querying, analysis and dashboard creation using tools such as MS Excel, PowerQuery, SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or QlikView.
You are familiar with master data management, data governance best practices, data factories, data architecture and integration.
You have strong problem-solving skills, an analytical mindset and an understanding of the business and customer context.
You have persuasive communication skills, are comfortable working with clients and can prioritize workload and communicate progress in a fast-paced international environment.
You like to learn and develop, are curious about how AI can improve data quality and integration, and are willing to stay hands-on with traditional master data work.
You hold a Master's degree in a relevant field, are fluent in English and are willing to travel globally and work in a hybrid setup from Barcelona. Spanish is a plus.
You feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together move fast and be kind!


Why join us?


You join a company built around supply chain transformation rather than broad, generalist consulting.
You become part of our supply chain data community, with different growth paths depending on what you want to deepen: data analysis, data quality, data modelling, data architecture, dashboarding, or people and process focused work.
You work on international supply chain projects where you do not only analyse data, but also help structure, cleanse, model, integrate and visualize it.
You leverage your expertise in a pioneering role, with the full support of our international team of supply chain and data experts to drive Barcelona’s success.
You are part of a global network spanning Belgium, the USA, Switzerland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Australia and Singapore, working on impactful international projects.
You have opportunities to travel to client sites, making your work truly international and engaging across borders.
You work on data that directly supports supply chain decisions, transformation projects and the successful implementation of planning solutions.
You work in a flexible and hybrid environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
You benefit from a competitive salary package.


About us

At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Within the Supply Chain Plan business unit, we have built up specific expertise in three main areas: Life sciences/pharma, CPG&CH and Chemicals&Industries. In these industries, we support a range of global leaders in their E2E planning transformation journey such as Bayer, Johnson&Johnson, BASF and Bridgestone.

During these E2E supply chain planning transformations, our experts support our customers in every step of their journey. We partner up to define a vision and review the operating model to create a strong and agile basis for the future.

The Plan business unit designs & implements our customers’ business transformation by defining the future organizational operating model, designing new ways of working & solutions advanced planning systems (APS), feeding their data factory, accelerating their setup towards agile S&OP or guiding them through their end-to-end supply chain planning. We do not work for them but rather with them, and we stand by their side the entire time. That is the only way to make changes stick and flourish.

Title: Staff Data Analyst - Compliance
Description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will


Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).


🤔 What You Can Expect


A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.


➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You


Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
Language: Fluent in English.


At Qonto we understand that true diversity isn't just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick! Who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we've been searching for all along.

By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (support@qonto.com)

Title: ACES Analyst, ADAT
Description:
Description

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join the ACES Data Analytics Team (ADAT) , supporting operational excellence through data-driven dashboarding solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards and underlying data pipelines that provide actionable insights to operations teams. You will work closely with stakeholders across the support function to translate business needs into analytics solutions that drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities

i) Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that support operational performance tracking and decision-making

ii) Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources

iii) Develop Python scripts for data manipulation, automation, and advanced analytics

iv) Partner with operations stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications

v) Perform root cause analysis on operational metrics, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement

vi) Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all reporting and dashboarding deliverables

vii) Proactively communicate progress, blockers, and risks to stakeholders and leadership

viii) Support KTLO (Keep The Lights On) activities for existing dashboards, including troubleshooting, bug fixes, and enhancements

A day in the life

In particular, Business Analysts will support the team with different types of analyses (from estimating the savings of a new project to calculating the drivers behind the Team’s performance) and work with various stakeholders in Amazon’s Operations. We are looking for profiles with analytics and communication skills, business sense and an excellent knowledge of Excel and the Microsoft Office package.

As a Business Analyst on our team, you own the full cycle from raw data to actionable insight. You write SQL queries to pull operational data from multiple sources, validate it, and transform it into something meaningful. When something looks off in the numbers, you investigate — tracing it back through the pipeline until you find the root cause and flag it to stakeholders before it becomes a problem.

You build and maintain dashboards in QuickSuite that operations teams rely on daily. That means designing layouts, connecting calculated fields, setting up filters, and making sure the right people see the right data at the right level of detail. You iterate on these based on feedback, always looking for ways to make the information clearer and more useful.

You also write Python scripts that automate repetitive work — data validations, scheduled extractions, report generation — things that used to take hours manually and now run in minutes. When a quick ad-hoc analysis comes in from a manager, you use Excel to pivot the data and deliver a clean summary without overengineering it.

Throughout all of this, you share what you find. You communicate insights clearly to stakeholders, walk them through what the data is telling us, and help them make decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions.

About The Team

Our team sits within the ACES organization and provides analytics and dashboarding solutions that support operational functions. We are a medium size, high-impact team focused on delivering clean, scalable, and well-documented analytics that enable data-driven decision-making across operations. We value seamless development practices, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience in a business analyst, data analyst or equivalent role
Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
iii) Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis across large datasets
vi) Proficiency in Excel for ad-hoc analysis and reporting
vii) Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical audiences


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in a logistics/operations environment
Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
Knowledge of SQL/ETL
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
Experience in process design and documentation
Familiarity with Amazon's data ecosystem (Redshift, Andes, S3)

Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Title: BI & Data Analytics Junior
Description:
El marketing digital ha dejado de ser una línea en un presupuesto para convertirse en el motor de crecimiento de las marcas. Pero entre tanta herramienta, dato y canal, muchas empresas necesitan un aliado que conecte todas las piezas: estrategia, tecnología, ejecución y resultados. Adsmurai se ha convertido en ese aliado.

Somos un Growth-Tech Partner. Combinamos tecnología propia, datos, inteligencia artificial y criterio experto para convertir el marketing en un sistema de crecimiento escalable. Diseñamos, construimos y optimizamos el sistema completo que hace que una marca crezca mejor, porque creemos que el crecimiento no viene de hacer más campañas, sino de conectar mejor las piezas.

Nuestra plataforma, Adsmurai Marketing Platform, es el cerebro de todo. Centraliza la gestión de campañas, datos, audiencias y feeds, permitiendo a marcas y agencias escalar resultados mediante estrategias automatizadas e inteligentes. Integra múltiples fuentes, plataformas y KPIs en tiempo real, automatiza catálogos y creatividades, y analiza datos de e-commerce, CRM y medios para optimizar la eficacia publicitaria.

Con una cultura basada en la excelencia, la agilidad y la colaboración, impulsamos un entorno donde la innovación audaz y la eficiencia generan resultados transformadores. Nuestro equipo, formado por más de 460 expertos, es clave en esta revolución tecnológica.

Somos partner oficial de Meta, Google, Pinterest y TikTok, y referente para marcas líderes en retail-fashion, lujo, educación y deportes. Contamos con oficinas en Barcelona, Málaga, Bogotá y Madrid, estableciendo el estándar global de eficiencia y excelencia en marketing digital.

🔍Buscamos un/a BI & Data Analytics junior con un fuerte componente de consultoría estratégica, implementación técnica y comunicación con cliente.

🚀 Desafíos Del Puesto


Modelado y Data Engineering: Diseñar, optimizar y mantener modelos de datos robustos en SQL para dar soporte a entornos cambiantes. Te encargarás de la limpieza, estructuración y carga de datos garantizando un alto estándar de rendimiento.
Visualización de datos y Data Storytelling (Looker/LookML): Construir productos de datos y cuadros de mando avanzados a partir de requerimientos técnicos. Te asegurarás de aplicar criterios estéticos y de usabilidad coherentes en el front-end de los dashboards para maximizar su adopción.
Calidad del dato y Gobernanza (Data Quality): Liderar el control de calidad del dato, identificando desviaciones, auditando flujos de información y resolviendo incidencias en procesos de datos complejos.
Consultoría técnica y Documentación: Sintetizar requerimientos del negocio en soluciones técnicas orientadas a producto. Serás responsable de responder a dudas sobre arquitecturas/flujos de datos y de mantener la documentación técnica al día bajo las mejores prácticas.


💯 Eres tu si:


Dominio avanzado de SQL: Aportas al menos 2 años de experiencia escribiendo, optimizando y auditando código SQL complejo para la preparación y transformación de datos.
Experiencia en Looker & LookML: Sabes cómo modelar datos en LookML y crear visualizaciones claras, interactivas y orientadas a la toma de decisiones directivas.
Capacidad analítica y rigor técnico: Posees una mente metódica para la detección de errores de datos, análisis de causa raíz y diseño de reglas de homogenización.
Cultura de documentación: Valoras la claridad y te aseguras de que cada desarrollo o modelo quede correctamente documentado para garantizar la escalabilidad del equipo.
Orientación a negocio: Capacidad para entender briefs técnicos complejos y traducirlos en productos de datos operativos de punta a punta.


✨ Plus muy valorado:


Herramientas de orquestación y transformación: Experiencia previa trabajando con dbt o herramientas similares de construcción de pipelines de datos.
Experiencia sectorial: Conocimientos en analítica aplicada a inversión en medios/marketing, métricas financieras o proyectos de medición de sostenibilidad/ESG.


✨ ¿Qué ofrecemos?


Contrato indefinido.
Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida.
Modelo híbrido oficina-remoto con 2 días de teletrabajo.
Jornada intensiva los viernes, prefestivos laborables, julio y agosto.
23 días de vacaciones (+1 día por año de antigüedad).
Adsmubirthday—día libre por tu cumpleaños.
Formación activa dentro de la empresa y crecimiento profesional a través de nuestro Plan de Carrera.
AdsmuAcademy (plataforma de formación adhoc para los trabajadores).
Actividades de equipo y afterworks.
Clases de inglés.
Convenio con gimnasios (WellHub)
Plan de retribución flexible: ticket restaurante, transporte y seguro médico.


🍀 Estos son nuestros valores:


Make things happen: Aplicamos la razón en la toma de decisiones basándonos en datos. Gestionamos de principio a fin y orientándonos a resultados.
Walk, run, fly: Disparamos la proactividad ejecutando ideas. Nos marcamos metas ambiciosas, tenemos curiosidad y no tenemos miedo al fracaso.
Passionate players: Trabajamos con actitud positiva y ponemos pasión en todo lo que hacemos, con perseverancia y orgullo por nuestro trabajo.
Work together: Construimos relaciones de confianza basadas en la honestidad. Escuchamos, empatizamos y respetamos a las personas.


Nuestra cultura está alineada con los valores universales de libertad, cooperación y autorrealización. Trabajamos cada día para que todo el mundo tenga las mismas oportunidades independientemente de su sexo, etnia, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, creencias políticas o religiosas y nunca aprobaremos ninguna acción discriminatoria.

Con una cultura basada en la excelencia, la agilidad y la colaboración, impulsamos un entorno donde la innovación audaz y la eficiencia generan resultados transformadores. Nuestro equipo, formado por más de 460 expertos, es clave en esta revolución tecnológica.

Somos partner oficial de Meta, Google, Pinterest y TikTok, y referente para marcas líderes en retail-fashion, lujo, educación y deportes. Contamos con oficinas en Barcelona, Málaga, Bogotá y Madrid, estableciendo el estándar global de eficiencia y excelencia en marketing digital.

🔍Buscamos un/a BI & Data Analytics junior con un fuerte componente de consultoría estratégica, implementación técnica y comunicación con cliente.

  • Modelado y Data Engineering: Diseñar, optimizar y mantener modelos de datos robustos en SQL para dar soporte a entornos cambiantes. Te encargarás de la limpieza, estructuración y carga de datos garantizando un alto estándar de rendimiento.

Title: Data Analyst I Courier RTO Global HQ
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR MISSION

Real-Time Operations keeps Glovo’s deliveries moving: when an order stalls, a courier stops, or a store goes quiet, RTO is what notices and acts.

Your mission is to find what is actually causing those failures and then build the thing that fixes them — the analysis and the automation, not one handed to someone else to build.

You will work at the intersection of operations analytics, AI agent quality and automation engineering, on problems that are genuinely unsolved.

THE JOURNEY


Own operational analyses end to end — take an ambiguous problem, find the real driver rather than the most visible symptom, and turn it into a decision about where to focus.
Build and run the automations that come out of that analysis: real-time detection, the action it triggers, the monitoring that proves it still works, and the documentation someone else can operate it from.
Work on the systems around our AI voice and chat agents across fourteen markets — automated conversation audits, the loop that turns an unanswered question into a knowledge base update, and the evaluation that says whether a prompt change helped or hurt.
Design and read the experiments behind what we ship: choose the unit of randomisation, pick the metric that reflects the real outcome, and report the result honestly, including when it says the thing does not work.
Build processes that send an input to an LLM and need a specific, reliable output back — together with the checks that confirm the output is what we expected.
Hand findings to the right owner when they sit outside RTO, with enough evidence that they can act on them.


Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

Must have


Advanced SQL — window functions, CTEs, joining across large event and transactional tables, and the habit of checking what a column really contains before building on it.
A structured, sceptical approach to problem-solving. You look for the reason your own conclusion might be wrong before someone else does.
Hands-on experience building something end to end that ran in production and that other people depended on.
Good written and verbal English. Most of your stakeholders are operations people, not analysts.


Nice to have


Python (pandas or equivalent), experiment analysis, BigQuery, n8n or similar orchestration, Google Apps Script, Looker, voice or chat AI agent platforms such as ElevenLabs, and a background in last-mile delivery, marketplaces or logistics.
Practical experience using LLMs inside a process that had to produce a reliable output — prompt design, structured outputs, and a way of checking the result.


Additional Information

At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!
