Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Como Data Analyst, formarás parte de un equipo de datos enfocado en transformar información financiera y de negocio en insights útiles para la toma de decisiones.

Tus principales responsabilidades serán:

Analizar datos financieros y de negocio para identificar tendencias, oportunidades y posibles desviaciones.
Extraer, transformar y consultar datos utilizando SQL.
Crear y mantener dashboards e informes para diferentes áreas de negocio.
Definir y hacer seguimiento de KPIs y métricas.
Trabajar con equipos de negocio para entender sus necesidades y traducirlas en análisis de datos.
Detectar problemas de calidad en los datos y proponer mejoras.
Presentar resultados e insights de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.



Lo que buscamos



3 años de experiencia como Data Analyst, Business Analyst con fuerte componente de datos o posición similar.
Buen dominio de SQL.
Experiencia con alguna herramienta de visualización, preferiblemente Power BI o Tableau.
Conocimientos básicos de Python para análisis de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con Excel y datos estructurados.
Capacidad para entender necesidades de negocio y convertirlas en análisis accionables.
Atención al detalle y orientación a la calidad de los datos.
Buen nivel de inglés.


Será valorable


Experiencia previa en sector financiero, banca, seguros, fintech o medios de pago.
Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales.
Experiencia con herramientas como Azure, AWS o Snowflake.
Conocimientos básicos de estadística.
Experiencia trabajando con metodologías Agile.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We are looking to welcome yet another brilliant Senior Marketing Data Analyst into our Marketing Analytics team.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be responsible for designing and driving high-impact analytics solutions, from developing advanced statistical frameworks to evaluate marketing performance, to building data pipelines that integrate third-party sources, to creating interactive tools that empower partner teams. These are just a few examples of the initiatives you’ll help lead and deliver end-to-end, playing a key role in shaping the technical direction of our analytics efforts. The demands on this team are constantly evolving with the needs of Socialpoint’s and Zynga’s dynamic marketing teams, so it is important that you be able to adapt and utilize your time efficiently.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with marketing and cross-functional teams to identify growth opportunities, improve efficiency, and shape strategic initiatives.
Lead analytical deep dives to surface insights and translate them into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Visualize and communicate analytical findings clearly, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Apply statistical methodologies to evaluate performance and account for uncertainties in major initiatives.
Proactively explore and prototype opportunities using AI-driven automation to streamline investigations and improve decision-making.


What You Bring


Demonstrated experience with some or all of the following: predictive modeling, statistics, experimental design, optimization, data visualization
Understanding of marketing metrics and KPIs, with experience in campaign optimization, Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling, and incrementality analysis
Proficiency in SQL and Python with hands-on experience in Redshift, Databricks, PySpark, and Airflow
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguous questions into data-driven insights
Strong communication skills — you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus
A team player, you establish effective relationships to work with others for the win
Proven work experience in data analytics or data science roles
BS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative field; Masters, MBA or PhD preferred


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)


The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English.

Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Please contact us at recruitment@socialpoint.es to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.

Analizar, transformar y visualizar datos para generar insights accionables y mejorar la toma de decisiones de negocio dentro del sector bancario, trabajando de forma transversal con diferentes equipos y stakeholders.

Automatización y optimización de procesos de reporting y análisis.
Preparación de informes y presentaciones para distintos niveles de gestión.
Identificación de tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora a partir de los datos.
Participación en la definición, priorización y seguimiento de iniciativas relacionadas con datos.

+4 años de experiencia en posiciones similares
Residencia en Barcelona (4 días presencial + 1 teletrabajo)
Perfil organizado, resolutivo y orientado a resultados
Experiencia trabajando con JIRA y Confluence

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.
Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic.


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)


The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
¡En K-LAGAN te estamos esperando para continuar creciendo juntos! Somos una empresa estratégica internacional de servicios tecnológicos, comprometida esencialmente con su equipo y con la sociedad. Ofrecemos soluciones en servicios IT, desarrollos de ingeniería, de electrónica y proyectos de I+D.




En esta ocasión, buscamos incorporar a un/a Data Analyst (Power BI Expert) para un proyecto internacional y altamente estratégico dentro del sector seguros/asistencia.




🚀 Misión del puesto Como Data Analyst dentro del equipo central de plataforma de Datos e IA (Analytics Team), tu misión principal será transformar datos complejos en insights accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas. Serás una pieza clave dentro de la red de analistas de datos, actuando como referente en Power BI y Modelos Tabulares, impulsando la estandarización, la calidad del dato y el diseño de soluciones analíticas avanzadas a escala global.




📌 Responsabilidades principales

Desarrollo y Mejores Prácticas: Diseñar, implementar y mantener reportes/dashboards en Power BI, definiendo guías y estándares para modelado dimensional (Kimball, star schema), data marts y tecnologías asociadas (DAX, MDX, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Log Analytics/KQL).
Referente Técnico y Mentoring: Capacitar y dar soporte a los equipos de datos en el uso avanzado de Power BI, capacidades Premium/Embedded y Microsoft Fabric, actuando como experto ad-hoc para resolver flujos de datos y optimizar el rendimiento.
Evolución de la Plataforma BI: Contribuir al desarrollo e implantación del modelo de BI corporativo descentralizado y a la creación de sistemas analíticos avanzados en producción.
Comunidad de Datos (Guild): Participar activamente en la comunidad de analistas, fomentando la transferencia de conocimiento, la colaboración internacional y el crecimiento del ecosistema analítico.
Monitoreo y BAU: Supervisar actividades operativas, realizar tareas de mantenimiento/soporte (BAU) y generar informes sobre el rendimiento de la plataforma y la calidad de los datos.
Metodología Ágil: Trabajar en un entorno Agile (Scrum/Kanban) dentro de un equipo multicultural, traduciendo requisitos de negocio en soluciones técnicas claras (prototipos/mock-ups).




🎯 Requisitos

Experiencia: Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en entornos Big Data (Build & Run) y analítica de datos, preferiblemente en organizaciones multinacionales.
Power BI & Visualización: Experiencia avanzada y sólida demostrable en Power BI, modelos tabulares, DAX, MDX y Azure Analysis Services. Valorable conocimiento en Power BI Premium/Embedded capacity y Microsoft Fabric.
SQL & Programación: Dominio experto de SQL. Valorable conocimientos en Python y PowerShell.
Data Warehousing & Cloud: Conocimiento sólido en principios de Business Intelligence, modelado dimensional (Kimball, esquemas en estrella), Data Warehouses y Data Marts. Valorable experiencia o familiaridad con Azure Cloud Datalake, Databricks, Spark o NoSQL.
Herramientas y Metodologías: Deseable conocimiento del ciclo de vida del software (Git, CI/CD con Azure DevOps) y metodologías Agile/Scrum.
Idiomas: Inglés fluido obligatorio (C1) para entorno de trabajo internacional diario. Francés muy valorable (o disposición a aprenderlo).
Perfil: Mentalidad proactiva, orientada al cliente, espíritu colaborativo y habilidades pedagógicas/mentoras. Valorable experiencia previa en el sector asegurador, financiero o de asistencia.




🌱 ¿Qué te ofrecemos en K-LAGAN?

Contrato indefinido y proyecto estable a largo plazo.
Modelo de trabajo híbrido en Barcelona.
Salario anual: 44.000 euros/aprox.
Horario flexible y conciliación.
Formación continua y plan de carrera personalizado.
Programa de reconocimiento 3 C’s (Compromiso, Comunicación y Orientación al Cliente).
Día libre por tu cumpleaños.
Seguro médico y plan de retribución flexible.
Descuento en gimnasio.
Ayudas en guarderías, idiomas y transporte (KM).
Día solidario anual.
Eventos de empresa: team building, cafés tecnológicos, afterworks, cena de verano y cena de Navidad.
A partir de 4 años de antigüedad, +1 día adicional de vacaciones.




Nuestro compromiso es contratar a los mejores talentos independientemente de su raza, religión, sexo, edad o personas con otras capacidades, promoviendo siempre su desarrollo profesional y personal.

Title: Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
Description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth
Partner with business functions to gather, challenge, and refine reporting requirements, proposing better KPIs and smarter ways to analyze the data
Act as a BI business partner, running working sessions with stakeholders across functions to understand their priorities and translate them into analytical solutions
Define, standardize, and monitor core business KPIs (sales, margin, corporate finance, and beyond), ensuring consistency and a shared definition across reporting
Turn business questions into executive-ready dashboards and self-service analytics that drive decision making
Perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis, identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights
Promote data literacy and the adoption of self-service analytics across the organization


Qualifications


Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query (M), dataset and data model design, and report/dashboard development
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, interpret, and communicate complex data
Solid understanding of core business KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance
Strong business acumen, with the ability to engage, challenge, and advise stakeholders across different functions — this is a hybrid business-and-technical role, not a pure IT developer position
Proven experience in a similar BI / analytics role (~3 years)
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and lead requirement-gathering discussions
Proficiency in Excel
Experience in data modeling, data analysis, and data visualization
Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona


You will be joining a highly motivated and skilled team, providing a great environment to learn and grow. If you love working with data, building insights, and partnering with the business to drive better decisions, this is the position for you. We value a proactive approach and encourage continuous learning and development, ensuring that you will have ample opportunities to enhance your skills and contribute to our success.

Arxada has world class offerings in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Title: Checkout Data Analyst - (Hybrid)
Description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking highly skilled technical Data Analysts for the Checkout team who are passionate about data, automation, analysis, and innovation, and who love working in a collaborative and agile environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Data Analyst in the Checkout team, you will be in charge of:


Build the infrastructure required for the extraction, transformation and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources.
Assemble large and complex datasets, with an optimal data pipeline architecture, meeting business requirements.
Implement processes to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes that depend on it.
Create alerts and dashboards to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs.
Identify, design and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimising queries, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc.
Collaborate with analytics and business teams to improve data models that feed existing reports or create brand new reports with the aim to increase data accessibility and foster data-driven decision making across the organisation.
Contribute to the delivery of strategic projects by participating in the delivery of key initiatives, giving support to the analytics and business teams when it comes to data availability and visualisation to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes. Work together with stakeholders in the execution of the projects.



What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.).
Experience building and optimising data pipelines, data sets and workflow management tools (e.g. Dataform).
Advance knowledge of SQL is a requirement as well as experience working with databases and large sets of data; Python programming skills are also required as well as experience in data visualisation or exploration tools such as Looker Studio.
An AI-first mindset — proactively exploring how AI tools can improve efficiency and quality of work.
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with Microsoft and Google Office packages (Excel, etc.).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail.
Strong organisational and communication skills.
Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!
Business Proficiency in English.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops,tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Title: Staff Data Analyst - Compliance
Description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will


Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).


🤔 What You Can Expect


A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.


➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You


Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
Language: Fluent in English.

Title: ACES Analyst, ADAT
Description:
Description

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join the ACES Data Analytics Team (ADAT) , supporting operational excellence through data-driven dashboarding solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards and underlying data pipelines that provide actionable insights to operations teams. You will work closely with stakeholders across the support function to translate business needs into analytics solutions that drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities

i) Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that support operational performance tracking and decision-making

ii) Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources

iii) Develop Python scripts for data manipulation, automation, and advanced analytics

iv) Partner with operations stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications

v) Perform root cause analysis on operational metrics, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement

vi) Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all reporting and dashboarding deliverables

vii) Proactively communicate progress, blockers, and risks to stakeholders and leadership

viii) Support KTLO (Keep The Lights On) activities for existing dashboards, including troubleshooting, bug fixes, and enhancements

A day in the life

In particular, Business Analysts will support the team with different types of analyses (from estimating the savings of a new project to calculating the drivers behind the Team’s performance) and work with various stakeholders in Amazon’s Operations. We are looking for profiles with analytics and communication skills, business sense and an excellent knowledge of Excel and the Microsoft Office package.

As a Business Analyst on our team, you own the full cycle from raw data to actionable insight. You write SQL queries to pull operational data from multiple sources, validate it, and transform it into something meaningful. When something looks off in the numbers, you investigate — tracing it back through the pipeline until you find the root cause and flag it to stakeholders before it becomes a problem.

You build and maintain dashboards in QuickSuite that operations teams rely on daily. That means designing layouts, connecting calculated fields, setting up filters, and making sure the right people see the right data at the right level of detail. You iterate on these based on feedback, always looking for ways to make the information clearer and more useful.

You also write Python scripts that automate repetitive work — data validations, scheduled extractions, report generation — things that used to take hours manually and now run in minutes. When a quick ad-hoc analysis comes in from a manager, you use Excel to pivot the data and deliver a clean summary without overengineering it.

Throughout all of this, you share what you find. You communicate insights clearly to stakeholders, walk them through what the data is telling us, and help them make decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions.

About The Team

Our team sits within the ACES organization and provides analytics and dashboarding solutions that support operational functions. We are a medium size, high-impact team focused on delivering clean, scalable, and well-documented analytics that enable data-driven decision-making across operations. We value seamless development practices, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience in a business analyst, data analyst or equivalent role
Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
iii) Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis across large datasets
vi) Proficiency in Excel for ad-hoc analysis and reporting
vii) Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical audiences


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in a logistics/operations environment
Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
Knowledge of SQL/ETL
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
Experience in process design and documentation
Familiarity with Amazon's data ecosystem (Redshift, Andes, S3)

About Kiwi.com

Kiwi.com is a leading global travel-tech company headquartered in the Czech Republic. Our innovative algorithm enables users to find better route options and prices other search engines can’t see, daily performing billions of price checks across 95% of global flight content. Are you bold, bright and curious? Join a global business that’s still got a start-up heart.

About Customer Support Analytics Team

We support our Customer Support department to turn complex operational data into thoughtful, high-impact decisions that enhance customer satisfaction and strengthen daily operations. Partnering closely across Product, Finance, and Operations, we build intuitive dashboards and data models to bring real-time visibility to friction points, tracking airline recovery and ensuring accurate, timely refunds. In our AI-native team, you will collaborate directly with key decision-makers, seeing firsthand how your shared insights make the customer journey measurably better.

What You Will Do


Support the analytical side of our refunds operation by building reliable data structures, tracking process flows, and partnering with Finance, Product, and Engineering to optimize airline recovery performance.
Partner with the CS Operations team to turn large-scale datasets into actionable insights that support agent productivity, queue management, and customer satisfaction.
Identify inefficiencies across CS Operations and Refunds by acting as a collaborative process expert, leveraging AI tools to support and streamline daily team workflows.
Collaborate closely with Workforce Management and vendor partners to ensure they have accurate, trusted data for volume forecasting, productivity tracking, and headcount modeling.
Co-create automation processes alongside Engineering by evaluating expected efficiency gains and supporting smooth post-implementation transitions.
Maintain and improve internal data pipelines by writing optimized SQL queries that extract meaningful insights and keep shared reporting tools up to date.
Connect with senior leadership by developing clear, empathetic, and data-backed narratives that articulate operational challenges while offering thoughtful solutions.


What You Will Need


A proven track record in a business analytics role, with experience translating complex operational data into supportive business decisions—ideally within a Customer Support environment.
Strong proficiency in SQL, with confidence writing and managing your own queries, understanding underlying data structures, and supporting peers through code reviews.
Demonstrated experience with Data Visualization tools (such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI) to build, refine, and maintain accessible, insight-rich dashboards.
A natural curiosity for AI tools, actively exploring new ways to make work sharper and faster while sharing discoveries to uplift the wider team.
Professional proficiency level English language skills (written and verbal), with clear, empathetic communication skills when working across diverse stakeholders and senior leadership.


We offer you


We offer a hybrid and flexible work environment. A lovely, modern office in the center of Barcelona (Passeig de Gracia) with great views and amenities.
Monthly entitlement of 200 Euro redeemable through Cobee. Cobee is a benefits platform offering a range of benefits (meals, transport, nursery, health insurance, and physical wellness) and flexible compensation. It also allows our employees to allocate up to 30% of their gross salary to the consumption of certain products or services, leveraging tax exemption.
We also enjoy benefits, such as flexible working hours, 30 paid vacation days and sick days.
Annual financial bonus based on company and individual performance.
Flight vouchers to celebrate your Kiwi anniversaries.
Relocation package (including visa transfer support).
Dogs are welcome in our offices.


Interested? Join us and help us make travel more accessible to all.

Title: BI & Data Analytics Junior
Description:
El marketing digital ha dejado de ser una línea en un presupuesto para convertirse en el motor de crecimiento de las marcas. Pero entre tanta herramienta, dato y canal, muchas empresas necesitan un aliado que conecte todas las piezas: estrategia, tecnología, ejecución y resultados. Adsmurai se ha convertido en ese aliado.

Somos un Growth-Tech Partner. Combinamos tecnología propia, datos, inteligencia artificial y criterio experto para convertir el marketing en un sistema de crecimiento escalable. Diseñamos, construimos y optimizamos el sistema completo que hace que una marca crezca mejor, porque creemos que el crecimiento no viene de hacer más campañas, sino de conectar mejor las piezas.

Nuestra plataforma, Adsmurai Marketing Platform, es el cerebro de todo. Centraliza la gestión de campañas, datos, audiencias y feeds, permitiendo a marcas y agencias escalar resultados mediante estrategias automatizadas e inteligentes. Integra múltiples fuentes, plataformas y KPIs en tiempo real, automatiza catálogos y creatividades, y analiza datos de e-commerce, CRM y medios para optimizar la eficacia publicitaria.

Con una cultura basada en la excelencia, la agilidad y la colaboración, impulsamos un entorno donde la innovación audaz y la eficiencia generan resultados transformadores. Nuestro equipo, formado por más de 460 expertos, es clave en esta revolución tecnológica.

Somos partner oficial de Meta, Google, Pinterest y TikTok, y referente para marcas líderes en retail-fashion, lujo, educación y deportes. Contamos con oficinas en Barcelona, Málaga, Bogotá y Madrid, estableciendo el estándar global de eficiencia y excelencia en marketing digital.

🔍Buscamos un/a BI & Data Analytics junior con un fuerte componente de consultoría estratégica, implementación técnica y comunicación con cliente.

🚀 Desafíos Del Puesto


Modelado y Data Engineering: Diseñar, optimizar y mantener modelos de datos robustos en SQL para dar soporte a entornos cambiantes. Te encargarás de la limpieza, estructuración y carga de datos garantizando un alto estándar de rendimiento.
Visualización de datos y Data Storytelling (Looker/LookML): Construir productos de datos y cuadros de mando avanzados a partir de requerimientos técnicos. Te asegurarás de aplicar criterios estéticos y de usabilidad coherentes en el front-end de los dashboards para maximizar su adopción.
Calidad del dato y Gobernanza (Data Quality): Liderar el control de calidad del dato, identificando desviaciones, auditando flujos de información y resolviendo incidencias en procesos de datos complejos.
Consultoría técnica y Documentación: Sintetizar requerimientos del negocio en soluciones técnicas orientadas a producto. Serás responsable de responder a dudas sobre arquitecturas/flujos de datos y de mantener la documentación técnica al día bajo las mejores prácticas.


💯 Eres tu si:


Dominio avanzado de SQL: Aportas al menos 2 años de experiencia escribiendo, optimizando y auditando código SQL complejo para la preparación y transformación de datos.
Experiencia en Looker & LookML: Sabes cómo modelar datos en LookML y crear visualizaciones claras, interactivas y orientadas a la toma de decisiones directivas.
Capacidad analítica y rigor técnico: Posees una mente metódica para la detección de errores de datos, análisis de causa raíz y diseño de reglas de homogenización.
Cultura de documentación: Valoras la claridad y te aseguras de que cada desarrollo o modelo quede correctamente documentado para garantizar la escalabilidad del equipo.
Orientación a negocio: Capacidad para entender briefs técnicos complejos y traducirlos en productos de datos operativos de punta a punta.


✨ Plus muy valorado:


Herramientas de orquestación y transformación: Experiencia previa trabajando con dbt o herramientas similares de construcción de pipelines de datos.
Experiencia sectorial: Conocimientos en analítica aplicada a inversión en medios/marketing, métricas financieras o proyectos de medición de sostenibilidad/ESG.


✨ ¿Qué ofrecemos?


Contrato indefinido.
Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida.
Modelo híbrido oficina-remoto con 2 días de teletrabajo.
Jornada intensiva los viernes, prefestivos laborables, julio y agosto.
23 días de vacaciones (+1 día por año de antigüedad).
Adsmubirthday—día libre por tu cumpleaños.
Formación activa dentro de la empresa y crecimiento profesional a través de nuestro Plan de Carrera.
AdsmuAcademy (plataforma de formación adhoc para los trabajadores).
Actividades de equipo y afterworks.
Clases de inglés.
Convenio con gimnasios (WellHub)
Plan de retribución flexible: ticket restaurante, transporte y seguro médico.


🍀 Estos son nuestros valores:


Make things happen: Aplicamos la razón en la toma de decisiones basándonos en datos. Gestionamos de principio a fin y orientándonos a resultados.
Walk, run, fly: Disparamos la proactividad ejecutando ideas. Nos marcamos metas ambiciosas, tenemos curiosidad y no tenemos miedo al fracaso.
Passionate players: Trabajamos con actitud positiva y ponemos pasión en todo lo que hacemos, con perseverancia y orgullo por nuestro trabajo.
Work together: Construimos relaciones de confianza basadas en la honestidad. Escuchamos, empatizamos y respetamos a las personas.


Nuestra cultura está alineada con los valores universales de libertad, cooperación y autorrealización. Trabajamos cada día para que todo el mundo tenga las mismas oportunidades independientemente de su sexo, etnia, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, creencias políticas o religiosas y nunca aprobaremos ninguna acción discriminatoria.

Adsmurai nació en 2014 de una conversación entre amigos y tratamos de mantener y transmitir ese buen rollo y convertirlo en un pilar fundamental de nuestra cultura.

Title: DATA ANALYTICS & REPORTING ANALYST
Place: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
Would you like to join an international team working to improve the future of healthcare? Do you want to enhance the lives of millions of people? Grifols is a global healthcare company that since 1909 has been working to improve the health and well-being of people around the world. We are leaders in plasma-derived medicines and transfusion medicine and develop, produce and market innovative medicines, solutions and services in more than 110 countries and regions.

We believe that diversity adds value to our business, our teams, and our culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, fostering an inclusive environment where diversity makes us outstanding.

Mission

Your mission will be twofold: to ensure the reliable and efficient operation of existing analytics and reporting solutions, and to support the design and implementation of new data projects that transform information into actionable insights for informed decision-making. This role acts as a technical and analytical reference, working closely with IT and business stakeholders to support Compliance needs through high-quality data solutions.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be


Analytics & Reporting Operations
Maintain, optimize, and evolve data systems and Business Intelligence platforms that support Compliance activities.
Administer, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting models, primarily in Power BI, ensuring accuracy, usefulness, and consistency of information.
Guarantee data integrity, availability, and consistency across reporting flows, ensuring day-to-day operational continuity of critical systems and on-time delivery of internal and regulatory reports.
Technical Implementation of Data Projects
Support end-to-end technical implementation of data initiatives, including the design of pipelines and ETL/ELT processes (data extraction, transformation, and loading).
Design, document, and maintain automated data ingestion and transformation processes to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
Work closely with IT and business teams to integrate new data sources, ensure compatibility with existing architecture, and implement technical improvements.
Manage and resolve data- and reporting-related incidents promptly to minimize operational impact and ensure system quality and resilience.
Reporting & Communication
Prepare and present periodic reports on Compliance performance, including program KPIs, Risk Profiling status, training metrics, and operational indicators, providing executive-level summaries and detailed operational views.
Publish and maintain reports in Power BI (apps, subscriptions, alerts), implementing appropriate access controls and row-level security.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating technical outputs into understandable insights.
Maintain data catalogs, technical documentation, and operational manuals, supporting Data Governance practices and user training on Analytics & Reporting tools and processes.

Who You Are

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, education, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions).


University degree (second-cycle studies / licenciatura or equivalent).
2 to 5 years of proven experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting-related roles.
Advanced English level, enabling effective communication in an international environment.
Proven knowledge and practical experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, and SharePoint.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage incidents and drive continuous improvement.
High degree of autonomy and proactivity, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts into business-relevant information.
Strong orientation to results, quality, and timely delivery, particularly in regulatory and compliance-related reporting contexts.



What We Offer

It is a brilliant opportunity for you, Grifols is fully aware that its employees are one of its major assets. We are committed to maintaining an atmosphere that encourages all our employees to develop their professional careers in an excellent working environment.

Information about Grifols is available at www.grifols.com. If you are interested in joining our company and you have what it takes for such an exciting position, then don’t hesitate to apply!

We look forward to receiving your application!

We believe in diverse talent and want to remove any barriers that may hinder your participation. If you require any adjustments in our selection process, please do not hesitate to inform us when applying. We are here to help.

Grifols is an equal opportunity employer.

Flexibility for U Program: Hybrid Model.

Benefits Package

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to start a new professional challenge? Check out our new opportunity!

We are looking to incorporate a Data Analyst to our team.

🤗 About us

We are an IT Consultant Group that provides services and creates digital solutions to improve the lives of citizens across Europe. Check out our website: www.altia.es/en

🚀 Our project and team

This is your opportunity to start working on international projects with a highly qualified team and applying the latest technologies.

You will join our European team, specifically the one involved in several projects for a significant European Agency.

Minimum Requirements

🧠 Required Knowledge


Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting.
Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable datasets.
High level of English.


✅ Main Responsibilities


Collect and clean data from various sources.
Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.


🔝 Skills:


Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights.
Skill in presenting findings with visuals and storytelling that support decisions.
Commitment to maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity in reporting.
Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
Competence in managing tasks and delivering insights on time.
Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively.
Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
Ability to understand, speak and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.


This job offer has been drafted with impartiality and non-discrimination on the basis of gender, race, ideology or any other grounds in mind. In particular, it complies with current regulations on gender equality between women and men (Royal Decree-Law 6/2019)

Title: Junior Data & BI Analyst
Description:
En Solcasino buscamos incorporar un/a Junior Data & BI Analyst con una sólida formación cuantitativa y una clara especialización en datos, analítica y Business Intelligence.




Esta posición está especialmente pensada para recién graduados o profesionales en sus primeras experiencias laborales que quieran desarrollarse rápidamente trabajando con datos reales de negocio y participando en la toma de decisiones de diferentes áreas de la compañía.

No buscamos una larga experiencia profesional. Buscamos muy buena base técnica, capacidad analítica, curiosidad y alto potencial de desarrollo.




¿Qué harás?

Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos relacionados con clientes, producto, marketing y operaciones.
Preparar, limpiar y transformar datos para diferentes análisis de negocio.
Construir consultas SQL y realizar análisis utilizando Python.
Crear dashboards, reporting y herramientas de Business Intelligence.
Analizar comportamiento de clientes, segmentaciones, cohortes y tendencias.
Apoyar análisis relacionados con adquisición, CRM, promociones, producto y operaciones.
Detectar anomalías, patrones y oportunidades a partir de los datos.
Ayudar a diferentes departamentos a responder preguntas concretas de negocio.
Transformar información compleja en conclusiones claras y accionables.
Evolucionar progresivamente hacia análisis estadísticos, predictivos y proyectos de mayor complejidad.




Formación académica

Buscamos candidatos con una formación cuantitativa sólida, preferiblemente en:

Matemáticas
Estadística
Matemática Aplicada
Ingeniería
Física
Econometría
Data Science
Informática con fuerte componente cuantitativo
O titulaciones similares

Además, valoraremos especialmente una especialización adicional en áreas como:

Business Intelligence
Data Analytics
Data Science
Estadística aplicada
Big Data
Analytics Engineering

Será especialmente valorable contar con un Máster en Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Science o similar.

Nos interesan especialmente perfiles que combinen una fuerte base matemática o estadística con una formación práctica en BI y análisis de datos.




Conocimientos técnicos

Buscamos una buena base, académica o práctica, en:

SQL
Python aplicado al análisis de datos
Excel avanzado
Herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau, Looker o similares
Estadística aplicada
Preparación, limpieza y transformación de datos
Visualización de datos
Modelado de datos

No es necesario tener experiencia profesional previa con todas estas herramientas, pero sí una buena base técnica y muchas ganas de desarrollarse.

Inglés

Es imprescindible un muy buen nivel de inglés hablado y escrito.

La persona debe sentirse cómoda:

Participando en reuniones profesionales en inglés.
Trabajando con equipos y proveedores internacionales.
Leyendo documentación técnica en inglés.
Explicando análisis, conclusiones y recomendaciones en inglés.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos una persona:

Muy analítica y cómoda trabajando con números.
Con fuerte capacidad matemática y lógica.
Curiosa y con interés por entender por qué suceden las cosas.
Rigurosa y atenta al detalle.
Capaz de trabajar con información compleja.
Capaz de transformar datos en conclusiones sencillas y útiles.
Interesada en comprender el negocio, no únicamente en generar reporting.
Con muchas ganas de aprender y desarrollarse rápidamente.
Proactiva y con capacidad para cuestionar los datos cuando algo no encaja.

Valoraremos especialmente

Proyectos académicos o personales relacionados con datos.
Experiencia con Pandas y NumPy.
Buen nivel de Power BI.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos.
Conocimientos básicos de Machine Learning.
Experiencia académica trabajando con grandes datasets.
Conocimientos de bases de datos.
Conocimientos de APIs o pipelines de datos.
Uso de herramientas de IA aplicadas al análisis.
Haber desarrollado dashboards o modelos analíticos en proyectos académicos o personales.

No es necesario haber trabajado anteriormente en el sector gaming.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

La oportunidad de comenzar y desarrollar tu carrera trabajando con datos reales dentro de una compañía digital en crecimiento.

No queremos que esta posición se limite a preparar informes.

Buscamos desarrollar progresivamente una persona que pueda convertirse en una referencia analítica dentro de la compañía, combinando datos, estadística, Business Intelligence y conocimiento del negocio para ayudarnos a tomar mejores decisiones.

Desde el inicio tendrás exposición a problemas reales de negocio relacionados con clientes, marketing, producto y operaciones.

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko is an AI shopping app that helps millions of users save time and money when shopping online or in-store. With Juno, our shopping assistant, they can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds.

What sets Joko’s AI apart is how well it knows its users. Its shopping recommendations feel personal from day one and get sharper the more they use it. It draws on unique assets to deliver the best experience: one of the largest product catalogs in the world, and unique shopping data no one else has to personalize every recommendation.

Users can also track the price of their favorite products and earn cash back almost everywhere. All in one free app.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 120+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with us.

Job Description

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are


State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.


🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.


Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.


👀 Who we're looking for


Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:


Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.


On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks


💸 Top-market compensation
📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
…and much more, check the full list here!


🤝 Our hiring process


Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information


Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Paris, Barcelona
Possible full remote
Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel

Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)

Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente


Experiencia


Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos

Español nativo

Puesto permanente con contrato indefinido desde el primer día.
Política de teletrabajo de hasta el 50% de la jornada mensual tras el periodo de adaptación.
Formar parte de un gran equipo de profesionales en una compañía internacional consolidada.
Obtener una visión global del sector automoción, interactuando con clientes, proveedores, consultores y concesionarios.

23 días laborables de vacaciones al año según convenio y 3 días por año completo trabajado.
Incentivos adicionales por programas de recomendación interna, formadores internos, detección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, etc.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Analyst to join our Claims Team.

This team is present for our customers when they need us most.

As a Data Analyst for our Claims Team, you will be more than just a "report generator." You will be a strategic partner, acting as the bridge between raw data and operational excellence. Your mission is to take full ownership of our claims insights to optimize the most critical moment for our customers.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


You will become a "go-to" person for the Claims team. You won't just provide data; you will interpret it, providing actionable insights and recommending specific business moves to improve efficiency.
We are looking for someone to take the lead on ETL processes. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines to ensure our claims datasets are robust, scalable, and accurate.
You will design high-impact Tableau dashboards that are both visually impeccable and highly functional. Your goal is to tell a clear story that allows stakeholders to make informed decisions at a glance.
You will collaborate closely with Pricing, Product, and Engineering to ensure a 360-degree view of the business, aligning claims performance with our overall growth strategy.
You will identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, freeing up the team to focus on high-value decision-making.


What We’re Looking For


Strong experience in data manipulation and extraction using SQL (MySQL, Redshift, or PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with building and maintaining ETL pipelines. You know how to transform raw data into structured, clean datasets.
4-5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a fast-paced environment (Consulting, Fintech, or Insurtech).
Proven track record of creating advanced models and dashboards in Tableau or similar BI tools.
Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Business Administration).
Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.


Nice-to-have


Ownership & Initiative: You don't wait for instructions; you identify gaps and propose solutions.
Communication & Influence: You can translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability: You thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing environment and can pivot your focus as business needs evolve.


Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Desarrollar y mantener dashboards y reportes que ofrezcan insights poderosos.
Analizar grandes conjuntos de datos para detectar tendencias, anomalías y oportunidades de mejora.
Colaborar con el equipo de Data Science en modelos predictivos y prescriptivos.
Realizar análisis ad hoc para responder a las preguntas de nuestros stakeholders.
Trabajar con IT para garantizar la calidad y accesibilidad de los datos.
Proponer y ejecutar mejoras en los procesos de recopilación y análisis.

¿Qué buscamos?


Formación Universitaria en Estadística, Matemáticas, Informática o estudios relacionados.
Al menos 1 año de experiencia como Data Analyst o becario/a.
Conocimientos en programación (Python, R) y análisis estadístico.
Curso o certificación en herramientas de Business Intelligence y análisis de datos.
Dominio avanzado de SQL y herramientas de BI (PowerBI o Tableau)

Formarás parte del líder mundial de reserva online de excursiones y visitas guiadas en español💃🏽.

Eventos de teambuilding 🎉 (afterworks, torneos de pádel, fútbol, tours, fiestas, concursos, etc.)
