Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


3+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At ING we are looking for a Data Analyst




Your role and work environment:




We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Data Analyst to join our Data Analyst team of Customer Interactions and Monetization Tribe.




Our mission is to enhance business performance through descriptive analytics and business diagnosis, providing insights and recommendations that facilitate better decision-making and lead to improved commercial outcomes.




We seek a dynamic and proactive individual who can engage with business areas, comprehend their needs, understand their services and products, and navigate the data ecosystem to produce precise and meaningful data-driven analyses.




We value a strong and honest team spirit, fostering an excellent and collaborative environment with business stakeholders and your fellow Data Analysts. This contributes to a robust and highly skilled data analyst community.




Your key responsibilities:




As a Data Analyst, you will:




Engage proactively with business areas to understand their business goals, financial services and products, to generate accurate data-driven business analyses and recommendations.

Analyzing product trends to increase sales conversion, reduce product attrition, improve digital funnels, and support communication campaigns. This involves identifying key performance indicators, monitoring product performance, and suggesting actionable insights to optimize sales strategies and customer experience.
Conducting customer analyses to determine customer lifetime value, customer segmentation, and forecast customer development. This includes using analytical techniques to identify patterns and trends in customer data, enabling the business to tailor its marketing and retention strategies effectively.
Supporting and advising the business on reporting needs and other analytical requirements. This entails collaborating with stakeholders to define reporting metrics, coordinate the development of comprehensive dashboards to ensure data-driven business monitoring and decision-making.




Additionally, you will collaborate closely with your Data Analyst teammates to foster a robust and highly skilled data analyst community. This involves sharing best practices, participating in knowledge-sharing sessions, and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.




What are we looking for?




Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!




Willing to assume challenges, take initiative and personal responsibility.
Desirable thinking in strategic terms. Able to recognize key information, identify business opportunities, establish connections and apply analytics for decision-making.
Willing to learn and improve your technical and your interpersonal skills.
Diven and customer-focused, always striving to understand and meet the needs of the business and its clients.
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, or other degree with strong analytical content.
Full proficiency in Excel, SAS and SQL
At least 5 years of experience in a comparable role, transforming data to extract key business insights. Experience in retail banking is highly recommended
Your communication skills enable you to work together with many different parties throughout our organization. Negotiation and stakeholder management
Fluent English will be appreciated.




What do we offer?




The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.




Check out what is waiting for you!




Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.




Meal allowance.

Receive your meal allowance in the way that best suits you: through a meal card or directly in your payroll, giving you greater flexibility and convenience in managing your everyday needs.




More than an office.

In our offices you can find doctor’s office, hairdresser, gym, Employee Concierge (to help you with your errands) and much more!




Health and life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you, including you and your immediate family.




Flexible remuneration.

Enjoy access to services such as nursery vouchers, public transport and training support, as well as other benefits through our flexible remuneration model.




Commuting made easier.

Our free shuttle service connects different areas of Madrid with ING MAD, helping make your commute to the office more comfortable and convenient.




Banking benefits.

Loans with preferential banking conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!




More vitality and more belonging

Our 360º wellbeing approach supports employees across Financial, Physical, Mental and Social Wellbeing.

On-site physiotherapy service.

A strong wellbeing culture, including Wellhub access, sports communities and activities.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.




Get to know Us




We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.




A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.




And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.




We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.




And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.




Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!




At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.




Job Application Safety Reminder




We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.

Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.

No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

Title: Técnico Senior de Analista de Datos y Movilidad
Description:
LogiRAIL, filial del Grupo Renfe, ha puesto ya en marcha 7 Centros de Competencias Digitales (CCD) para la gestión de los servicios tecnológicos de Renfe y se ha convertido en un ejemplo de negocio público riguroso y eficiente.




Su principal logro es el impulso de la igualdad de oportunidades en pequeñas y medianas poblaciones mediante la creación de puestos de trabajo cualificados y de calidad en estas zonas de baja densidad demográfica.




Actualmente buscamos un perfil de Técnico Senior de Analista de Datos y Movilidad para nuestro Centro ubicado en Madrid, Avenida Ciudad de Barcelona 8.




Algunas de tus funciones serán...




Recopilar, integrar, depurar y analizar datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes.
Diseñar y desarrollar cuadros de mando e informes ejecutivos mediante Power BI.
Construir modelos analíticos para previsión de demanda, segmentación y análisis de comportamiento.
Elaborar estudios estadísticos y análisis de mercado.
Diseñar y realizar seguimiento de KPIs operativos y comerciales.
Optimizar procesos de tratamiento y explotación de datos mediante automatización y consultas avanzadas.
Elaborar informes técnicos y presentaciones ejecutivas para clientes y dirección.
Analizar oferta, demanda y eficiencia operativa para apoyar decisiones estratégicas.
Interpretar patrones de movilidad y comportamiento de usuarios para optimizar servicios y costes.




REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS




Formación en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Ciencia de Datos, Economía o similar.
Power BI nivel experto.
Dominio avanzado de DAX y modelado de datos.
Experiencia en integración de datos desde SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, APIs, Excel y servicios cloud.
SQL avanzado sobre grandes bases de datos.
Experiencia en extracción, limpieza y transformación de datos.
Excel nivel experto (Power Query, tablas dinámicas avanzadas y modelos de datos).
Experiencia en reporting ejecutivo y presentación de resultados a dirección.
Capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados y comunicación efectiva.




REQUISITOS DESEABLES




Experiencia en análisis de datos de movilidad, transporte o smart mobility.
Conocimientos de Python y/o R.
Experiencia en procesos ETL e integración de datos.
Conocimientos de Big Data y arquitectura analítica.
Participación en proyectos de ciudades inteligentes y movilidad sostenible.
Conocimientos de técnicas estadísticas y modelos predictivos.
Experiencia en análisis de mercado y comportamiento de consumidores.




¿Cómo va a ser el proceso de selección?




Revisión de candidaturas: Nuestro equipo evaluará tu perfil según los requisitos del puesto.
Primer contacto telefónico: Validaremos tu experiencia, motivación y disponibilidad.
Entrevista por Teams: Entrevista virtual con el responsable del área para profundizar en tu perfil.
Resultados del proceso: Te informaremos sobre los siguientes pasos o te incorporaremos a nuestra bolsa de empleo para futuras oportunidades.




Beneficios:




Incorporación a un proyecto profesional estable y de larga duración, con grandes oportunidades de crecimiento.
Horario: lunes a jueves de 08:00 a 17:00 o de 09:00 a 18:00, y viernes de 08:30 a 14:00h.
Jornada de 37,5 horas semanales.
27 días laborales de vacaciones al año (25 días + 24 y 31 de diciembre).




Si te interesa y crees que puedes encajar en la posición, ¡no dudes en apuntarte!




¡No te olvides de adjuntar tu CV a nuestra base de datos! De otra manera, no se avanzará con tu candidatura.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




🎯 Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, using data to recommend customer experience optimization strategies.
Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments that support product development.
Work with Operations Program leadership to define measurement strategies for program health and operational performance.
Establish comprehensive metrics, develop clear reporting, and create regular monitoring processes.
Analyze key customer experience and operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities for deeper research.
Develop and present concise narratives from analytical findings to senior Operations leaders, highlighting problems and proposed solutions.
Support the development and maintenance of core reporting abstractions built in dbt, business intelligence reporting, and AI semantic layers.

🛠️ Requirements

At least 4 years of experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision-making.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment design.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and results to business partners clearly, concisely, and meaningfully.
Ability to independently translate stakeholder questions into clear, actionable analytical problems.
Experience building data abstractions with tools such as dbt or Airflow.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Mode, Looker, Periscope, or Tableau.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including the ability to confidently review code written by other analysts and data scientists.

➕ Nice to have

Master’s degree in a quantitative field or professional experience applying statistics.
Ability to code in Python or R.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for analytics.
Experience working with customer service datasets, such as Zendesk.
Experience with workforce forecasting.

First-year salary range in the greater Barcelona area: €47,124–€60,319.
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout.

Title: Data Analyst Support Engineer
Description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a Data Analyst has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join our Data & Analytics Team, acting as a key interface between business functions, our data ecosystem, and requested solutions. The team is multidisciplinary and focused on driving a data-driven mindset across the organization. The jobholder will reinforce our capabilities in transforming large datasets into strategic assets, collaborating closely with various departments to understand their needs, deliver actionable insights, and ensure top-tier data governance in our complex defense and space programs.

Responsibilities

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:


Perform end-to-end data processing, from gathering relevant data from various internal and external sources to cleaning and processing raw data to ensure the highest data quality.
Apply advanced statistical and analytical techniques to extract meaningful insights, draw accurate conclusions from data, and prevent biases in decision-making.
Design and deliver high-impact data visualizations, charts, and dashboards to communicate findings effectively through clear storytelling, while advising users on best practices.
Prepare and present comprehensive reports to share key insights with stakeholders and support informed, data-driven business decisions.
Manage and maintain analytical tools and software ecosystem for data analysis, ensuring data security, privacy, and full compliance with internal requirements and external regulations.
Foster a data-driven mindset by coaching business functions, collaborating with other teams, and actively sharing best practices and techniques with the wider Airbus data community.


Skills

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:


Education: Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience: Proven experience in data analysis, data preparation, and working with complex datasets.
Technical knowledge:
Strong command of statistics and probability concepts (e.g., hypothesis testing, Monte Carlo simulations, expected values, standard errors, Central Limit Theorem, confidence intervals).
Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Python/R, SQL, Tableau, PowerBI, QlikSense, or similar software).
Soft skills: Excellent communication and storytelling skills, high adaptability to work in a networking mode, coaching mindset, and ability to act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
Languages: Advanced level in English.
Valuable / Nice to have: Experience within the aerospace, defense, or industrial manufacturing sectors; knowledge of big data technologies or advanced machine learning models.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AN AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:


Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
Attractive salary.
Hybrid model of working when possible.
Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environ ment.
Option to access special rates in products & benefits.

Desde Candee estamos gestionando esta posición de Junior Data Analyst para Ufinet.

¿Qué es Ufinet?

Ufinet es un operador mayorista de telecomunicaciones. Con más de 27 años de experiencia, ha desplegado más de 130.000 km de fibra óptica con una amplia cobertura de red en las principales ciudades de 17 países, principalmente de América Latina.

Pretenden proporcionar conectividad a través de fibra óptica de la manera más flexible y ágil, siempre con un alto compromiso con sus clientes.

Con valores integrados de flexibilidad, agilidad, pasión, compromiso o proximidad, tienen la visión de ser el operador neutral de telecomunicaciones de referencia a nivel mundial.

¿Qué hace que Ufinet sea un sitio único?

Según nos ha contado el equipo de UFINET, lo mejor de trabajar aquí es:

🤝Trabajo en equipo: Un ambiente de compañerismo, respeto y apoyo mutuo. Aquí todos reman en la misma dirección, se celebran los logros juntos y se superan los retos en equipo.

🌎 Crecimiento: UFINET es una empresa en plena expansión, lo que se traduce en oportunidades constantes para evolucionar profesionalmente.

💡Aprendizaje: Oportunidad de aprender constantemente nuevas tecnologías y habilidades dando soluciones a proyectos y problemas reales.

¿Cómo será tu equipo?

Entrarás a formar parte del equipo de Software y Data, bajo el liderazgo de su Chief Data Officer. El equipo tiene una línea de Data Analysis y una línea de Data Engineering liderado por sus respectivos Team Leads y dentro de los cuáles los perfiles están especializados en las diferentes áreas de negocio.

Formarás parte del equipo de Data Analysts, quienes te acompañarán en tu desarrollo como analista de datos.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Tu misión será dar soporte al equipo de analistas de datos y aprender y colaborar con todo lo necesario para realizar una visualización y análisis efectivo de datos.


Dar soporte en la extracción, limpieza y estructuración (ETL) de datos desde diferentes fuentes.
Participar en la construcción de informes que den respuesta a necesidades del equipo corporativo con Power Bi.
Construcción de conjuntos de datos consolidados de diferentes fuentes.
Desarrollo de análisis descriptivos, analítica avanzada e implementación de modelos estadísticos.
Coordinarte con el equipo corporativo, para entender las necesidades del negocio y definir las métricas necesarias para un análisis de datos efectivo.
Colaborar con perfiles más seniors para aprender todo lo necesario para dominar la posición y crecer en la organización.


¿Qué están buscando?


Estudios en ingeniería, física o matemáticas.
Que tengas al menos una experiencia básica/intermedia laboral o en prácticas con SQL y algún lenguaje de programación como Python o Scala.
Que tengas curiosidad e interés por crecer en el mundo del dato.
Esperamos que seas una persona proactiva, flexible, con ganas de aprender y mejorar de manera continua junto con tu equipo.
Que seas una persona con buenas habilidades de comunicación, que sepa trabajar en equipo.
Permiso para trabajar en el país y dominio del español.


Valoraremos positivamente:


Que tengas experiencia con Power BI u otra herramienta de visualización de datos.
Que estés familiarizadx con la metodología Scrum y conozcas GitHub.
Te defiendas con el inglés (B2).


¿Qué ofrecen?


Modalidad híbrida de trabajo, con oficinas situadas en Paseo de la Castellana 47, Madrid.
Horario flexible: Entrada de 8h a 11h y horario de salida en consecuencia.
Mes de Agosto con Jornada Intensiva y Reducida.
Ticket Restaurant.
Seguro Médico con Adeslas.
Formación a demanda en función de tu interés/necesidades. Son una compañía abierta a sugerencias de formación, recursos y tecnología. No cuentan con restricciones en este aspecto.
Posibilidad de crecimiento profesional, donde estarás acompañado/a por un equipo técnico con ganas de compartir, enseñar y ayudarte a desarrollar todo tu potencial.


¿Cómo será tu proceso de selección?


Aplica a la vacante.
Entrevista estructurada: Si cumples los requisitos, tu Talent Partner se pondrá en contacto contigo para que puedas resolver dudas sobre la posición y para empezar a conocerte más allá de tu CV.
Caso práctico: En caso de que ambas partes consideréis que hay encaje, te enviaremos un caso práctico para que podamos verte en acción👩🏻‍💻.
Entrevista con Ufinet: Si has bordado el caso, agendaremos una entrevista con la compañía para que puedas entrevistar a tus potenciales empleadores y para que ellos puedan entrevistarte a ti.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?


Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Customer Lifecycle Analytics: Analyse onboarding, activation, retention and lifecycle campaigns, helping local teams improve customer engagement and long-term revenue quality.
Performance Marketing Analytics: Analyse paid and organic acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, audiences and markets, helping teams understand where growth is efficient and where optimisation is needed.
Experimentation & Incrementality: Support the design, measurement and interpretation of marketing experiments, including A/B tests, landing-page tests, lifecycle tests and channel tests.
Cross-functional Connectivity: Bridge insights across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, ensuring a unified view of customer acquisition, value creation and retention.


📍 Job located in Berlin or Madrid, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Growth Analytics or Revenue Analytics, ideally in a SaaS, fintech, subscription, marketplace or digital product environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with dbt (modelling, testing, and documentation).
Business & Revenue Analytics Expertise: Strong understanding of revenue metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback), customer lifecycle and funnel analytics and commercial KPI frameworks. Marketing analytics experience is a strong plus.
Analytical Breadth: Comfortable working across forecasting, LTV modelling, funnel analysis, and operational KPI frameworks.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English. German is strongly preferred for the German market scope; Spanish would be beneficial for the Spain market scope.
Nice to have: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Hightouch, Census, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Saghar (Analytics Manager) + a technical SQL assessment.

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: DATA ANALYST - EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Buscamos un Data Analyst para impulsar el desarrollo de la capa informacional del banco y aportar valor directo al negocio y a la dirección. Su misión será transformar datos - estructurados y no estructurados - en conocimiento útil que permita entender mejor el negocio, el mercado y nuestros clientes, así como identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

 

Sus responsabilidades incluyen:

 

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)

Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.
Priorización y planificación de los proyectos y peticiones recurrentes.
Gestión de expectativas, seguimiento y comunicación de resultados.

 

Realización de proyectos en los que se aborda el ciclo completo de análisis de información

Toma de requerimientos de información de negocio
Exploración de datos en Datapool y/o fuentes externas. Desde la búsqueda hasta el tratamiento de los datos hasta generar la información necesaria
Propuesta y generación de KPIs
Construcción de los informes / análisis para presentar la información
Comunicación de resultados a los clientes
Diseño, elaboración, mantenimiento y automatización los procesos para seguimientos recurrentes o peticiones puntuales.

 

Para realizar estas funciones, será necesario:

Tener conocimientos técnicos para llevar a cabo los informes que se requieran desde negocio
Tener cualidades analíticas que permitan entender la lógica de negocio y proponer nuevas ideas o estrategias que ayuden a impulsarlo
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, así como creatividad y atención a los detalles en la visualización y comunicación de información.
Requisitos mínimos
Licenciatura en carreras de ciencias o ingenierías.
Fuertes capacidades de análisis y gestión de datos, con uso de herramientas de análisis y explotación de Bases de datos: alto nivel en SQL, fluidez en Data Discovery y Análisis Estadísticos, Python, GIT, Airflow.
Formación en lenguajes de programación.
Generación de dashboards con herramientas de visualización como QlikSense, Looker, etc.
Nivel avanzado herramientas de ofimática (Excel, Power Point, etc).

 

Se valorará positivamente:

Experiencia trabajando o analizando experiencia de cliente (NPS, touchpoints, etc.)
Experiencia previa en Google Cloud o en otras plataformas cloud (AWS, etc.).
Experiencia previa en Banca en departamentos de analítica/BI.

 

Competencias Clave

 

Gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos
Gestión de proyectos de información (relación con clientes y proveedores)
Capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas
Persona resolutiva, con entusiasmo y compromiso, colaborativa
Perfil flexible, con capacidad de adaptación al cambio
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales
Orientación al negocio y a la experiencia de cliente
Definición y seguimiento de KPI’s comerciales

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Treasury
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Design, build, and maintain robust AI agentic workflows and analytical tools to automate and enhance Treasury data processes and decision-making
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


6+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience working with AI and building agentic workflows
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing


Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.


What You Will Bring To Ogury


Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.


How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:


A competitive compensation package
Comprehensive benefits coverage
Meal voucher

Title: Senior Data Analyst - B2B
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

This role is embedded within either the B2B domain and is part of Preply’s Data Chapter. You will work closely with directors, B2B leaders, and cross-functional partners across finance and product teams, while collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers to strengthen analytical foundations and business impact.

What you’ll be doing:


Partner with senior stakeholders across Business and Operations to proactively identify where new analyses, metrics, or frameworks can unlock improvements in retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.
Build and own the analytical framework leadership uses to evaluate B2B trade-offs, and define the long-term measurement framework that identifies structural growth levers, not just incremental wins.
Lead high-complexity, end-to-end analytical initiatives — including retention and cohort analyses that answer specific open questions from B2B leadership — uncovering root causes behind revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, and cost efficiency, and turning findings into concrete pricing, product, or lifecycle recommendations.
Own impact modeling, scenario analysis, and KPI governance for B2B: resolve conflicting metric definitions across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Product, maintain a single source of truth, and feed directly into quarterly and annual planning.
Design the experimentation and analytics agenda, what gets tested, how success is measured, and translate results into executive-ready storytelling that aligns stakeholders on goals and trade-offs.
Partner with Directors and VPs to shape B2B strategy, embed analytics into daily decision-making, and mentor senior analysts to raise the analytical bar.


What you need to succeed:


5+ years of experience in analytics roles (ideally in B2B), with demonstrated ownership of KPI frameworks and measurable impact on retention, revenue, or efficiency.
You can point to specific decisions (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and one where your recommendation was rejected, with the judgment to explain why, in hindsight, that was right or wrong.
You've owned a metric or strategic framework other teams were required to use, and resolved a conflict between two teams who each wanted a different definition to win.
Deep understanding of retention and performance metrics (revenue retention, LTV, churn, utilization, cost efficiency), and the ability to build an LTV or cohort model from scratch, not just interpret one someone else built.
Strong, independent SQL, you're the person other analysts send their code to for review; proven ability to lead cross-functional analytical projects end-to-end.
Strong business acumen and stakeholder influence: comfortable saying no to a request that wasn't the right question, clarifying trade-offs in metrics and resourcing, and building forecast or scenario models that leadership uses to defend a bet to their own leadership.


Nice to have:


Background in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or account-based business models; exposure to customer support operations.
Experience building or scaling an analytics function (hiring, tooling, process, KPI frameworks).
Hands-on experience with Looker, Snowflake, Tableau, or Power BI.
Working knowledge of Python for analysis.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.


Why you’ll love it at Preply:


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Sales (All Genders)
Description:
Company Description

With over 25 years’ experience, plus the same enormous passion and ambition we had on day-one, we’re trailblazers in the pet e-commerce industry. Our solutions make over 12 million customers genuinely happier – and that’s something we really care about. We work together to continually adapt; embracing change and the challenges it brings so that we can keep doing better. Join us and discover a place where your potential meets your passion for pets. That’s the power of plus.

Job Description

As a Senior Sales Analyst at zooplus, you will join our Shopping & Markets Analytics team within the Data & Analytics division acting as a strategic analytics partner for our Regional Sales and Commercial teams across Europe.

You will own a portfolio of analytical products, reporting solutions and business insights that support commercial decision-making across multiple markets and functions. Working closely with Sales, Growth / Category managers, Pricing and Leadership stakeholders, you will identify growth opportunities, challenge assumptions, drive KPI governance and provide actionable recommendations that drive business performance and support the future growth of zooplus.

Shopping & Markets Analytics mission

The Shopping & Markets Analytics team empowers product and business teams to make better decisions by transforming transactional and behavioral data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

We partner closely with stakeholders across the full commercial lifecycle, from performance analysis and opportunity identification to impact assessment and business steering. By combining business understanding with advanced analytics, we help teams unlock growth opportunities, accelerate decision-making and foster a strong data-driven culture across zooplus.

Key Responsibilities


Act as a strategic analytics partner for Regional Sales stakeholders across Europe, supporting data-driven decision-making and business growth.
Identify commercial opportunities and performance drivers through in-depth analysis of sales, pricing, promotions, customer behavior and market trends.
Own and continuously improve dashboards, reporting solutions and KPI frameworks that support business steering and performance monitoring.
Design and maintain scalable analytical datasets and data marts, ensuring reliable and efficient access to business insights.
Lead complex analytical projects in collaboration with cross-functional teams including Sales, Pricing, CRM, Category Management and Data Science.
Leverage AI, automation and modern analytics tools to improve analytical efficiency and enable self-service analytics.
Communicate insights and recommendations effectively to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Promote a data-driven culture by helping stakeholders understand, access and act on data.


Qualifications

Skills and experience:


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, Computer Science or a related analytical field.
5+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence or Commercial analytics roles, preferably within e-commerce, retail or digital businesses.
Advanced SQL expertise, including large-scale data analysis, query optimization and development of analytical datasets.
Strong experience with Tableau, Power BI or similar BI and data visualization tools.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of sales, pricing, promotions, customer behavior and e-commerce performance metrics.
Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations and influence stakeholder decisions.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior business stakeholders.
Experience working with cloud-based analytics environments and modern data platforms.
Proactive, business-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Strong prioritization skills and the ability to adapt quickly to evolving business needs and stakeholder priorities.


Nice to Have


Experience working with digital behavioral or event-based data and translating customer interactions into actionable business insights.
Experience with Python or R for analytics, automation or modelling.
Experience building self-service analytics solutions and scalable reporting frameworks.
Experience with forecasting, experimentation or other advanced analytical methodologies.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled analytics tools to improve analytical efficiency and business decision-making.
Experience leading cross-functional analytics initiatives or mentoring other analysts.


Additional Information

Headquartered in Munich, with offices across Madrid, Krakow, Wroclaw, London and Vienna, we collaborate because we genuinely love working together - so you’ll be at the heart of an incredible, multinational team. We trust each other to get the job done, which means you’ll benefit from hybrid working, spending 60% of your time in the office and 40% at home. There’s an option to work for 20 days abroad in approved countries too.

Add to that development opportunities that help you to shape your own career path, excellent training and support, wellbeing offers, subsidised transport or bike leasing, plus 20% discount across all our products, and you’ll begin to get a sense of what sets us apart. Find out more about the specific benefits at your local office in our blog posts.

A note on compensation: We believe in being transparent about salary ranges. The range shown reflects the full scope that the role can grow into over time, depending on experience, skills, and impact. Most offers are positioned around the midpoint of the range, ensuring a fair and consistent approach across our teams.

At zooplus, we believe in equal opportunity and support everyone to fulfil their potential. We recognise the power of listening and learning from each other and embrace diversity and inclusion of all.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;


At BESTSECRET, diversity isn't just a trend – it's our professional philosophy. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace where everyone's unique talents and backgrounds are celebrated. Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

Con más de 100 hoteles en 23 países y 70 años de excelencia en el sector hotelero, RIU Hotels & Resorts es un líder mundial reconocido por su servicio excepcional, innovación y hospitalidad.

Únete a nosotros mientras seguimos redefiniendo el lujo y la excelencia. Ya sea desarrollando tu carrera profesional, explorando nuevos horizontes o trabajando con un equipo dinámico e inclusivo, RIU Hotels & Resorts te ofrece oportunidades inigualables para continuar creciendo.




Ejecutivo/a de Revenue




Descripción del empleo




¿Te interesaría participar en un plan de carrera internacional con nosotros?

Monitorear y analizar indicadores clave de desempeño como tasa de ocupación, pickup y pace. Proponer y ejecutar acciones sobre de venta de acuerdo a los indicadores analizados.

Title: Data Analyst - BigQuery
Description:
¡En Ayesa Digital crecemos Contigo!




Cada profesional de nuestra empresa es importante para nosotros, nos ayudan a crecer de manera diversa y gracias a ellos somos más de 11.000 personas trabajando con el mismo objetivo internacionalmente.




Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!




Buscamos ampliar nuestro equipo con un/a Data Analyst / BI Consultant, para participar en proyectos de analítica de datos, reporting y evolución del ecosistema analítico corporativo. La persona seleccionada trabajará en modalidad de teletrabajo híbrido en Madrid.




¡Anímate a dar el salto! ¡Te estamos esperando!




¿Qué vas a hacer?

Actuar como referente analítico y nexo entre las áreas de Negocio y Tecnología.
Gestionar la transformación, modelado y explotación de datos, garantizando la calidad y disponibilidad de la información para la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos orientados a negocio.
Definir, documentar y evolucionar KPIs, métricas e indicadores de gestión.
Desarrollar lógica de negocio mediante DAX y modelos semánticos.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes en Power BI.
Construir visualizaciones que faciliten el análisis y la toma de decisiones de las distintas áreas de negocio.
Asegurar la correcta integración y explotación de datos entre BigQuery y Power BI.
Recopilar, analizar y documentar requisitos funcionales de las áreas usuarias.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas y de reporting.
Participar en la migración de procesos y modelos actualmente desarrollados en SAS hacia tecnologías Google Cloud y Microsoft.
Colaborar en la evolución de la arquitectura analítica y en la mejora continua de herramientas, procesos y modelos de datos.
Establecer mecanismos de control y seguimiento de la calidad del dato.
Identificar incidencias, inconsistencias y riesgos asociados a la información.
Gestionar iniciativas analíticas, coordinando diferentes equipos y asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos y entregables.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia como Data Analyst, BI Consultant o en posiciones similares relacionadas con Business Intelligence y Analítica de Datos.
Dominio avanzado de SQL.
Experiencia trabajando con BigQuery.
Conocimientos sólidos de Power BI, diseño de informes y cuadros de mando.
Experiencia desarrollando modelos semánticos y cálculos mediante DAX.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos y procesos ETL/ELT.
Capacidad para analizar necesidades funcionales y transformarlas en soluciones analíticas.
Experiencia actuando como interlocutor/a entre negocio y equipos técnicos.
Orientación a la calidad del dato y a la mejora continua.
Capacidad de organización, gestión de prioridades y trabajo en entornos dinámicos.
Valorable experiencia en proyectos de migración desde SAS hacia entornos Google Cloud o Microsoft.




Te Ofrecemos Un Camino Lleno De Aventuras




¡Llega hasta donde tú quieras! ¡Crece con nuestros programas de desarrollo! Te ayudaremos a marcar tu itinerario de futuro anualmente participando en proyectos vanguardistas con los mejores profesionales del sector.




Porque lo importante sois tú y los tuyos : contamos con políticas que facilitan la conciliación entre la vida profesional y personal: Flexibilidad horaria, Smart Job y jornada intensiva en verano.

Tú decides cómo usar tu dinero: disfruta de nuestra retribución flexible, contamos con: Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurant, Guardería y Transporte.

Plan Bienestar descuentos en viajes, tecnología, formación, deporte, belleza y ¡muchos más!

Diviértete participando en los diferentes concursos y actividades que organizamos: ¿te gusta el deporte, escribir, la fotografía? Todo tiene cabida.

¡Deja tu huella! Impacta con nuestros proyectos de voluntariado social.
