Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Summary



ABOUT US



We are an international pharmaceutical company committed to the veterinary profession, with a constantly growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products and diets. Our focus is on veterinarians, whom we approach with compelling solutions designed to make us their trusted partner.

Dechra is one of the fastest-growing and most consistently successful global veterinary companies. Our size enables us to maintain a personal approach, remain flexible and respond quickly to change, allowing us to make decisions with agility.

At the same time, we are a strong and well-established company, with the product portfolio and technical capabilities needed to provide our customers with the support they need.

OUR PEOPLE

Are solution oriented and pro-active
Love working together
Have a 'can do' mentality
Are easy to approach
Value honesty
Are professional
Are able to punch above their weight
Have the desire to win
Have fun

YOU WILL FIT IN

If you have strong analytic and problem-solving skills
If you are able to understand the business and deliver based on a strong commercial focus
If you are self-motivated and highly organized
If you are responsive and flexible to change
If you are cooperative and have the desire to make a difference together
If you are structured and independent

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a key role at Dechra in Iberia as the company is growing fast and data analysis is gaining importance to support business decisions and improvements.

The Data Analyst is ultimately responsible for making available and clear all data necessary to contribute to translate the strategy and plans into clear reports by using relevant data. The tasks and responsabilities include:

Analysis of sell in and sell out data across all the business areas.
Management of the source master data (customer and product) ensuring the reliability and veracity of data.
Validating development requests from the business allowingreports improvement and upgrades.
Management of the CRM data and reports (maintenance and update).
Preparation of periodic and ad hoc reports to analyse comercial stategies.
Collection and consolidation of data from different sources (mainly Excel and SQL Server).
Process documentation.
Involvement in budgeting and forecasting process.
Evaluation and process of the data to facilitate the decision taking from sales, marketing and business managers.
Develop strong internal relationship with the sales team to understand the market and support them.
Ensure the connection between CRM and marketing.
Providing user support services to ensure problems are remediated quickly and effectively.
Providing training (Targit, Salesforce, BI software) for new users and new functionality for existing users.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

This job might be for you when you have:

A higher education or degree within the area of Computer science, Economics, Finance, or related bachelor degree.
Experience of Business Intelligence systems.
Ideally a minimum of 2/3 years' experience in a similar position.
Basic programming skills for data manipulation.
Ability to develop key and beneficial relationships with stakeholders.
Excellent commercial networking approach to enable the growth of the business.
Ability to structure and organize effectively and deliver to tight deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
Natural leadership skills to lead high performing teams.
High level of Excel use.
Knowlegde of SQL/Power BI/Targit/ Salesforce.
Ideally based in Barcelona.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Spanish Fluent (verbal and written)

English Fluent English

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: Experienced Data Analyst - Digital Sales (m/f/d)
Description:
Your Tasks

This position is part of the Digital Sales Data Foundation team, which drives data-driven decision making across our digital platforms by analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and measuring the impact of strategic initiatives with a strong focus on A/B testing to enhance customer experience and business performance. You will work closely with other Data Analysts, Data Engineers, a dedicated Product Owner, and colleagues from global and local business departments.

Your tasks:


Partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve analytics, tracking, and experimentation initiatives across digital areas.
Design, optimize, and document scalable tracking and measurement concepts, ensuring data quality, consistency, and usability for reporting, analysis, experimentation, and third-party integrations.
Define relevant KPIs, build dashboards, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support product optimization and data-driven decision-making.
Support and improve experimentation processes, including A/B test design, sample size planning, KPI alignment, analysis methodology, result interpretation, and rollout recommendations.
Contribute to scalable experimentation practices, tooling, automation, and knowledge management to support a growing number of experiments across markets, platforms, and product areas.
Work hands-on with complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud environments, and analytics tools, while collaborating closely with developers and data teams.
Act as a trusted sparring partner for stakeholders, working independently or within cross-functional teams, and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and continuous improvement.


Your Profile


Several years of experience in digital analytics, conversion analysis, product analytics, experimentation, or a similar data-focused role, ideally in an e-commerce or digital product environment.
Strong understanding of tracking concepts, KPI frameworks, data quality, reporting, and analytics tools such as Google Data Studio, Adobe Analytics, Firebase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong experience with A/B testing or experimentation methodologies, including test setup, sample size considerations, KPI definition, statistical evaluation, interpretation of results, and communication of conclusions.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL, complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud or data warehouse technologies such as Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, or similar solutions.
Experience working with developers and technical teams, including documentation of requirements, tracking concepts, data flows, and implementation logic.
Familiarity with modern collaboration and productivity tools such as GitHub, GitHub Copilot, AI agents, reusable skills/workflows, or similar tools.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions and explain complex topics clearly.
High level of ownership, self-organization, curiosity, and ability to work both independently and as part of technical and cross-functional teams.


About Us

MediaMarktSaturn is Europe’s leading consumer electronics retailer. It sees itself as a partner, daily companion and navigator for its customers in the digital world. Its over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores are closely integrated with their online shops. MediaMarktSaturn has a total headcount of more than 60,000.

MediaMarktSaturn Technology is working on making Europe's number one consumer electronics retailer the technology leader in its sector. To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 11 countries.

Technology Hub located in Barcelona, is one of the service units of MediaMarktSaturn Technology to deliver adequate staffing and engineering skills for the agreed deliveries of the global deployment plan for the entire group.

(*) Diversity and equal opportunities are important to us. Research shows that women and people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. If you are interested in this position but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Additional Benefits


Young environment, where not everything is written in stone, and where you are expected to contribute and co-create the culture of the Tech Hub and international collaboration model
You'll have a 10% discount on the entire MediaMarkt website, so you can treat yourself at a lower price whenever you want!
On top of your compensation package, you can request Flexible Pay “MediaFlex program” (a.e. Ticket Restaurant, Private Health Insurance with Adeslas, …)
Flexible working time and possibility to combine home office / presential working. Intensive workday every Friday and during summer
The possibility to choose between 2 offices: The first one is the MediaMarkt Spain HQ with a very attractive menu at a price. You'll eat for less than €4! And the second office is located at Pier01, in Barceloneta, right in the center of Barcelona.
There is a training budget so you can continue developing the skills you need most to keep growing professionally and personally!
We offer language classes: English, Spanish, and German
On your birthday, you won't work! It's a day for you to enjoy without thinking about work
You'll be working with the most cutting-edge technological stack of the moment

Title: Data Analyst (with focus on AI)
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Role purpose

We are looking to add to the Analytics team a profile 100% focused on data analysis and business impact, with a strong sensitivity towards the world of applied Artificial Intelligence, capable of transforming complex data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement, and clearly communicating conclusions in an executive manner to different stakeholders.

We are not looking for a purely academic or AI research profile, but for someone who knows how to use AI as a lever to elevate analysis quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze large volumes of data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities with direct business impact.
Generate actionable insights by connecting technical metrics with business KPIs and strategic objectives.
Apply AI / advanced analytics techniques (predictive models, clustering, analysis automation, insight generation, etc.) with a practical, results-oriented approach.
Drive continuous improvement by proposing hypotheses, tests, and data-driven recommendations.
Design and create executive presentations (slides, dashboards, one-pagers) for committees and senior stakeholders, with clear, structured, and decision-oriented messaging.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (product, technology, operations, business), acting as a bridge between data and decision-making.
Explore and propose new use cases of AI applied to data analysis, maintaining a pragmatic innovation mindset.




Profile we are looking for

Degree in quantitative fields: Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar.
Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation of business KPIs.
Knowledge and practical experience with analytics tools (SQL, Python, Power BI / Tableau or similar).
Interest and experience in applying AI techniques and advanced models, always with a business focus (not an academic profile).
High ability to synthesize complex information and convert it into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Experience creating executive presentations and presenting conclusions to senior stakeholders.
Continuous improvement mindset, critical thinking, and impact orientation.
Strong communication skills, autonomy, and an end-to-end vision of data.
Fluent in English and Spanish (C1+), with experience working in international and cross-functional environments




Nice to have

Experience using AI to automate analysis, generate insights, or improve analytical efficiency.
Knowledge of cloud environments, large-scale data management, or analytical pipelines.
Previous experience in product, operations, or business environments.
Ability to prioritize and focus analysis on what truly drives impact.




What We Offer

A role with real impact on business decisions.
An environment where AI is applied in a practical, not experimental, way.
Direct participation in decision-making forums and strategic projects.
A highly skilled team with a collaborative mindset.
Opportunity to grow at the intersection of data, AI, and business.







Strong fit with our Company DNA

Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people bring a contagious energy and a sense of urgency that is unmistakable. We create a vision and inspire others around that vision with full engagement and focus. We are all-in, and we love what we do.

Committed to Making a Difference: We are courageous, we deliver what we promise through hard work and resilience. We make a difference, through operating with discipline and doing what is needed. We are hands-on, and we aren’t afraid to get into the detail. We deliver results and we execute with excellence.

Always Innovating: Our people make the impossible possible; it’s a continuous state of mind. We are purpose-driven, curious and we challenge the status quo. We believe good ideas travel, we share and reapply. We take smart risks, and we are not afraid to fail. We believe innovation can be big or small.

Winning as a Team: We are determined to become number 1, and to do that we need to listen to one another, collaborate and work together. We play our part, fueled by a winning attitude and a fighting spirit. We celebrate our successes. We play to our strengths and our diversity to deliver even better outcomes, while developing and supporting one another. We believe that together we go further, and that nothing is impossible.

With Trust & Responsibility: Our people take responsibility for the people we protect. We are accountable and reliable. We role model operating with integrity. We trust and empower one another to do the right thing, always. We deliver on our promise through world-class expertise and meticulous know-how. And, we do this with humility while being honoured to play such an important role in society.




At Verisure, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognising that diversity of thought and background only makes our teams stronger and more innovative. We reject all forms of discrimination and bias, and we believe in access to opportunities for everyone, regardless of gender, age, disability status, race, sexual orientation, or any other status.

We review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position once we find the right candidate. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.




Feel free to get in touch with me at enrique.barajasluque@verisure.es. I’d be happy to tell you more about the role and Verisure!

Title: Técnico Senior de Analista de Datos y Movilidad
Description:
LogiRAIL, filial del Grupo Renfe, ha puesto ya en marcha 7 Centros de Competencias Digitales (CCD) para la gestión de los servicios tecnológicos de Renfe y se ha convertido en un ejemplo de negocio público riguroso y eficiente.




Su principal logro es el impulso de la igualdad de oportunidades en pequeñas y medianas poblaciones mediante la creación de puestos de trabajo cualificados y de calidad en estas zonas de baja densidad demográfica.




Actualmente buscamos un perfil de Técnico Senior de Analista de Datos y Movilidad para nuestro Centro ubicado en Madrid, Avenida Ciudad de Barcelona 8.




Algunas de tus funciones serán...




Recopilar, integrar, depurar y analizar datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes.
Diseñar y desarrollar cuadros de mando e informes ejecutivos mediante Power BI.
Construir modelos analíticos para previsión de demanda, segmentación y análisis de comportamiento.
Elaborar estudios estadísticos y análisis de mercado.
Diseñar y realizar seguimiento de KPIs operativos y comerciales.
Optimizar procesos de tratamiento y explotación de datos mediante automatización y consultas avanzadas.
Elaborar informes técnicos y presentaciones ejecutivas para clientes y dirección.
Analizar oferta, demanda y eficiencia operativa para apoyar decisiones estratégicas.
Interpretar patrones de movilidad y comportamiento de usuarios para optimizar servicios y costes.




REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS




Formación en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Ciencia de Datos, Economía o similar.
Power BI nivel experto.
Dominio avanzado de DAX y modelado de datos.
Experiencia en integración de datos desde SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, APIs, Excel y servicios cloud.
SQL avanzado sobre grandes bases de datos.
Experiencia en extracción, limpieza y transformación de datos.
Excel nivel experto (Power Query, tablas dinámicas avanzadas y modelos de datos).
Experiencia en reporting ejecutivo y presentación de resultados a dirección.
Capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados y comunicación efectiva.




REQUISITOS DESEABLES




Experiencia en análisis de datos de movilidad, transporte o smart mobility.
Conocimientos de Python y/o R.
Experiencia en procesos ETL e integración de datos.
Conocimientos de Big Data y arquitectura analítica.
Participación en proyectos de ciudades inteligentes y movilidad sostenible.
Conocimientos de técnicas estadísticas y modelos predictivos.
Experiencia en análisis de mercado y comportamiento de consumidores.




¿Cómo va a ser el proceso de selección?




Revisión de candidaturas: Nuestro equipo evaluará tu perfil según los requisitos del puesto.
Primer contacto telefónico: Validaremos tu experiencia, motivación y disponibilidad.
Entrevista por Teams: Entrevista virtual con el responsable del área para profundizar en tu perfil.
Resultados del proceso: Te informaremos sobre los siguientes pasos o te incorporaremos a nuestra bolsa de empleo para futuras oportunidades.




Beneficios:




Incorporación a un proyecto profesional estable y de larga duración, con grandes oportunidades de crecimiento.
Horario: lunes a jueves de 08:00 a 17:00 o de 09:00 a 18:00, y viernes de 08:30 a 14:00h.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




🎯 Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, using data to recommend customer experience optimization strategies.
Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments that support product development.
Work with Operations Program leadership to define measurement strategies for program health and operational performance.
Establish comprehensive metrics, develop clear reporting, and create regular monitoring processes.
Analyze key customer experience and operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities for deeper research.
Develop and present concise narratives from analytical findings to senior Operations leaders, highlighting problems and proposed solutions.
Support the development and maintenance of core reporting abstractions built in dbt, business intelligence reporting, and AI semantic layers.

🛠️ Requirements

At least 4 years of experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision-making.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment design.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and results to business partners clearly, concisely, and meaningfully.
Ability to independently translate stakeholder questions into clear, actionable analytical problems.
Experience building data abstractions with tools such as dbt or Airflow.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Mode, Looker, Periscope, or Tableau.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including the ability to confidently review code written by other analysts and data scientists.

➕ Nice to have

Master’s degree in a quantitative field or professional experience applying statistics.
Ability to code in Python or R.
Hands-on experience using AI tools for analytics.
Experience working with customer service datasets, such as Zendesk.
Experience with workforce forecasting.

💰 Compensation

First-year salary range in the greater Barcelona area: €47,124–€60,319.
Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout.
Benefits are available to full-time employees.
Cash compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities demonstrated throughout the interview and hiring process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: Junior Data Analyst en Ufinet 🌎
Description:
Modalidad: Híbrida

Localización: Madrid

Desde Candee estamos gestionando esta posición de Junior Data Analyst para Ufinet.

¿Qué es Ufinet?

Ufinet es un operador mayorista de telecomunicaciones. Con más de 27 años de experiencia, ha desplegado más de 130.000 km de fibra óptica con una amplia cobertura de red en las principales ciudades de 17 países, principalmente de América Latina.

Pretenden proporcionar conectividad a través de fibra óptica de la manera más flexible y ágil, siempre con un alto compromiso con sus clientes.

Con valores integrados de flexibilidad, agilidad, pasión, compromiso o proximidad, tienen la visión de ser el operador neutral de telecomunicaciones de referencia a nivel mundial.

¿Qué hace que Ufinet sea un sitio único?

Según nos ha contado el equipo de UFINET, lo mejor de trabajar aquí es:

🤝Trabajo en equipo: Un ambiente de compañerismo, respeto y apoyo mutuo. Aquí todos reman en la misma dirección, se celebran los logros juntos y se superan los retos en equipo.

🌎 Crecimiento: UFINET es una empresa en plena expansión, lo que se traduce en oportunidades constantes para evolucionar profesionalmente.

💡Aprendizaje: Oportunidad de aprender constantemente nuevas tecnologías y habilidades dando soluciones a proyectos y problemas reales.

¿Cómo será tu equipo?

Entrarás a formar parte del equipo de Software y Data, bajo el liderazgo de su Chief Data Officer. El equipo tiene una línea de Data Analysis y una línea de Data Engineering liderado por sus respectivos Team Leads y dentro de los cuáles los perfiles están especializados en las diferentes áreas de negocio.

Formarás parte del equipo de Data Analysts, quienes te acompañarán en tu desarrollo como analista de datos.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Tu misión será dar soporte al equipo de analistas de datos y aprender y colaborar con todo lo necesario para realizar una visualización y análisis efectivo de datos.


Dar soporte en la extracción, limpieza y estructuración (ETL) de datos desde diferentes fuentes.
Participar en la construcción de informes que den respuesta a necesidades del equipo corporativo con Power Bi.
Construcción de conjuntos de datos consolidados de diferentes fuentes.
Desarrollo de análisis descriptivos, analítica avanzada e implementación de modelos estadísticos.
Coordinarte con el equipo corporativo, para entender las necesidades del negocio y definir las métricas necesarias para un análisis de datos efectivo.
Colaborar con perfiles más seniors para aprender todo lo necesario para dominar la posición y crecer en la organización.


¿Qué están buscando?


Estudios en ingeniería, física o matemáticas.
Que tengas al menos una experiencia básica/intermedia laboral o en prácticas con SQL y algún lenguaje de programación como Python o Scala.
Que tengas curiosidad e interés por crecer en el mundo del dato.
Esperamos que seas una persona proactiva, flexible, con ganas de aprender y mejorar de manera continua junto con tu equipo.
Que seas una persona con buenas habilidades de comunicación, que sepa trabajar en equipo.
Permiso para trabajar en el país y dominio del español.


Valoraremos positivamente:


Que tengas experiencia con Power BI u otra herramienta de visualización de datos.
Que estés familiarizadx con la metodología Scrum y conozcas GitHub.
Te defiendas con el inglés (B2).


¿Qué ofrecen?


Modalidad híbrida de trabajo, con oficinas situadas en Paseo de la Castellana 47, Madrid.
Horario flexible: Entrada de 8h a 11h y horario de salida en consecuencia.
Mes de Agosto con Jornada Intensiva y Reducida.
Ticket Restaurant.
Seguro Médico con Adeslas.
Formación a demanda en función de tu interés/necesidades. Son una compañía abierta a sugerencias de formación, recursos y tecnología. No cuentan con restricciones en este aspecto.
Posibilidad de crecimiento profesional, donde estarás acompañado/a por un equipo técnico con ganas de compartir, enseñar y ayudarte a desarrollar todo tu potencial.


¿Cómo será tu proceso de selección?


Aplica a la vacante.
Entrevista estructurada: Si cumples los requisitos, tu Talent Partner se pondrá en contacto contigo para que puedas resolver dudas sobre la posición y para empezar a conocerte más allá de tu CV.
Caso práctico: En caso de que ambas partes consideréis que hay encaje, te enviaremos un caso práctico para que podamos verte en acción👩🏻‍💻.
Entrevista con Ufinet: Si has bordado el caso, agendaremos una entrevista con la compañía para que puedas entrevistar a tus potenciales empleadores y para que ellos puedan entrevistarte a ti.


Durante todo el proceso tendrás contacto directo con tu Talent Agent para poder resolver cualquier duda o inquietud.

Si has llegado hasta aquí, puedes ser la persona que buscamos. ¡Conectemos!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?


Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Customer Lifecycle Analytics: Analyse onboarding, activation, retention and lifecycle campaigns, helping local teams improve customer engagement and long-term revenue quality.
Performance Marketing Analytics: Analyse paid and organic acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, audiences and markets, helping teams understand where growth is efficient and where optimisation is needed.
Experimentation & Incrementality: Support the design, measurement and interpretation of marketing experiments, including A/B tests, landing-page tests, lifecycle tests and channel tests.
Cross-functional Connectivity: Bridge insights across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, ensuring a unified view of customer acquisition, value creation and retention.


📍 Job located in Berlin or Madrid, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Growth Analytics or Revenue Analytics, ideally in a SaaS, fintech, subscription, marketplace or digital product environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with dbt (modelling, testing, and documentation).
Business & Revenue Analytics Expertise: Strong understanding of revenue metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback), customer lifecycle and funnel analytics and commercial KPI frameworks. Marketing analytics experience is a strong plus.
Analytical Breadth: Comfortable working across forecasting, LTV modelling, funnel analysis, and operational KPI frameworks.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English. German is strongly preferred for the German market scope; Spanish would be beneficial for the Spain market scope.
Nice to have: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Hightouch, Census, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Saghar (Analytics Manager) + a technical SQL assessment.

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Summary



ABOUT US



We are an international pharmaceutical company committed to the veterinary profession, with a constantly growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products and diets. Our focus is on veterinarians, whom we approach with compelling solutions designed to make us their trusted partner.

Dechra is one of the fastest-growing and most consistently successful global veterinary companies. Our size enables us to maintain a personal approach, remain flexible and respond quickly to change, allowing us to make decisions with agility.

At the same time, we are a strong and well-established company, with the product portfolio and technical capabilities needed to provide our customers with the support they need.

OUR PEOPLE

Are solution oriented and pro-active
Love working together
Have a 'can do' mentality
Are easy to approach
Value honesty
Are professional
Are able to punch above their weight
Have the desire to win
Have fun

YOU WILL FIT IN

If you have strong analytic and problem-solving skills
If you are able to understand the business and deliver based on a strong commercial focus
If you are self-motivated and highly organized
If you are responsive and flexible to change
If you are cooperative and have the desire to make a difference together
If you are structured and independent

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a key role at Dechra in Iberia as the company is growing fast and data analysis is gaining importance to support business decisions and improvements.

The Data Analyst is ultimately responsible for making available and clear all data necessary to contribute to translate the strategy and plans into clear reports by using relevant data. The tasks and responsabilities include:

Analysis of sell in and sell out data across all the business areas.
Management of the source master data (customer and product) ensuring the reliability and veracity of data.
Validating development requests from the business allowingreports improvement and upgrades.
Management of the CRM data and reports (maintenance and update).
Preparation of periodic and ad hoc reports to analyse comercial stategies.
Collection and consolidation of data from different sources (mainly Excel and SQL Server).
Process documentation.
Involvement in budgeting and forecasting process.
Evaluation and process of the data to facilitate the decision taking from sales, marketing and business managers.
Develop strong internal relationship with the sales team to understand the market and support them.
Ensure the connection between CRM and marketing.
Providing user support services to ensure problems are remediated quickly and effectively.
Providing training (Targit, Salesforce, BI software) for new users and new functionality for existing users.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

This job might be for you when you have:

A higher education or degree within the area of Computer science, Economics, Finance, or related bachelor degree.
Experience of Business Intelligence systems.
Ideally a minimum of 2/3 years' experience in a similar position.
Basic programming skills for data manipulation.
Ability to develop key and beneficial relationships with stakeholders.
Excellent commercial networking approach to enable the growth of the business.
Ability to structure and organize effectively and deliver to tight deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
Natural leadership skills to lead high performing teams.
High level of Excel use.
Knowlegde of SQL/Power BI/Targit/ Salesforce.
Ideally based in Barcelona.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Spanish Fluent (verbal and written)

English Fluent English

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Sobre Twenix

La vida no es listen and repeat. Y el trabajo tampoco.

En Twenix creemos que aprender un idioma no va de memorizar reglas, sino de atreverse a hablar cuando importa: en una reunión, una presentación o una negociación real.

Somos una EdTech B2B que transforma la formación corporativa en idiomas con un enfoque simple, personalized and fun: conversaciones online de 26 minutos pensadas para profesionales que quieren comunicarse con confianza en su día a día y para empresas que no quieren gastar energía en la misma formación de siempre.

Nuestra misión: que la formación en idiomas deje de ser un gasto y se convierta en impacto real para empresas y profesionales. Desde 2017 en inglés y ahora, también en español, francés y portugués.




🎯 Este es tu reto

En Twenix damos servicio a más de 1500 clientes y en 2026 tenemos previsto dar 860.000 clases. Somos una de las scaleups que más crece de España según Deloitte, y en los últimos años hemos multiplicado nuestra facturación x5 y hemos añadido 5 nuevos idiomas a nuestra plataforma. Ahora, buscamos un Data Analyst que nos ayude a liderar el análisis de datos complejos para identificar tendencias, generar insights accionables y apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Impulsarás una cultura data-driven en Twenix, colaborando con Ventas, Producto, Marketing, Operaciones y Finanzas, y reportando al Director de Data.




🧩 Lo que harás:

Liderar proyectos de análisis de datos de principio a fin: desde entender el reto de negocio hasta presentar conclusiones y recomendaciones accionables.
Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos para identificar tendencias, oportunidades y palancas de crecimiento, convirtiendo los datos en decisiones que mejoren la eficiencia de Twenix.
Trabajar de forma cercana con equipos de Ventas, Marketing, Producto, Operaciones y Finanzas, entendiendo sus necesidades y diseñando soluciones analíticas que generen impacto.
Garantizar la calidad, integridad y fiabilidad de los datos, detectando y resolviendo posibles problemas.
Comunicar insights de forma clara a diferentes stakeholders, utilizando storytelling y visualizaciones que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y resultados para asegurar un trabajo transparente y reproducible.
Estar al día de nuevas herramientas y tendencias en Data & Analytics, incorporándolas cuando aporten valor.




🔎 Lo que buscamos

Formación en un área cuantitativa: Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Economía, ADE o similar.
3+ años de experiencia en Data Analytics, BI o posiciones similares, idealmente en entornos internacionales.
Experiencia entendiendo procesos de negocio y transformando el análisis en recomendaciones y planes de acción para mejorar procesos y eficiencia.
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y plataformas cloud como GCP, AWS o Azure, así como con procesos ETL/ELT (valorable experiencia con Dataform).
Dominio de SQL y experiencia con herramientas de programación para análisis de datos (Python o R).
Experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Looker, Looker Studio o Tableau.
Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles y gestión de proyectos.
Experiencia previa en startups o entornos de rápido crecimiento.
AI First con aplicación práctica en el entorno de data (Claude, Gemini, Chatgpt)




🤘Nice to have

Una persona curiosa, analítica y orientada a resolver problemas, capaz de ir más allá del dato para encontrar la causa raíz.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y storytelling, tanto en español como en inglés.
Proactividad, autonomía y capacidad para priorizar y avanzar en un entorno dinámico.
Mentalidad de mejora continua y ganas de cuestionar lo establecido y probar nuevas formas de hacer las cosas.
Capacidad para trabajar con diferentes equipos y stakeholders, adaptándose a distintas necesidades.
Experiencia en análisis estadístico será un plus.




🎁 Lo que te ofrecemos

Formato 100% remoto o híbrido si estás en Madrid o Almería.
Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes, verano y Navidad.
26 días laborables de vacaciones 🌴
Día libre en tu cumple 🎉 (sí, nos gusta celebrarlo contigo).
3 días al año para asistir a eventos o formaciones de tu sector. 📝
Clases de idiomas ilimitadas con nuestra propia metodología Twenix. 📖
Plan de bienestar para invertir en tu desarrollo, salud y formación. 🩺
Retribución flexible con Cobee (comida, transporte, formación) y Alan (seguro de salud). 💶
Plataforma de descuentos exclusivos por ser empleados de Twenix.
Excelente clima laboral: compromiso, cercanía y trabajo en equipo. 🍀
Y por supuesto, ¡eventos anuales de team building para disfrutar en compañía! 🤼




💙 Nuestros valores

Foco en lo importante: Buscamos impacto real. Priorizamos lo que aporta valor al negocio, a los clientes y al equipo, y evitamos el ruido, el postureo y el trabajo porque sí.
Crecemos juntos: Creemos en la colaboración, la confianza y la responsabilidad compartida. Aquí se trabaja y se construye en equipo.
Hacer que las cosas pasen: Nos gusta hacer las cosas bien y mejorar constantemente. Somos ambiciosos, aprendemos rápido de los errores y no nos conformamos con el mínimo.
Ideas antes que egos: Fomentamos las conversaciones honestas, el feedback directo y el pensamiento crítico, siempre desde la humildad y las ganas de aprender.




Para la promoción de la igualdad, en nuestra empresa adoptamos la siguiente medida: En igualdad de oportunidades accederá al puesto de promoción la candidata o el candidato del sexo infrarrepresentado, para el puesto donde se ha producido la vacante.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Conetic is an innovative global company dedicated to transforming the flying experience by making the passenger journey engaging and truly memorable.

We specialize in comprehensive media services, with a focus on creating more personalized and engaging experiences for travelers at every step of the journey.

By uniting Touch Inflight Solutions and ABOVE, Conetic brings together a leading IFE content service provider and a robust cloud-based media distribution platform. This combination of curated content, data-driven personalization, and an automated cloud media supply chain enables airlines to deliver fresh, personalized content to passengers faster and more efficiently through a seamless, end-to-end solution.

About the role:

As our Data Analyst, you will provide essential support to the Digital Products & Innovation department by performing a variety of data analysis tasks, such as organizing large amounts of data, defining trends and patterns, as well as supporting data architects on other projects.

About the responsibilities:


Conduct complex data analysis and report on results;
Interpret trends and patterns
Evaluate business needs and objectives
Analyze and organize raw information from different sources
Build data systems, pipelines, algorithms and prototypes
Develop analytical tools and programs
Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability
Prepare data for prescriptive and predictive modeling
Identify opportunities for data acquisition
Collaborate with data scientists and architects on several projects


About you:


Strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems with data.
Proficient in SQL
Experienced with Power BI and Python
Comfortable working with large datasets and integrating data from multiple sources.
Skilled in using statistical techniques and data modeling to uncover insights.
Knowledge of R, or similar languages for data analysis is a plus.
Detail-oriented, with the ability to translate raw data into clear and actionable insights.
Collaborative and communicative, able to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Curious, proactive, and eager to improve processes and contribute to innovation.


About the benefits:


Flexible working hours;
International team;
Birthday Leave;

We believe in providing equal opportunities for employment and advancement, regardless of factors such as race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. This policy sets forth our commitment to promoting equal opportunity and diversity within our organization.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That's the future we're building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don't just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!





This job was posted on 02/07/2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Title: Data Analyst - Fraud Intelligence Team
Description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

Join our Fraud Intelligence team at Riskified! As a Data Analyst on this team, you'll play a key role in helping us mitigate fraud and stay ahead of the fraudsters targeting our merchants. You'll research new and emerging fraud modus operandi (MOs), dive deep into transactional data, and help build and define the detection tools that power our fraud-prevention engine. This role sits at the core of Riskified's product and performance — the strength of our detection is a direct result of the work this team does every day.

What You'll Be Doing
Research and investigate new and evolving fraud modus operandi (MOs) across our merchant base
Analyze large-scale transactional data using SQL (and R or Python) to uncover patterns, anomalies, and emerging fraud trends
Collaborate with Data Science, Product, and Engineering to help build, define, and refine new fraud-detection tools 
Translate research findings into actionable insights that directly improve detection accuracy and merchant performance
Monitor and evaluate the performance of existing detection logic, flagging gaps or drift as fraud patterns evolve
Document investigation findings and methodologies, strengthening the team's shared knowledge base
Work cross-functionally with Risk Operations and Account Management to respond quickly to new fraud threats
Qualifications
2-3+ years of relevant strong analytical experience with complex data
2+ years of hands-on work experience with SQL (must be proficient)
Proven expertise in analysis tools such as R and Python 
Experienced problem-solver with critical thinking skills
Ability to work simultaneously on different tasks and lead multiple projects
Full working proficiency (both written and verbal) in English
Effective presentation skills, with a track record of client-facing experience
Advantage - experience in fraud, payments, or ecommerce domains

*Please submit your CV/Resume in English

We include transparent salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. The base salary range for this position is €37,000 - €42,000 gross annually for candidates based in Lisbon. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.

The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.

 Life at Riskified

We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking.

We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.

Some of our Lisbon Benefits & Perks:

Hybrid mode of work
Flexible schedule
Healthcare benefits
Fully-stocked kitchens
Benefits package per month—per your choice, e.g., work-from-home equipment, gym membership, wellbeing activities, and more.
Wellness program

Team events

Awesome Riskified gifts and swags

Role-based technical skills training

Title: Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Revenue Intelligence
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket. Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



About the Role



As our business scales across 27 European markets, understanding the mechanics behind our financial performance and identifying new revenue streams is vital. We need an experienced analytical professional who can translate complex datasets into actionable business strategies and take ownership of high-impact initiatives.



To achieve this goal, we are hiring a Data Analyst (m/f/d) to join our Revenue Intelligence team. In this role, you will act as a key strategic partner to our leadership, working closely with our Head of Revenue Intelligence and Chief Revenue Officer, while collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Management and other teams.



You will focus on dissecting revenue dynamics, building predictive models and developing automated anomaly detection systems to safeguard and boost performance. You will leverage SQL and Python to run causal inference analyses, evaluate pricing initiatives and uncover performance drivers across our e-commerce ecosystem. Beyond technical execution, a key part of your mission will be data storytelling—translating advanced statistical concepts into clear, compelling insights for non-technical stakeholders.



This is an exciting opportunity for a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, proactive problem-solving and high visibility. You will have the direct space to pitch independent ideas, shape analytical frameworks and immediately influence commercial outcomes in a fast-paced scale-up environment.



What You Will Do



Monitor revenue and profit trends continuously across diverse e-commerce dimensions.



Build automated detection systems and frameworks to identify performance anomalies, early warning signals and degradation drivers.



Conduct deep root-cause analyses and apply causal inference methods to distinguish correlation from causation in business performance changes.



Quantify factor contributions to revenue shifts and evaluate commercial initiatives like pricing strategies or category launches.



Communicate analytical findings effectively to cross-functional partners and present actionable insights to senior leadership.



Utilize advanced tools, data processing models and modern analytics technologies to enhance team productivity and workflow automation.





Qualifications



Proven experience (5-7 years) in economic analysis, revenue management, or financial planning and analysis (FP&A), ideally within e-commerce, retail or tech.



Academic background in Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.



Strong technical proficiency in SQL for advanced data extraction and transformation.



Fluency in Python for data analysis, statistical modeling and analytical processing (e.g., pandas, numpy,etc ).



Solid understanding of statistics, econometrics, time series forecasting, regression and segmentation.



Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to bridge complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.



Proactive mindset with a collaborative approach and strong problem-solving drive.



Professional fluency in English.





Additional Information


Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)

This job was posted on 31/08/2026 and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Collaborate with internal clients to best understand their needs towards the process and assure continuous improvement

Ensure proper maintenance of documentation of all methodologies, tools, processes and procedures
Continuous participation in transversal projects, being a key participant for improvement and decision making

Proactivity

Title: Analista de Dados
Description:
A Energia Repsol:

A Repsol é uma empresa multienergética global, que lidera a transição energética e definiu o objetivo de alcançar as zero emissões líquidas até 2050. Está presente em toda a cadeia de valor energética, emprega cerca de 25.000 pessoas, distribui os seus produtos em mais de 20 países e conta com 24 milhões de Clientes. Lidera o desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis na área da mobilidade e do lar. Na Repsol, contamos com a inovação tecnológica e a digitalização para criar um futuro mais sustentável e trabalhamos para contribuir o progresso da sociedade, valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas.

Missão:

Procuramos uma pessoa com iniciativa, vontade de aprender e crescer profissionalmente no mundo da analítica e da tomada de decisões orientadas por dados (data driven).

Será o business partner do negócio, assumindo-se como especialista no conhecimento dos clientes, na definição de segmentações de valor comercial, na modelização e na utilização de técnicas de inteligência artificial para apoiar a tomada de decisões baseadas em dados e contribuir para a criação de novos e melhores resultados para a empresa.

Terá a oportunidade de transformar dados em conhecimento e conhecimento em ação, identificando oportunidades comerciais e apoiando as diferentes áreas de negócio na definição de estratégias e iniciativas orientadas para o cliente. Será especialista em modelos de negócio e em processos de tomada de decisão orientados por dados, atuando como parceiro estratégico do negócio.

Funções e Responsabilidades:


Propor, desenvolver e implementar modelos, estudos e dashboards com base em analítica avançada de dados para os diferentes negócios comerciais da Repsol Portugal, com foco na análise de clientes e em ações comerciais.
Participar na avaliação de programas e ações comerciais personalizadas.
Identificar oportunidades, desenvolver soluções e prestar apoio às áreas comerciais e de negócio em temas de otimização comercial e estratégia de cliente.
Interpretar variáveis de negócio e desenhar indicadores de desempenho.
Participar em equipas multidisciplinares, desempenhando funções de analista de negócio e de coordenação com equipas de desenvolvimento técnico.
Realizar segmentações, definir campanhas e journeys comerciais, bem como avaliar o seu impacto, desvios e rentabilidade através de ferramentas de mineração e analítica de dados.
Desenvolver estudos de clientes através de técnicas de clusterização, análise de padrões e tendências e desenho de modelos estatísticos de previsão de comportamento ou procura.
Conceber, desenvolver e gerir a manutenção de modelos de dados, assegurando todo o ciclo de captura, armazenamento e exploração da informação.



Requisitos da Função


Formação superior em Matemática, Engenharia, Informática, Gestão e Administração de Empresas, ou áreas similares.
Experiência entre 4 a 5 anos em projetos de analítica avançada e na gestão de bases de dados (depuração de indicadores, reconciliação de dados, validação de cargas de informação, entre outros).
Experiência em segmentação, modelação estatística, machine learning com Python ou SAS, e desenvolvimento de dashboards em Power BI, Tableau ou SAS Viya.
Experiência na utilização de ferramentas como SAS Guide, Alteryx, SAS Miner, SQL ou Python.
Orientação para a análise de dados e para a criação de valor para o negócio, atuando como analista de negócio/dados.
Elevada capacidade de trabalho em equipa, comunicação e síntese.
Conhecimentos avançados de Excel, Power BI e PowerPoint.
Disponibilidade para deslocações frequentes a Espanha.
Fluência em português, nível C1 em espanhol e nível B2 em inglês.



O que oferecemos:


Condições salariais atrativas
Políticas work-life balance
Desenvolvimento contínuo
Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo
