Title: Senior Business Strategy Analyst
Description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?







We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.   










Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 










It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 










Ready to awaken your best with us? 







 





About The Role


We are looking for a Senior Business Strategy Analyst to drive commercial excellence and regional performance for Emma's European D2C business. You will be responsible for building scalable frameworks, processes, and cross-market initiatives that enable country teams to deliver consistent results and accelerate EU growth.




You'll report to the Business Strategy Manager and work closely with Ecommerce Country Teams, Global Marketing, Category Management, and Webshop and Operations.







What You'll Do:


Own and drive regional commercial excellence by defining scalable campaign structures, testing pipelines, and implementation playbooks that deliver measurable impact across EU markets


Lead high-impact cross-country initiatives that create regional advantage, embed best practices, and establish clear decision-making models across European markets


Build scalable systems and processes that enable local country teams to deliver consistent commercial results independently while maintaining strong regional alignment


Lead strategic projects at the intersection of operations, commercial strategy, and execution, ensuring Europe-wide coordination, accountability, and business impact


Drive forward-looking forecasting, budget planning, and market performance visibility in alignment with country teams, Controlling, and P&L ownership


Monitor process governance and KPIs across markets, identifying risks and growth opportunities to accelerate Emma's EU commercial performance


Act as a strategic sparring partner to country teams, enabling knowledge transfer, performance scaling, and alignment while respecting local market ownership


Partner cross-functionally with Global Marketing, Category Management, and Webshop and Operations to align on trends, priorities, and commercial execution








Who We're Looking For:


You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering or a related field


You have 3–5+ years of experience in business operations, strategy, or consulting, ideally within e-commerce or performance-driven commercial environments


You are skilled in translating campaign mechanics, financial KPIs, and supply constraints into coherent regional planning and structured execution


You are data-led and commercially sharp — you use data to make decisions, quantify impact, and challenge assumptions in campaign and financial planning


You act with full ownership mentality: you define the "how," drive initiatives forward independently, and thrive without waiting for perfect conditions


You lead by influence, not authority — you bring cross-functional teams together and drive alignment between Global, Regional, and Local stakeholders


You are fluent in English and communicate with clarity and confidence across multicultural, distributed, international teams








What We Offer:


The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change


Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo


A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events


A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities


Private Health Insurance and 24 vacation days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 29 days per year)


A flexible hybrid setup with up to 22 remote days per quarter


A modern, pet-friendly office in Parque das Nações, Lisbon















Become an Emmie 








We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  










We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 










Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.   










Upon your consent, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as get the interviews transcript and summarised by AI. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to privacy@emma-sleep.com

Title: Senior Data Scientist Reinforcement Learning – Offer Intelligence (m/f/d)
Description:
We work at the intersection of pricing science, offer personalisation, advanced statistics, and scalable software. You'll build and bring into production state-of-the-art probabilistic models - like hierarchical Bayesian regression, SVI, or bandit algorithms - that power millions of pricing and offer decisions at SIXT every day. Beyond pricing, we're building the intelligence layer that decides which offer and which experience each customer sees, so your models shape both what we charge and what we show. From shaping the analytical question to deploying live models, you'll own the full lifecycle, supported by an innovation-friendly culture and great team. If you're excited by real-world impact, rigorous methods, and turning cutting-edge ideas into production - even if you don't tick every box - we'd love to hear from you!



YOUR ROLE AT SIXT


You architect and prototype advanced regression models (linear, GLM, mixed-effects, Gaussian Process) with a principled Bayesian approach, guiding pricing strategy at scale
You design and productionise personalisation and recommendation systems - two-tower retrieval, embedding-based candidate generation, learning-to-rank, sequential/transformer models - with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation to keep them learning from real interactions
You apply techniques like SVI, MCMC, and importance sampling to enable robust decision-making under uncertainty, even with sparse, high-volume, or streaming data
You build and maintain reproducible pipelines for feature engineering, label generation, and automated data validation using tools like Airflow or Dagster, ensuring high code quality and reliability
You deploy models via FastAPI, Docker, or Kubeflow, and establish real-time monitoring with Bayesian control charts and performance dashboards to catch drift and anomalies early
You design sophisticated A/B and multivariate tests, apply quasi-experimental and causal impact methods, and quantify the value of information to balance exploration and exploitation
You collaborate with product, revenue, and customer experience leaders to translate ambiguous ideas into testable hypotheses, while mentoring peers and elevating Bayesian practice through internal publications and workshops





YOUR SKILLS MATTER


Expertise You bring deep statistical chops, with 5+ years of applying regression, hierarchical models, or state-space methods in production
Computing proficiency You have a well-stocked Bayesian toolbelt - fluent in PyMC, Stan, NumPyro, TFP, or similar - and are comfortable writing custom likelihoods and priors.
Modeling You have proven experience scaling inference using SVI, black-box VI, or advanced MCMC techniques on large datasets
Personalisation (nice to have) You have experience with recommender and personalisation stacks - two-tower / embedding retrieval, learning-to-rank, sequential models, contextual bandits - plus counterfactual or off-policy evaluation to prove incremental value rather than optimise click-through
Engineering practices You write solid, production-grade Python code and are familiar with type hints, testing frameworks, and CI/CD workflows
Infrastructure You are hands-on with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, and have experience with containerization (Docker/K8s) and workflow orchestration
Stakeholder management You communicate uncertainty, lift, and risk in plain English for executives, while engaging deeply with scientists and engineers





WHAT WE OFFER


A Global Tech Hub in Lisbon Join a thriving international tech community and work alongside engineers, product experts, and business teams who turn ideas into real impact. Our hubs at Factory Lisboa in Beato and ARTs Lisboa in Parque das Nações are where great tech gets built
Learning & Knowledge Exchange Level up through regular events with internal and external speakers. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and open exchange – across teams, disciplines, and borders
Flexible Work Setup Two office days a week, flexible hours, and modern spaces built for both deep focus and team collaboration – work the way that brings out your best
Time Off & Wellbeing Enjoy 28 vacation days per year, an additional day off on your birthday, one volunteer day annually, and private health insurance that also covers your spouse and children free of charge
Practical Everyday Benefits Get a yearly Coverflex allowance and a daily meal allowance to make everyday life a little easier
SIXT Perks Get exclusive rates on all SIXT services, with special discounts extended to your family and friends. Because great perks are even better when you can share them





About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.00 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 350,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 110 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Marketing Measurement & Causal Inference (m/f/d)
Description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

As a Senior Data Scientist in our Commercial & Marketing Intelligence team at Flix, you can make an impact by owning and evolving our causal measurement practice — designing and running experiments that directly shape how we allocate our global marketing budget. You will work closely with a dedicated team across Marketing & Sales, Revenue Management, Reporting, and Engineering to ensure our incrementality evidence drives smarter, more transparent choices at scale.

About The Role


Own the design, execution, and continuous improvement of geo-based, time-based, and synthetic control experiment frameworks, ensuring methodological rigour and scalability across global markets and channels
Apply econometric and causal inference techniques — including difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and Bayesian structural time series — to measure the true incremental effect of marketing activities on bookings and revenue
Build and manage a structured test-and-learn programme across paid channels, identifying measurement gaps and prioritising experiments by expected business value
Contribute to the development and validation of attribution models (CLV-MTA and MMM), providing reliable benchmarks that reduce reliance on platform self-reported data
Translate complex causal findings into clear, actionable recommendations for a wide range of stakeholders including marketing teams, finance, and senior management
Review experiment designs, create thorough documentation, and help shape internal standards for how Flix measures marketing effectiveness across all channels


About You


Holds a Master's or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
Brings 5+ years of experience in a data science or quantitative research role, with hands-on expertise in designing and evaluating causal experiments such as geo experiments, time-series holdouts, or synthetic control studies
Demonstrate strong command of causal inference methods including difference-in-differences, synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series, or matched market testing
Proficient in Python,SQL, Power BI and experienced with statistical modelling libraries such as statsmodels, PyMC, CausalImpact, or equivalent tools
Comfortable with version control (Git), reproducible workflows, and cloud or data warehouse environments such as BigQuery or Snowflake
Proven ability to present statistical findings to non-technical audiences and contribute to strategic choices with data
Experience in marketing measurement, media mix modelling, or growth reporting is a plus — as is familiarity with Bayesian methods


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer


Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Title: Data Analyst - Europe
Description:
Job Type

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

About Hiscox

Hiscox is an international insurer specialising in luxury goods and property markets, as well as high-end professional insurance. As experts in risk, we empower individuals and businesses to achieve their ambitions. With offices in nine European countries, we have a highly international workforce and foster a culture of inclusion, collaboration, and personal and professional growth.

About The Hiscox Data Team

The Europe Data Team is a cross-country, multidisciplinary group responsible for driving and enabling Hiscox Europe’s data capabilities. We combine expertise in Data Engineering, Data Analysis, and Data Management to deliver high-quality data pipelines, insightful reporting, and strong governance frameworks, working closely with business teams across Europe.

Our mission is to ensure trusted, consistent, and accessible data that empowers smarter decision-making and supports the evolution of the enterprise Hiscox Data Strategy.

The Role

The Data Analyst for the Europe Data Team analyses business requirements and available data across our European analytics platform, which uses Microsoft Azure and Databricks. This role clarifies business needs, identifies improvements, and helps guide the platform’s development in line with the Hiscox Data Strategy.

Working with technical teams, the Data Analyst defines solutions to deliver reliable and accurate insights for functions such as Sales, Underwriting, and Finance, using tools such as Power BI and collaborating with diverse stakeholders.

With ongoing data transformation across Europe, this position offers the opportunity to shape strategic outcomes while supporting daily operations and existing commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Business & Data Analysis


Analyse and document business requirements to support reporting and analytical needs.
Perform data analysis and discovery across multiple sources to validate data quality, identify gaps, and support decision-making.
Extract and prepare data to support ad hoc business requests.
Monitor analytical platform outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with business expectations.



Data Modelling & Mapping


Support data modelling and mapping activities, ensuring that business rules are correctly defined and implemented.
Analyse data from various systems to support the mapping processes feeding the European Data Platform.



Collaboration & Solution Design


Work closely with data engineers and business stakeholders to translate and align functional requirements into effective technical solutions.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes, standards, and platform evolution.



Reporting & Visualisation (Power BI)


Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that deliver actionable insights to stakeholders.
Build and manage data models, relationships, and calculations within Power BI.
Apply best practices in data visualisation to create clear and impactful dashboards.
Stay up to date with new Power BI features and industry trends to continuously improve reporting capabilities.



Skills

Technical Skills


Good understanding of data mapping and business intelligence concepts.
Knowledge of data modelling techniques, including star schema.
Experience using SQL to query and manipulate data.
Hands-on experience with Power BI, including report creation, data modelling, and DAX.
Experience with Databricks, or exposure to Databricks-based data and analytics environments, would be advantageous.



Functional Skills


Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain insights to non-technical stakeholders.
At least three years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data and Analytics roles.
Experience in functional analysis, ideally within the insurance industry.



Education & Languages


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.
Fluent English, both spoken and written.



Person Specification


Self-motivated and able to work independently while contributing effectively to a team.
Positive attitude and a strong interest in creating value from data.
Able to communicate ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Skilled at translating business needs into practical technical solutions.
Strong relationship-building skills with end users.
Comfortable working in environments with ambiguity and change.
Flexible, adaptable, and resilient.



Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

Data analysis

  • Good working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, filters, pivot tables, and charts;
  • Ability to clean, compare, summarize, and validate data;
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies, patterns, and outliers;
  • Ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical people.

Development support

  • Practical experience with Python;
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools;
  • Familiarity with scripting and task automation;
  • Ability to create or adapt small tools that make analysis faster or more reliable.

Working style

  • Strong analytical skills and critical-thinking ability;
  • Careful and methodical when handling data;
  • Able to question assumptions, assess evidence, and distinguish facts from interpretations;

Title: Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Revenue Intelligence
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket. Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



About the Role



As our business scales across 27 European markets, understanding the mechanics behind our financial performance and identifying new revenue streams is vital. We need an experienced analytical professional who can translate complex datasets into actionable business strategies and take ownership of high-impact initiatives.



To achieve this goal, we are hiring a Data Analyst (m/f/d) to join our Revenue Intelligence team. In this role, you will act as a key strategic partner to our leadership, working closely with our Head of Revenue Intelligence and Chief Revenue Officer, while collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Management and other teams.



You will focus on dissecting revenue dynamics, building predictive models and developing automated anomaly detection systems to safeguard and boost performance. You will leverage SQL and Python to run causal inference analyses, evaluate pricing initiatives and uncover performance drivers across our e-commerce ecosystem. Beyond technical execution, a key part of your mission will be data storytelling—translating advanced statistical concepts into clear, compelling insights for non-technical stakeholders.



This is an exciting opportunity for a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, proactive problem-solving and high visibility. You will have the direct space to pitch independent ideas, shape analytical frameworks and immediately influence commercial outcomes in a fast-paced scale-up environment.



What You Will Do



Monitor revenue and profit trends continuously across diverse e-commerce dimensions.



Build automated detection systems and frameworks to identify performance anomalies, early warning signals and degradation drivers.



Conduct deep root-cause analyses and apply causal inference methods to distinguish correlation from causation in business performance changes.



Quantify factor contributions to revenue shifts and evaluate commercial initiatives like pricing strategies or category launches.



Communicate analytical findings effectively to cross-functional partners and present actionable insights to senior leadership.



Utilize advanced tools, data processing models and modern analytics technologies to enhance team productivity and workflow automation.





Qualifications



Proven experience (5-7 years) in economic analysis, revenue management, or financial planning and analysis (FP&A), ideally within e-commerce, retail or tech.



Academic background in Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.



Strong technical proficiency in SQL for advanced data extraction and transformation.



Fluency in Python for data analysis, statistical modeling and analytical processing (e.g., pandas, numpy,etc ).



Solid understanding of statistics, econometrics, time series forecasting, regression and segmentation.



Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to bridge complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.



Proactive mindset with a collaborative approach and strong problem-solving drive.



Professional fluency in English.





Additional Information


Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights.


Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)


What Excites You


Become a strategic partner and advisor for the business: you like to proactively seek out gaps in our product capabilities, suggest areas of improvement based on tangible data, as well as owning processes to run and improve testing from the tracking point of view when developing new features.
Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.
Translate complex technical findings into compelling, high-impact narratives. You will bridge the gap between technical data and commercial strategy, influencing product roadmaps and executive decision-making across the entire organization.
Stay current with AI and data trends to solve real-world problems. You like to leverage these technologies to enhance the payment experience, as well as to optimize data analysis, and deliver high-impact insights and strategic recommendations across the business.
Unlocking new layers of payment performance, from uncovering new fraud vectors to maximizing success rates
Serve as a cross-functional mentor, championing a data-driven mindset and elevating the analytical capabilities of team members throughout the company.


What Excites Us


You have a background working in similar fast paced product-driven teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed product decisions
You are a self-starter, focused on results, with a demonstrated background in using analytics to drive the understanding, growth, and success of a product
You have extensive experience with data visualisation tools mentioned above and develop compelling visualisations which influence decision making and business understanding
You have advanced SQL skills and intermediate Python skills & have experience leveraging AI capabilities to enhance data analysis, automate tasks, and improve decision-making processes
You have a background working in similar fast paced teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed decisions.
You are solution-oriented and able to own projects from start to finish. You are comfortable motivating stakeholders across the business and negotiating timelines to unblock yourself and make things happen!


Salary range: the expected base salary range for this position is between €32,000 - €48,000.

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

(some of) The good stuff


Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)


Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To Ensure That We're Representative Of The World Around Us - And To Be Able To Review Relevant Benchmarks - We Ask GeeCees To Voluntarily Disclose Diversity Data. HTML:
Purpose of Position

The Business Insights Analyst combines analytical expertise and aptitude with adaptability, practicality, and a strong ability to communicate. The purpose is to deliver exceptional analytical insights and solutions to challenges throughout NetJets.

This role is responsible for gathering, managing and consolidating accurate information to provide to the business within the diverse areas that belong to the Business Insights & Analytics department, executing analysis measuring the business performance to provide actionable and value-add insights, support decision-making and business planning.

This role will help define solutions and support change adoption to improve forecasting performance, cross functional communication, and integrated planning.

Tasks And Responsibilities

  • Provide support to the Executive Leadership Team on strategic planning and decision-making processes of a wide range of topics contributing to the company’s profitability;
  • Develop and implement company dashboard reports, analytical modelling and visualizations to facilitate the monitoring of the business, allowing to quickly identify and act on issues and seize opportunities;
  • Assist to identify key business indicators to enhance the understanding of key business stakeholders of business needs by the distribution and creation of reporting, analysis, visualization, dashboards, whilst proposing solutions to business concerns;
  • Create timely, relevant, and accurate analyses of operational and business data and processes at the level of fidelity required for the diverse areas of the business;
  • Provide expertise in statistics, data visualization, machine learning, mathematical optimization, simulation, or another analytical specialty;
  • Learn new tools and techniques as needed to produce the best possible results;
  • Perform analysis of both strategic and tactical business and operational questions while working independently, pragmatically, and with reliance on creative analytical curiosity;
  • Collaborate with business partners to analytically explore business and operational problems;
  • Explore, gather, understand, and act to resolve operational issues through increasing business acumen;
  • Simplify complex analytical models/insights/solutions in presentations for Executive Leadership Team;
  • Author memos or presentations summarizing/explaining insights effectively and delivers work directly to the Executive Leadership Team;
  • Provide special analytical projects and prepares detailed, comprehensive presentations supporting corporate initiatives;
  • Collaborate with, mentors, develops, and supports other analysts;
  • Practice active listening and seeks feedback routinely to build business partner relationships and to foster trust in analytical insights and the recommendations of decision support tools and analyses.

Bachelor's in Computer Science or Mathematics

Certifications and Licenses

2-4 years of experience

Service-Oriented

Curiosity

Collaboration

Adaptability

Strives For Positive Results

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar role or related work experience (preferential in aviation industry);
  • Ability to demonstrate high level of business acumen and commercial attitude;
  • Analytical skills with demonstrated experience in creating data architectures and datasets, machine learning and algorithms, prescriptive and predictive modelling techniques, advanced statistical techniques (regression, statistical tests etc) and their various applications;

  • Initiative, confidence, and the drive to achieve results without explicit direction or detailed instruction;
  • Fluency in Business English (written and spoken).

  • Excelente ambiente de trabalho.

Join us at BNP Paribas Cardif Support

based in Porto

Be part of our dynamic Management Control (Management Accounting Nanterre) team!

Your Key Responsibilities Will Be

Prepare technical result projections during budgetary exercises (Update, Budget, Medium-Term Plan) by leveraging advanced Excel and automated data processing.
Perform comparative analytical reviews between different phases on a technical level and utilize data reconciliation techniques to prepare synthesis reports for Financial Steering, Executive Management, and the Group.
Drive continuous improvement and optimization of production processes by applying programming logic to automate manual processes and enhance workflow efficiency, in collaboration with IT development teams.
Build and design dashboards for Business Unit Heads, adapting it to their needs and contributing to monitoring the gap between French GAAP and IFRS 17, and be capable of leveraging data automation tools and techniques for this purpose.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? HERE’S WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:


Bachelor’s degree in Management, Accounting, Finance or another related field
Minimum of 5 years of experience, in similar positions (Finance, Management Control or Actuarial)
Proficiency in computing skills. Advanced excel knowledge is mandatory.
Knowledge of VBA / SaaS / Power BI / Power Query / Python is a plus. Comfortable and confident learning new tools or developing skills on the above tools.
Prior experience in banking, insurance or in a consulting firm would be an advantage
Proficiency in Financial Models, financial and performance analysis, and measurement and budget management
Fluent in English (C1 level minimum). Fluency in French is a plus.

In addition to our attractive salary, here’s a glimpse of what you can expect from us:

Flexibility Redefined: Embrace our hybrid working model for a perfect balance of commitment and personal flexibility.
Endless and tailored Professional Growth: Fuel your career aspirations with continuous development opportunities on both local and global scales

Title: Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner
Description:
About The Company

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy - full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We're the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we're accelerating.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner who will help us understand where the business makes money, where profit is lost, and which decisions can improve margins, cash flow, and overall performance. You will work closely with founders, finance, product, operations, and business teams to turn financial and operational data into clear recommendations. This role exists to help leadership make faster, better decisions based on real business numbers.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build and improve executive dashboards that show revenue, profit, margins, COGS, OpEx, refunds, payouts, cash flow, and key business metrics

Analyze profitability across products, customers, providers, geographies, channels, lead sources, and operational workflows

Create P&L analysis, gross margin analysis, contribution margin analysis, unit economics models, forecasts, and scenario analysis

Identify cost leaks, overspending, inefficient vendors, payment issues, margin risks, and other areas where the business can improve profit

Partner with finance, accounting, product, operations, sales, and marketing teams to connect business activity with financial outcomes

Reconcile business data with invoices, payouts, payment systems, taxes, accounting records, and financial reports

Present clear recommendations to founders and senior leadership on pricing, cost optimization, product profitability, hiring, and growth decisions

What Makes You a Strong Fit:

6-8+ years of experience in financial analytics, FP&A, data analytics, business analytics, or a similar role

Strong experience with financial modeling, P&L analysis, unit economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis

Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with BigQuery

Strong experience with Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial modeling, reporting, and scenario analysis

Good understanding of accounting basics, financial statements, revenue, COGS, OpEx, gross margin, contribution margin, and cash flow

Clear communication in English, both spoken and written, with the ability to explain financial insights to founders, business teams, and non-finance stakeholders

Bonus if you have:

Experience with Python or another scripting language for data analysis and reporting automation

Experience with payment systems, accounting systems, CRM, ERP, Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or similar tools

Experience in marketplace, SaaS, fintech, real estate, lead generation, or performance marketing businesses

Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership in a fast-moving business environment

Why You'll Love It Here:

You'll work at the core of a product-led, AI-powered startup where data drives every decision

Your work will ship fast and impact thousands of users

High autonomy, low bureaucracy: we trust you to own your domain

Remote-first culture with flexible hours and async-friendly communication

Salary (fixed base) ABOVE the market average

A smart, passionate team that moves fast, supports each other, and builds cool stuff

15 paid vacation days plus 5 paid sick days annually

Paid access to courses, books, and growth resources

Real decision-making power and ownership of your results

Title: Senior Pricing & Revenue Performance Analyst
Description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?







We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.   










Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 










It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 










Ready to awaken your best with us? 







 




About the Role




 







As Senior Pricing & Revenue Performance Analyst, you'll be responsible for ensuring that Emma captures the full commercial value of its product portfolio — by connecting revenue performance, pricing architecture, and competitive intelligence into actionable insight.




This is a newly created role designed to address one of the most critical gaps identified in the category diagnostic: the absence of a structured pricing framework, a clear performance intelligence function, and a structured competitive monitoring capability. Today, pricing decisions lack governance, performance tracking is high-level, and competitive intelligence is fragmented. This role exists to fix that.




You will build the analytical backbone of Category Management — providing the data, frameworks, and strategic insight that make better portfolio decisions possible, and ensuring that pricing logic holds across markets, channels, and the full product lifecycle.







What you'll do:


1. Category Performance Intelligence





Design, build and own global category performance dashboards in partnership with BI and Data teams


Define the KPI framework for the category: which metrics matter, how they are measured, and at what frequency


Track and analyse product performance across all global markets:



Revenue, volume, and margin by SKU, channel, and market


Return rate and NPS correlation with product attributes and positioning


Portfolio mix evolution and contribution margin by tier


Channel performance across DTC, marketplace, and retail








Identify performance gaps, growth opportunities, and structural category issues — and translate them into clear recommendations


Produce monthly performance reviews and quarterly category performance deep-dives for senior stakeholders


Build the category portfolio assessment framework (combining CM, return rate, revenue, and mix) to steer investment and rationalisation decisions







2. Pricing Architecture & Value Capture





Design and maintain global price ladders, pricing tiers, and trade-up logic for each product category


Define pricing corridors by channel, market cluster, and product tier — ensuring coherence across the portfolio


Maintain & update a pricing elasticity model to inform strategic pricing decisions and promotional planning


Support pricing decisions for new product launches — working closely with Global Category Managers and Finance


Conduct regular price-value assessments: are products priced coherently relative to consumer-perceived value and competitive positioning?


Identify pricing risks (undercutting, margin compression, channel conflict) and propose corrective actions


Build a pricing governance framework ensuring decisions are documented, consistent, and defensible







3. Promotional Governance & ROI Framework





Define promo guardrails and governance standards (frequency, depth, product eligibility, channel fit)


Build and maintain a promotional effectiveness tracking model — measuring actual ROI vs planned


Collaborate with countries to conduct pre- and post-promo analysis to identify what works, at what cost, and for which products


Work with Regional Category Managers to evaluate EU, APAC, and LATAM promo requests against global guardrails


Identify structural promo dependency risks (habituation, margin erosion, brand degradation) and escalate early


Partner with Finance and Commercial to ensure promo plans are margin-accretive or strategically justified







4. Competitive & Market Intelligence





Own and continuously maintain a structured competitive landscape view across Emma's core categories


Track competitor pricing, product launches, positioning changes, and promotional activity across key markets


Develop a repeatable, scalable competitive intelligence process — pulling from multiple sources (online scraping, trade press, field reports, mystery shopping)


Analyse market sizing, category growth rates, and channel shifts to identify whitespace and strategic risks


Deliver regular competitive intelligence reports and ad-hoc briefs when significant competitor moves occur


Support business case modelling with validated market data and external benchmarks







5. Category Decision Support & Business Cases





Serve as the analytical partner to Global and Regional Category Managers — providing the data backbone for strategic decisions


Build and validate business cases for new product investments, portfolio changes, and category expansion


Support market sizing exercises, opportunity assessments, and go/no-go frameworks for innovation


Work with Finance to translate category insights into P&L impact, investment return projections, and budget inputs


Develop self-service analytics tools and templates that help the broader category team make faster, better decisions










Who we are looking for:


4–6 years in pricing, strategy, business analytics, revenue management, or category performance in a consumer goods, DTC, e-commerce, or retail context


Proven experience designing or operating pricing frameworks and governance processes


Experience working with BI tools and building performance dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent)


Experience using statistics and data science to inform business and commercial decisions


Experience with competitive intelligence and market analysis methodologies


Background in building business cases and financial models for portfolio or pricing decisions


Highly analytical and data-literate: you are comfortable in Excel and BI tools, and can build models independently


Solid foundation in statistics (hypothesis testing, regression basics, distributions, interpreting outputs) and clear understanding of clustering methods (e.g., k-means) and their practical limitations


Working knowledge of Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, basic scripting, data cleaning, exploratory analysis)


Track record of translating complex data into clear, decision-ready business recommendations


Pricing-first thinker: you understand the interplay between pricing, perceived value, volume, and margin


Structured and rigorous: you build frameworks that hold up under scrutiny and can be used repeatedly


Business-oriented: you translate insights into decisions, not just reports


Strong communicator: able to present complex analytical findings clearly to non-analytical audiences including leadership


Collaborative: you work as a service partner to category managers — empowering their decisions, not replacing them


Proactive: you spot issues and opportunities before being asked, and you come with solutions








What we offer:


At Emma, you’ll find a culture of freedom, impact, and zero politics. We give you full ownership from day one and expect you to move fast, think big, and grow even faster. 


Pet-friendly environment, where you can bring your furry desk buddy;  


Discounts on our top-notch products;   


Health insurance including dentist;  


24 days holidays/year +1 day/year at Emma (max. 29 days);  


The opportunity to collaborate with multinational teams;  


Exciting events that aren't just team-building exercises but opportunities to create epic memories















Become an Emmie 








We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 










Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?



We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.   




Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 




It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 




Ready to awaken your best with us? 



 


About the Role


 



As Senior Pricing & Revenue Performance Analyst, you'll be responsible for ensuring that Emma captures the full commercial value of its product portfolio — by connecting revenue performance, pricing architecture, and competitive intelligence into actionable insight.


This is a newly created role designed to address one of the most critical gaps identified in the category diagnostic: the absence of a structured pricing framework, a clear performance intelligence function, and a structured competitive monitoring capability. Today, pricing decisions lack governance, performance tracking is high-level, and competitive intelligence is fragmented. This role exists to fix that.


You will build the analytical backbone of Category Management — providing the data, frameworks, and strategic insight that make better portfolio decisions possible, and ensuring that pricing logic holds across markets, channels, and the full product lifecycle.



What you'll do:

1. Category Performance Intelligence



  • Design, build and own global category performance dashboards in partnership with BI and Data teams

  • Define the KPI framework for the category: which metrics matter, how they are measured, and at what frequency

  • Track and analyse product performance across all global markets:

    • Revenue, volume, and margin by SKU, channel, and market

    • Return rate and NPS correlation with product attributes and positioning

    • Portfolio mix evolution and contribution margin by tier

    • Channel performance across DTC, marketplace, and retail





  • Identify performance gaps, growth opportunities, and structural category issues — and translate them into clear recommendations

  • Produce monthly performance reviews and quarterly category performance deep-dives for senior stakeholders

  • Build the category portfolio assessment framework (combining CM, return rate, revenue, and mix) to steer investment and rationalisation decisions




2. Pricing Architecture & Value Capture



  • Design and maintain global price ladders, pricing tiers, and trade-up logic for each product category

  • Define pricing corridors by channel, market cluster, and product tier — ensuring coherence across the portfolio

  • Maintain & update a pricing elasticity model to inform strategic pricing decisions and promotional planning

  • Support pricing decisions for new product launches — working closely with Global Category Managers and Finance

  • Conduct regular price-value assessments: are products priced coherently relative to consumer-perceived value and competitive positioning?

  • Identify pricing risks (undercutting, margin compression, channel conflict) and propose corrective actions

  • Build a pricing governance framework ensuring decisions are documented, consistent, and defensible




3. Promotional Governance & ROI Framework



  • Define promo guardrails and governance standards (frequency, depth, product eligibility, channel fit)

  • Build and maintain a promotional effectiveness tracking model — measuring actual ROI vs planned

  • Collaborate with countries to conduct pre- and post-promo analysis to identify what works, at what cost, and for which products

  • Work with Regional Category Managers to evaluate EU, APAC, and LATAM promo requests against global guardrails

  • Identify structural promo dependency risks (habituation, margin erosion, brand degradation) and escalate early

  • Partner with Finance and Commercial to ensure promo plans are margin-accretive or strategically justified




4. Competitive & Market Intelligence



  • Own and continuously maintain a structured competitive landscape view across Emma's core categories

  • Track competitor pricing, product launches, positioning changes, and promotional activity across key markets

  • Develop a repeatable, scalable competitive intelligence process — pulling from multiple sources (online scraping, trade press, field reports, mystery shopping)

  • Analyse market sizing, category growth rates, and channel shifts to identify whitespace and strategic risks

  • Deliver regular competitive intelligence reports and ad-hoc briefs when significant competitor moves occur

  • Support business case modelling with validated market data and external benchmarks




5. Category Decision Support & Business Cases



  • Serve as the analytical partner to Global and Regional Category Managers — providing the data backbone for strategic decisions

  • Build and validate business cases for new product investments, portfolio changes, and category expansion

  • Support market sizing exercises, opportunity assessments, and go/no-go frameworks for innovation

  • Work with Finance to translate category insights into P&L impact, investment return projections, and budget inputs

  • Develop self-service analytics tools and templates that help the broader category team make faster, better decisions





Who we are looking for:

  • 4–6 years in pricing, strategy, business analytics, revenue management, or category performance in a consumer goods, DTC, e-commerce, or retail context

  • Proven experience designing or operating pricing frameworks and governance processes

  • Experience working with BI tools and building performance dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent)

  • Experience using statistics and data science to inform business and commercial decisions

  • Experience with competitive intelligence and market analysis methodologies

  • Background in building business cases and financial models for portfolio or pricing decisions

  • Highly analytical and data-literate: you are comfortable in Excel and BI tools, and can build models independently

  • Solid foundation in statistics (hypothesis testing, regression basics, distributions, interpreting outputs) and clear understanding of clustering methods (e.g., k-means) and their practical limitations

  • Working knowledge of Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, basic scripting, data cleaning, exploratory analysis)

  • Track record of translating complex data into clear, decision-ready business recommendations

  • Pricing-first thinker: you understand the interplay between pricing, perceived value, volume, and margin

  • Structured and rigorous: you build frameworks that hold up under scrutiny and can be used repeatedly

  • Business-oriented: you translate insights into decisions, not just reports

  • Strong communicator: able to present complex analytical findings clearly to non-analytical audiences including leadership

  • Collaborative: you work as a service partner to category managers — empowering their decisions, not replacing them

  • Proactive: you spot issues and opportunities before being asked, and you come with solutions




What we offer:

  • At Emma, you’ll find a culture of freedom, impact, and zero politics. We give you full ownership from day one and expect you to move fast, think big, and grow even faster. 

  • Pet-friendly environment, where you can bring your furry desk buddy;  

  • Discounts on our top-notch products;   

  • Health insurance including dentist;  

  • 24 days holidays/year +1 day/year at Emma (max. 29 days);  

  • The opportunity to collaborate with multinational teams;  

  • Exciting events that aren't just team-building exercises but opportunities to create epic memories







Become an Emmie 



We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

Title: Data Analytics Consultant
Description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Lisbon Office where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 200 people. Consultants based in Lisbon will support clients globally with the opportunity for international travel. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

This role sits within Efficio's Digital Delivery team, working at the intersection of consulting, data and technology.

Rather than building dashboards or maintaining internal reporting, you'll use data to solve real procurement and supply chain challenges for global clients.

You'll work alongside our consulting teams to understand client data, assess its quality, build analytical datasets such as Spend Cubes, and deliver insights that directly influence sourcing decisions and business outcomes.

Every project is different. One week you might be analysing ERP data for a global manufacturer, while the next you're helping consultants understand supplier spend patterns or using Python to automate data preparation for a new client engagement.

This is a hands-on delivery role combining technical problem-solving, analytical thinking and client collaboration.

What You’ll Be Doing


Work alongside consulting teams on global procurement and supply chain transformation projects.
Gather, assess and understand client data from ERP systems and other sources.
Clean, transform and structure complex datasets into analytical models such as Spend Cubes.
Develop data pipelines and automate repetitive data preparation activities using Python, SQL and AI.
Analyse procurement and spend data to uncover sourcing opportunities and support consulting recommendations.
Use AI-enabled tools and internal technologies to improve delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into data solutions.
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve delivery processes through knowledge sharing and automation.


What we are looking for:


At least 3 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data consulting, or a related field.
Experience working with SQL.
Experience using Python for data manipulation or automation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with and processing varied, disparate datasets.
Familiarity with Excel and data visualisation tools. We are using Sigma, but experience in PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik or similar will be valued).
Curious and eager to understand how businesses operate.
Comfortable working in across multiple projects.
Strong communication skills.


Nice to have:


Experience working with ERP data (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)
Procurement or supply chain exposure
Experience with AI-assisted analytics or automation
Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Learning Reporting Expert
Description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Learning Reporting Expert, who will adjusting HR cost center allocations and delivering robust learning reporting solutions globally. To address these business aims, this role focuses on learning data analytics, automated reporting solutions, and HR cost center alignment. These areas directly support strategic decision-making by translating complex learning datasets into actionable business insights.

How You’ll Make an Impact


Ensure reliable learning reporting by using data from Siemens Energy Learning Platform SELP to derive / create reporting with the required quality, managing Security Rights in SELP, and ensuring reliable learning data for audited external reports (e.g., SE Annual Report, ESG Fact Sheet).
Manage many adhoc reports with sensitive user data requested, e.g. which users haven’t completed “Foundation of DIGI AI”, and maintain 14 Excel sheets required to ensure accurate learning reporting and data quality.
Manage interfaces with external partners / suppliers providing trainings and learning opportunities (e.g. Cegos, Tüv Sued, Skillsoft …).
Manage the re-allocation of €1-1.5M monthly learning costs from HR Cost Center to participants' cost centers, including PO management; 70-80% of invoices are cross-BA, requiring a centralized allocation process. This global Transitory Cost Center (gTCC) process generates savings of approximately 2.5 Mill. € per year for SE.
Drive and ensure Reporting Migration (Transformation project to new Learning Platform – Cornerstone Workforce AI), including streamlining the number of active reports in SELP from 400 to 30 in “Workforce AI” and implementation and test of new created reports in “Workforce AI”.
Create completely new reports for “Performance & Talent Management” as requested.



What you bring


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum 5 years of experience in HR reporting, learning analytics, or business intelligence, preferably in a multinational corporate environment.
Strong expertise in business intelligence tools, learning management systems (LMS) data structures, and financial cost center tracking.
Ability to collaborate effectively with HR, IT, and additional team members.
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
English language skills.



About The Team

Our Corporate and Global Functions are essential in driving the company's strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across various departments, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you contribute to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external stakeholders, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/ Benefits


Stay safe and healthy with our medical subscription.
Career growth and development
Flexible work culture & well-being
Being part of an international and open-minded team.

Title: Especialista de Dados e Analytics (m/f)
Company: INCM Imprensa Nacional - Casa da Moeda
Description:
A Imprensa Nacional-Casa da Moeda, S. A. (INCM) tem por missão criar, produzir e fornecer bens e serviços que exigem elevados padrões de segurança, focados no cliente e em soluções inovadoras. Destacam-se, entre diversos bens e serviços essenciais à vida em sociedade, a produção de documentos de segurança, como o cartão de cidadão ou o passaporte, a cunhagem de moeda corrente e de coleção, a autenticação de artefactos de metais preciosos, a edição do Diário da República Eletrónico e a publicação de obras fundamentais da cultura portuguesa e universal.




Estamos à procura de um Especialista de Dados e Analytics (m/f) que integrará a carreira de técnico superior para integrar a nossa equipa. O candidato será responsável por desenvolver as capacidades de gestão e exploração de dados da organização, contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura de dados, disponibilização de informação para suporte à decisão e preparação dos ativos de informação para futuras iniciativas de análise avançada e Inteligência Artificial.

Procuramos um profissional com forte capacidade analítica, visão de conjunto sobre os dados da organização e interesse em participar na construção e evolução das práticas de dados e analytics.




Principais Responsabilidades:

Participar na definição e evolução da arquitetura de dados da organização.
Conceber e implementar modelos de dados para suporte a reporting, analytics e tomada de decisão.
Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Business Intelligence e dashboards corporativos.
Integrar, transformar e disponibilizar dados provenientes de diferentes sistemas e aplicações.
Definir e promover boas práticas de qualidade, consistência e governação de dados.
Apoiar a definição de indicadores e métricas de negócio transversais à organização.
Identificar oportunidades de valorização dos dados e de melhoria dos processos de gestão da informação.
Preparar e estruturar dados para iniciativas de Inteligência Artificial, automação e analítica avançada.
Produzir documentação funcional e técnica das soluções implementadas.
Colaborar com equipas internas e fornecedores na implementação de soluções de dados e analytics.




Qualificações:

Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em Business Intelligence, Analytics, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas relacionadas.
Licenciatura ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados ou área similar.
Experiência em modelação de dados e desenho de soluções analíticas.
Conhecimentos sólidos de bases de dados relacionais e SQL.
Experiência em processos de integração e transformação de dados.
Experiência na implementação de dashboards e relatórios analíticos.
Capacidade de compreender requisitos de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções de informação.

Competências Valorizadas:

Experiência com Microsoft Fabric, Power BI ou plataformas equivalentes.
Conhecimentos de Azure Data Services ou outras plataformas cloud de dados.
Experiência com Python ou linguagens de tratamento e análise de dados.
Conhecimentos de Data Governance e qualidade de dados.
Experiência na integração de dados através de APIs.
Conhecimentos de Inteligência Artificial e IA Generativa.
Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital e modernização de sistemas de informação.
Capacidade para trabalhar autonomamente e contribuir para a evolução das capacidades de dados da organização.




Oferecemos:

Integração numa empresa sólida;
Flexibilidade no local de trabalho;
Serviços Sociais INCM;
Remuneração compatível com a função;
Contrato de trabalho sem termo.




Se considera ter o perfil que procuramos, envie-nos o seu CV até dia 5 de outubro e junte-se a esta equipa! Em caso de dificuldade no preenchimento ou envio do formulário de candidatura eletrónica, por favor contacte a INCM através do e-mail: recrutamento@incm.pt

A sua singularidade é bem-vinda a esta empresa, a quem mais de 700 anos de história ensinaram que as mudanças trazem reinvenção e que é sempre possível transformar obstáculos em oportunidades. Na INCM queremos ver as coisas de perspetivas diferentes, num ambiente de diversidade, inclusão e igualdade com oportunidades iguais de crescimento para todos os profissionais com as mais variadas capacidades, que, acreditamos, em muito contribuirão para o crescimento desta empresa e de todos que fazem parte dela.




Caso a sua candidatura seja selecionada, entraremos em contacto consigo.

Se não contactarmos num prazo de 2 meses, queira considerar a sua candidatura como não selecionada.

Os dados recolhidos no decorrer deste recrutamento serão eliminados após decurso do prazo legal de 5 anos.

Para mais informações consulte a Política de Privacidade da INCM em www.incm.pt
