Title: Capabilities & Insights Analyst - Digital and Technology
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Capabilities & Insights (C&I) Analyst in the Digital & Technology Insights (DTi) team, you will be an integral part of McKinsey’s client delivery engine, working side by side with consultants and experts to help organizations transform through data, technology, and digital innovation. You’ll combine analytical rigor with business acumen to shape client recommendations, drive decision-making, and strengthen McKinsey’s knowledge assets globally.

You’ll often participate in team problem-solving discussions and, over time, contribute directly to client conversations — ensuring that insights are not just accurate, but actionable and strategically relevant.

You will be based in Lisbon, Portugal and you will play a pivotal role in guiding our consultants to leverage cutting-edge offerings, products, and insights to solve complex client challenges.

Your impact within our firm will be multifaceted, contributing to both client success and the advancement of our internal knowledge and operational excellence. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering DTi diagnostics, insights and products across the world, particularly on Technology Strategy and Productivity Performance topics, with a focus on clients in Europe.

In this exciting position, you will be at the intersection of technology, digital, AI and business, providing essential support to our client-service teams. You will engage with these teams to scope and prioritize project requests and business needs. You will clarify and scope objectives to determine the most appropriate offerings, insights, data, and products. This involves deploying standard offerings and products with minimal guidance, interpreting the outputs of these, and conducting medium-complexity data-driven analyses. Your ability to prepare accurate, well-developed documents, databases, models, solution outputs, and ready-to-use charts will be instrumental in driving client success.

Beyond client work, you will contribute to our knowledge, tech-enablement, and operational agenda. You will support the development and maintenance of databases, products, offerings and knowledge codification, working closely with senior colleagues on product development and knowledge creation initiatives. Your contributions will extend to client development efforts, such as creating client proposals and use-case examples that showcase our expertise. You will analyze data sets by developing scripts to validate, transform, and load data, creating insights that help drive our clients to action.

Over time, you will increasingly serve as a subject matter expert to McKinsey colleagues and our clients on digital, analytics, AI and technology topics, contributing to building our diagnostics, product development, and reach and relevance initiatives. Your journey at McKinsey will be one of continuous growth and development, ensuring that you remain at the forefront of industry advancements.

In a typical week, you might help a global bank assess its technology cost performance, support a retailer’s technology transformation readiness assessment, or contribute to elevating our internal operational excellence leveraging GenAI solutions. No two projects are the same — and each offers a chance to create visible client impact through data and technology.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer engineering/IT, mathematics, electronics or related field
2+ years of work experience in Information Technology field, either in industry/blue-chip company or IT consulting/advisory firm
Solid understanding of general business concepts and terminologies and proven problem-solving skills
Familiarity with recent technological advancements such as GenAI/Agents and adaptability to work in an environment which is enabled by GenAI capabilities for day-to-day work
Excellent organizational capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completion
Proficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoning. Strong analytical and quantitative skills; good problem-solving capabilities
Ability to create product-focused materials/outputs, which would include PowerPoint decks, Excel models, etc
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Professional attitude, intellectual curiosity, good team player, and customer service orientation
This role is based in our European office (Lisbon) with flexibility for hybrid work. You’ll collaborate with global teams and may travel up to 10% of the time for clients or internal engagements
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

Title: Distributed Cloud | Data Analyst
Description:
At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. We are a global leading player in Digital Transformation for leading organisations across EMEA, with a revenue of €1B. We believe in transforming technology to create value for our clients, partners and employees in a world where technology is developed for people. We are proud of the culture we have built together. We are proud of our people at the service of technology. We are proud of our diverse environment. Because we are #TechforPeople. Join our multidisciplinary team of Cloud experts, Designers, Business consultants, Security experts, Engineers, Developers and other extraordinary talents, spread across more than 20 EMEA countries. Become one of our +10.000 tech and business leaders on cloud, data and cyber security. Let’s fuse creativity with technology together and build innovative solutions that actively change things for the better.

Job Description

We are looking for a sharp and insightful Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence (BI) team. You will be the crucial link between raw data and strategic decisions, responsible for gathering business requirements, transforming complex data, and creating compelling visualizations that drive action across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and translate business needs into technical requirements for data models and reporting solutions.
Develop, optimize, and execute SQL queries to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Design and build dynamic dashboards and reports, primarily using Power BI, to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable business insights.
Perform root-cause analysis on data discrepancies and collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure data quality and availability.
Present findings and strategic recommendations to stakeholders, clearly communicating complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Participate in the full lifecycle of BI projects, from requirements gathering to final deployment.



Qualifications


3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar role focused on data and reporting.
Strong mandatory proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets.
Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, data manipulation, automation, and scripting (e.g., using Pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries).
Expert hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI (or similar BI tools) for data modeling, visualization, and publishing reports.
Proven ability to gather, document, and manage business requirements effectively.
Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with data.
Experience with Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling is expected.



Valued Skills:


Experience with other components of the Microsoft Data Stack (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Analysis Services).
Knowledge of Data Modeling principles (e.g., Dimensional Modeling).
Professional fluency (B2+) in French is highly valued and may be a mandatory requirement for allocation on specific projects with Francophone clients.



Additional Information

The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. We are convinced that diversity contributes to the creativity, dynamism and excellence of our organization. All of our vacancies are open to people with disabilities.

Title: Junior Healthcare Data Analyst
HTML:
Learn About Knok

At knok, we dare to lead and humanise the digital transformation of healthcare. We envision a world where everyone has timely access to quality healthcare through digital technology, creating a more equal society. We genuinely believe in it, and you can recognise it in every person who embraces this mission.

Through a Digital Front Door strategy, knok connects patients, providers and healthcare professionals in one place. Our API-first white-label platform enables a continuous, engaging and personalised healthcare experience for all conditions through a cutting-edge Patient Journey Engine.

With regular clinical practice as our main source of knowledge, we leverage ready-to-use data to improve care automation and increase financial savings. Since 2015, we have enabled more than 2.5 million clinical interactions in over 12 countries. Our platform is scalable and AI-ready, enhancing the power of data-driven care to deliver better outcomes during all stages of life.

Are you ready to join us in revolutionising healthcare and making a tangible impact on people's lives?

About The Role

We are looking for a Junior Healthcare Data Analyst to support our teams in turning complex healthcare data into meaningful insights. You'll be working with datasets from different sources, such as clinical operations, insurance processing, and patient journeys - helping us improve care delivery and decision-making.

If you're passionate about using data to make healthcare more accessible and effective, don't stop here - dive deeper!

As an Junior Healthcare Data Analyst, you will:

  • Collect, clean, and analyse healthcare data from multiple sources (e.g. EHR, patient demographics, operational systems), to extract meaningful insights;
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations to communicate key metrics and findings to stakeholders, including clinicians, operational teams and leadership team;
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the organisation, including data science, product management, and clinical operations, to support data-driven decision-making;
  • Perform statistical analysis to support population health management, risk stratification, and clinical outcome optimisation;
  • Contribute to improving data quality by identifying data quality issues and anomalies, and work with relevant stakeholders to address and resolve them

What Makes You a Great Fit For This Journey

  • Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Statistics, Biomedical Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred;
  • Experience (academic or professional) with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar;
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining and segmentation techniques;
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear insights that support better decision-making;
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling;
  • Ability to explain a dashboard or an analysis to someone without a technical background, in a simple and practical way;
  • Care when working with data to ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability;
  • Ability to manage several analytical tasks at the same time, prioritising what has the greatest impact on the business and patients

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SQL;
  • Experience with Apache Superset;
  • Previous experience or exposure to the healthcare sector

Recruitment stages

  • People Interview: A conversation to get to know you better, explore your background and motivation, and introduce you to knok, our culture, and the role.
  • Case Study: A practical exercise designed to understand how you approach data, structure your analysis, and turn information into meaningful insights.
  • Final Interview: A conversation with the Hiring Manager where you'll present your case study, explain your reasoning, and discuss your approach in more detail

Title: Analista de Dados (m/f) - SHEQ
Description:
Descrição da Oportunidade

Estamos a reforçar a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, responsável por apoiar a definição de diretrizes, standards, indicadores e práticas de gestão em Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade em todo o Grupo. Uma das nossas prioridades é evoluir para uma gestão SHEQ cada vez mais orientada por dados, capaz de antecipar riscos, identificar tendências e apoiar decisões mais informadas.

Procuramos um/a Analista de Dados para apoiar a definição, recolha, tratamento, automatização e análise de dados SHEQ, transformando informação operacional proveniente de diferentes fontes em dashboards, indicadores e insights acionáveis para diferentes níveis da organização.

Em articulação com a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, IT e equipas SHEQ e operacionais das várias unidades de negócio, contribuirá para transformar dados e tendências em informação útil para antecipar riscos, melhorar decisões e reforçar o desempenho SHEQ do Grupo

Requisitos da Função


Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou área equivalente.
Experiência mínima de 3 anos em análise de dados, Business Intelligence, reporting corporativo, gestão e consolidação de informação ou funções similares.
Domínio de Power BI, DAX e Power Query, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios corporativos.
Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL e bases de dados relacionais. Conhecimentos de Python ou de outras linguagens de análise e tratamento de dados serão valorizados.
Experiência na recolha, tratamento, validação, harmonização e consolidação de dados provenientes de múltiplos projetos, empresas ou unidades de negócio.
Conhecimentos de modelação de dados, definição de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e estruturação de modelos de informação para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Experiência na integração e automatização de fluxos de dados, incluindo processos ETL, APIs, Power Platform ou ferramentas equivalentes.
Conhecimentos de estatística aplicada e análise exploratória de dados, incluindo a identificação de tendências, correlações, desvios e fatores de risco. Experiência em analítica avançada ou modelos preditivos será valorizada.
Conhecimentos de governação, qualidade e gestão de dados, assegurando a sua integridade, consistência, rastreabilidade e comparabilidade entre diferentes fontes de informação.
Fluência em português (obrigatório) e inglês (mínimo B2). Conhecimentos de espanhol ou francês serão valorizados.
Conhecimento dos processos e indicadores de Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade (SHEQ), incluindo gestão de incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, observações, riscos, não conformidades e desempenho ambiental, será valorizado.
Conhecimento dos referenciais ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 será valorizado.
Disponibilidade para deslocações pontuais a projetos e mercados internacionais.


Principais tarefas


Definição, em articulação com as áreas SHEQ e operacionais, dos indicadores, dados e critérios de reporte necessários à monitorização do desempenho SHEQ.
Estruturação, harmonização e validação de dados provenientes de diferentes empresas, geografias e sistemas, assegurando a sua qualidade, consistência e comparabilidade.
Automatização dos processos de recolha, consolidação e tratamento de dados, promovendo a fiabilidade da informação.
Colaboração no desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua de plataformas, ferramentas de reporte e soluções digitais de suporte aos processos SHEQ.
Integração e análise de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, identificando tendências, desvios, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos corporativos, assegurando a qualidade e atualização da informação.
Produção de análises e insights sobre indicadores SHEQ, incluindo incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, não conformidades, ações corretivas e desempenho ambiental.
Implementação de mecanismos de monitorização da qualidade dos dados e promoção de boas práticas de governação da informação.
Apoio à identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria através da análise de tendências e do cruzamento de dados entre processos e unidades de negócio.
Exploração de soluções de análise avançada, inteligência artificial e modelos preditivos aplicados à melhoria do desempenho SHEQ.
Apoio à realização de auditorias internas e externas.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
In 1966, in Marseille, Pierre Bellon laid the foundations of what would become Sodexo, guided by a simple yet powerful idea: improving everyday life through services that truly matter.

Today, Sodexo is a global leader in Food and Services, supporting people at every moment of life, at work, in schools, hospitals and communities. With 426,000 colleagues across 43 countries, we serve 80 million consumers every day, generating €24.1 billion in revenues. Our growth goes hand in hand with social and environmental responsibility, driven by our purpose: to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all.




About Sodexo Business Services (SBS)




Portugal is no exception! Eight years ago, we established Sodexo Business Services (SBS), our shared service center. Here, you will have the opportunity to join various Financial teams such as Record to Report, Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Financial Analysis, and Master Data, supporting European markets and ensuring business growth.




Join Us!

We are looking for talented professionals to be part of our team, bringing unique skills and perspectives to help us grow even further.




Data Analyst

The Data Analyst is responsible for the technical execution of reporting and insight that enhances transparency & business performance with particular emphasis on digitization (Power BI), process efficiency & solution




⚙What will you do?

Enhancing our digital reporting suite & ensuring smooth execution of business-critical activities.
Demonstrate strong technical capability across reporting tools,
Accountable for scoping, designing, and delivering reporting developments.
Explore new ways to leverage reporting technologies, with a focus on building advanced proficiency in tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Ensure that reporting output and architecture is coherent and consistent with our governance framework and standards.
Evaluate reporting processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce non‑value‑adding analysis.
Engage proactively with stakeholders to deliver reporting and insights, building effective business partnerships and communicating data in a clear, relatable narrative.
Translate broad or unclear stakeholder requirements into structured reporting plans and deliverables.
Be able to shift between data modelling, content creation, commercial insight & business partnering.




🤙What You Need to Succeed:

Bachelor’s degree in relevant field
Fluency in English required, ability to speak other European language is a plus
Focus on produt excellence, integrity and costumer focus
Experiency in Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Continuous improvement mindset
Communication skills
Problem solving
Be flexible and versatile




What we have to offer you?

Hybrid working model;
Flexible working hours;
Health & Life Insurance;
Meal allowance paid in Meal Card;
Additional Days off: extra vacation day, employee’s birthday, volunteering day;
Opportunity to grow professionally inside the Company;
Possibility to participate in multicultural projects;
Several internal activities aiming to promote our team´s wellbeing.




📩 Apply now! Send your CV to Recruitment.SBS.Portugal@sodexo.com with the job title in the subject line. Explore all our career opportunities here: Sodexo Careers.

Learn more about Sodexo: YouTube - Sodexo.




Diversity & Inclusion Statement

Sodexo is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit.




🔒 Data Privacy:

We respect your privacy. Your personal data will be used exclusively for recruitment purposes, processed under GDPR regulations, and treated confidentially. For further details, contact privacy.sbs@sodexo.com.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Sobre a Empresa




A Solverde.pt é uma marca portuguesa de jogo online. Desde o seu lançamento em Setembro de 2017, temos vindo a trabalhar todos os dias para oferecer o melhor produto de jogo online do país.




Sobre a Função




Procuramos um(a) Data & Business Analyst altamente qualificado(a) para integrar a nossa equipa.

A função irá apoiar a performance, reporting e otimização dos nossos produtos, com especial foco em apostas desportivas. Irá trabalhar de perto com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades, analisar resultados e apoiar iniciativas que melhorem a experiência do utilizador e os resultados do negócio.




Responsabilidades




Recolher, analisar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados para identificar tendências, riscos e insights que apoiem a tomada de decisão.
Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios para acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas de negócio.
Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar e definir necessidades de negócio e necessidades de dados.
Elaborar e implementar ferramentas e metodologias de análise de dados para melhorar a qualidade e a precisão da informação.
Comunicar conclusões e insights resultantes da análise de dados a stakeholders relevantes.
Monitorizar e avaliar continuamente a exatidão, integralidade e consistência dos dados.







Qualificações




Experiência prévia numa função analítica (experiência comprovada em análise de dados, análise de negócio ou área relacionada).
Forte formação académica e/ou experiência numa área quantitativa.
Fluência em inglês (oral e escrito).







Competências Requeridas







Forte capacidade analítica e de pensamento crítico, com capacidade para recolher, organizar, analisar e disseminar grandes volumes de informação.
Excelentes competências de resolução de problemas, com foco na tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI).
Experiência com SQL e Python.
Excelentes competências de comunicação, tanto oral como escrita, com capacidade para apresentar informação complexa de forma clara e acessível.
Forte atenção ao detalhe, com foco na exatidão e integralidade dos dados.
Conhecimento de produtos de sportsbook, comportamento dos jogadores e mecânicas de apostas desportivas é uma mais-valia.







Se é um(a) profissional orientado(a) por dados, com paixão por apostas desportivas e otimização de produto, esta poderá ser a oportunidade certa para ti.




Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades




A Solverde.pt está comprometida com a diversidade e inclusão em seu local de trabalho.

Title: Finance/Data Anlayst
Description:
Who are we ?




Quanteam, founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, is a consulting firm specialized in Banking and Financial Services. With more than 1200 consultants across 10 countries, we combine business and IT expertise to support leading institutions in transformation projects.

Our core areas:

➡Quantitative Finance

➡Risk & Compliance

➡Operations & Finance

➡Transformation & Organization

➡ Information Systems.




🔎 We are looking for a Finance/Data Anlayst




We are looking for a Financial Data Analyst / BI Analyst to join our team in Porto, combining strong analytical skills with a solid understanding of Finance. The role has an approximately 50/50 split between Data & BI and Finance, with a strong focus on Power BI, data modelling, reporting, reconciliation and internal stakeholder support:




Main Tasks

Aggregate and consolidate data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality, consistency and reliability.
Build data models and Power BI dashboards from scratch, translating business and financial needs into clear and actionable reporting solutions.
Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, using Power Query and DAX to transform data and create relevant KPIs and metrics.
Support financial closing and reconciliation activities, analysing discrepancies and ensuring the accuracy of financial information.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and providing data-driven insights and reporting solutions.




Requirements

3–4 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics, Controlling or a related field.
Strong experience with Power BI, including DAX and Power Query, with the ability to develop dashboards and data models independently.
Advanced Excel skills and a strong analytical mindset; some exposure to Python is valued.
Academic background in Finance, Economics, Business, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field combining Finance and Technology.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and business-oriented approach.
Hybrid model in Porto Office




🎁 WHAT WE OFFER

This role offers a gross annual salary between 22.500€ to 37.000€, defined according to the candidate’s experience and competencies.
Permanent contract (CTI).
Meal allowance.
Health Insurance.
Extra holiday: Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve.
Access to Quanteam Academy for continuous learning and certifications.
Elevate Program to support professional development and career growth.
Career progression plan.
Ongoing follow-up and technical support provided by a Consultant Expert.

Title: ETL Data Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis is looking for a versatile professional who is comfortable both "talking to the business" and "getting their hands dirty in the data pipeline." You will be responsible for understanding business data structures, writing clear technical specifications for Data Engineers, designing reporting solutions in Power BI, and actively participating in the development of our ETL flows.

As a Data Analyst / Data Engineer in our team, you will bridge the gap between business needs, data analysis, and technical data engineering. If you have a strong analytical mindset, a love for data modeling, and hands-on experience with ETL tools, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities


Business Requirements & Specifications: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear data models and technical specifications for the Data Engineering team.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Design, structure, and maintain robust data models (star schemas, snowflake schemas) optimized for analysis and reporting.
Data Governance: Ensure data quality, consistency, and clear documentation of data definitions (data lineage and data dictionary).
ETL Development: Design, build, test, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into our data warehouse.
Tooling (Stambia + Others): Develop ETL processes primarily using Stambia (training/adaptation can be provided if you have strong experience in other market-standard ETL tools like Talend, Informatica, SSIS, dbt, etc.).
Data Quality Automation: Implement automated checks to ensure the reliability and integrity of the loaded data.


Qualifications

Hard Skills:


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Finance, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in a similar role (Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer) with a strong dual focus on analysis and ETL development.
Advanced SQL skills are mandatory (complex queries, joins, optimizations, stored procedures).
Strong understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts (Kimball methodology).
Direct experience with Stambia is a major asset. Otherwise, solid experience with other ETL tools (Talend, Informatica, SSIS, Data Factory, dbt) and a strong willingness to adapt to Stambia.
Prior experience working in the banking, finance, or insurance sector (understanding of financial instruments, regulatory compliance, risk management, or retail banking data) is highly appreciated.
Design, develop, and maintain high-performing, user-friendly Power BI dashboards and reports (including DAX formulas and Power Query/M).
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Knowledge of Python or Unix/Linux scripting.
Fluency in French and English is essential.


Soft Skills


Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between business users (non-technical) and pure developers (highly technical).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Ability to take ownership of projects from requirements gathering to final delivery.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are commited to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Degree in Data Science, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Actuarial Science, Data Engineering, or related fields;

Strong technical skills, including experience with Power BI, Python and SQL (ideal)
Fluent in English. Fluency in French would be an additional advantage

Title: Sr Specialist GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management & Solutions reporting team is looking for a Senior Specialist Reporting Analytics to support the development and delivery of operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and contribute to self-service analytics through Power BI. The role combines hands-on reporting development, data analysis, problem solving, and stakeholder support. Working within established reporting processes and data products, the role collaborates with business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable and effective reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards using existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Support business stakeholders in gathering and clarifying reporting requirements and contribute to the translation of defined business needs into practical reporting and analytics solutions, with guidance from more senior team members for complex or ambiguous requirements.
Analyze and troubleshoot reporting and data issues, perform initial root cause analysis, and resolve issues within own area of support, seeking guidance or escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
Support the intake and coordination of reporting requests by gathering relevant information, clarifying requirements, and tracking progress in collaboration with more senior team members.
Provide support to Power Users and business users on Power BI reports, data interpretation, and established reporting practices, helping to promote self-service analytics.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI development standards across Supply Planning operational teams.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT), including test execution, issue documentation, and coordination of feedback.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Practical experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards.
Data & Technical Skills: Basic SQL skills with the ability to query, analyze, and validate data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate data and reporting issues and identify potential causes.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business requirements and processes and translate them into clear reporting requirements and practical solutions, with support where requirements are complex or ambiguous.
Problem Solving: Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues systematically, resolve straightforward problems independently, and know when to seek support or escalate.
Stakeholder Engagement: Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams. Able to explain reporting and data topics clearly to non-technical users.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams and contributing to the delivery of reporting enhancements. Ability to support UAT, document issues, and follow established delivery processes.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities, work independently on defined activities, and deliver high-quality outcomes while following established processes, standards, and development practices.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Basic to intermediate experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks).
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.

Data Specialist – Voice of Customer Program

You will integrate a cross-responsibility team and collaborate closely with the multiple business teams to identify key performance indicators on customer satisfaction to uncover opportunities for improvement.

Collect, consolidate, and validate customer feedback from multiple sources
Perform in-depth analysis of data to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Track program performance and support regular reviews
Collaborate with cross functional teams to prioritize and address top customer priorities

Familiar with survey tools such as Qualtrics (pref) or Survey Monkey and CRM tools such as Salesforce or MS Dynamics.

Prompt engineering for extracting insights from customer feedback

Title: Business Analyst
HTML:
Agradecemos o teu interesse nesta oportunidade! A tua candidatura só será considerada completa após a realização de um assessment digital. No final da candidatura, e caso cumpras os critérios necessários para a função, receberás no email de registo um link para aceder ao mesmo. Esta etapa é obrigatória, já que o nosso processo de recrutamento se baseia na avaliação de competências.


Somos uma empresa de todos e para todos. Na MC, colocamos as pessoas no centro: clientes, colaboradores e comunidade. Criamos valor juntos, inovamos a cada passo e lideramos de forma próxima, reconhecendo as qualidades de cada um. Diferentes histórias e ideias unem-nos no mesmo propósito: crescer e chegar à melhor versão de nós próprios. Porque tudo o que somos, conseguimos juntos.

Por isso, junta-te a nós!


Estamos à procura de Business Analyst para integrar a nossa equipa de CoE Value, em Matosinhos e acreditamos que seremos #betterwithyou!


No âmbito do nosso Center of Excellence in Value, a nossa missão é apoiar e desafiar o negócio no reforço da nossa proposta de valor e influenciar positivamente a forma como os clientes percecionam o valor. Combinamos dados, insights de mercado e de negócio para identificar oportunidades e apoiar uma melhor tomada de decisão, particularmente em torno de pricing, promoções e outros elementos-chave da nossa proposta de valor.


Procuramos um Business Analyst com uma forte capacidade analítica para integrar a nossa equipa. Esta função encontra-se na interseção entre análise de dados, estratégia de negócio e consultoria interna, transformando questões de negócio complexas em insights claros e recomendações acionáveis.


Terás a oportunidade de trabalhar com diferentes áreas da organização, estando exposto(a) a uma ampla variedade de temas de negócio e a diferentes stakeholders séniores. Esta experiência permitirá desenvolver uma visão abrangente do negócio e contribuir para discussões estratégicas relevantes.


Contamos contigo para…

  • Utilizar ferramentas analíticas como SQL e Python para explorar, manipular e analisar dados;
  • Analisar conjuntos de dados grandes e diversificados para responder a questões de negócio relevantes e gerar insights acionáveis;
  • Estruturar problemas de negócio ambíguos, definir hipóteses e determinar as análises necessárias para chegar a conclusões robustas;
  • Combinar diferentes fontes de informação para identificar padrões, tendências, riscos e oportunidades;
  • Transformar resultados analíticos complexos em conclusões e recomendações de negócio claras;
  • Questionar pressupostos e formas de pensar existentes através de análises baseadas em factos;
  • Colaborar com diferentes equipas em toda a organização em temas de negócio e estratégicos relevantes.


Por isso, traz contigo…

  • 1–4 anos de experiência profissional, idealmente em análise de dados, consultoria ou outro contexto orientado por dados;
  • Formação académica numa área quantitativa ou analítica, como Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Data Analytics, Gestão ou similar;
  • Fortes competências analíticas e experiência em análise prática de dados;
  • À-vontade na utilização de SQL e/ou Python para explorar, manipular e analisar dados;
  • Forte pensamento crítico e curiosidade, com capacidade para estruturar problemas complexos, questionar pressupostos e identificar insights relevantes;
  • Uma mentalidade orientada para o negócio, com capacidade para transformar resultados analíticos em conclusões e recomendações claras;
  • Boas competências de comunicação e capacidade para trabalhar eficazmente com diferentes stakeholders em toda a organização;
  • Experiência em retalho, pricing, promoções ou análise comercial será valorizada, mas não é obrigatória;
  • Experiência com PowerPoint e ferramentas de visualização de dados também não é obrigatória, mas será considerada uma mais-valia.


O que temos para ti…

  • Descobre aqui todos os nossos benefícios nas áreas de Saúde e Bem-Estar, Compensação e Benefícios, Família e Parentalidade, Desenvolvimento de Carreira e Flexibilidade.


#BETTERTOGETHER #BETTERWITHYOU


Compromisso de D&I MC Sonae:

Trabalhamos para criar um ambiente de trabalho assente na riqueza de perfis e com foco na singularidade, garantindo que todos se sentem respeitados, valorizados pelas suas competências e têm confiança na organização.

  • High attention to detail and ability to connect the dots;

  • A salary between 21.324€ and 24.324€ gross annual, based on your experience and knowledge, with room to grow.

  • You are eligible for 15 months every year.
  • The option is to work hybrid up to 3 days, with 2 joint office days.
  • The entitlement to annual leave can be up to 26 days, according to internal policy.
  • Other benefits include health insurance (covering the employee), bus and several partnerships, such as with gyms, clinics offering wellness services, banks, and more.

The people behind our products and brands make Dorel Juvenile an even stronger company. We invite you to grow with us!

Title: Manager GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management team is looking for a Manager Reporting Analytics to deliver operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and enable self-service analytics through Power BI.

The role combines reporting solution development, problem solving, and stakeholder engagement, acting as a bridge between business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and effective reporting solutions

Key Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards by leveraging existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Partner with business stakeholders to gather and translate business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Investigate reporting and data issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and collaborate with the Supply Chain Intelligence and Data Domain teams on global capabilities issues.
Manage reporting demand by triaging requests, prioritizing work, and coordinating the delivery of reporting solutions.
Support and enable the Power User community by providing technical guidance, promoting self-service analytics, and driving reporting best practices.
Drive continuous improvements to reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI governance across Supply Planning operational teams.
Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) and adoption of new and enhanced reporting solutions.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI reporting solutions, including DAX, data modelling, and performance optimization for operational reporting.
Data & Technical Skills: Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate reporting issues and ensure data accuracy.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business processes, gather requirements, and translate them into practical, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to investigate reporting and data issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate resolutions or escalation paths.
Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and the Power User community, adapting communication to different audiences.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams to deliver reporting enhancements, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and drive successful adoption of new reporting capabilities.
Continuous Improvement: Proactive approach to improving reporting processes, development standards, data quality, and self-service analytics through innovation and best practices.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a dynamic, global environment.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks). Experience with Python is an advantage.
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.


adidas celebrates diversity, supports inclusiveness and encourages individual expression in our workplace. We do not tolerate the harassment or discrimination toward any of our applicants or employees. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee (IEFP)
Description:
Join us as a Business Intelligence /Data Analytics Engineer Trainee!

As a Business Intelligence /Data analytics Engineer Trainee you will design, build, and maintain scalable analytics solutions that transform raw data into actionable insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reliable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Accountabilities

You will primarily be responsible for:


Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, anomalies, and business insights.
Develop and evaluate machine learning models for supervised and unsupervised learning tasks.
Prepare datasets for statistical analysis and predictive modelling.
Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in data engineering, analytics, and data science.
Designing and maintaining semantic data models (star/snowflake schemas) optimized for analytics and reporting.
Building and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Ensure data quality, consistency and performance across business intelligence solutions.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Python and R.
Translating business requirements into robust BI solutions and flexible Power BI semantic models.
Optimizing SQL queries, data models and report performance for large-scale datasets, monitoring BI workloads in cloud and on-premises environments.
Collaborating with business users to understand KPIs, metrics and reporting needs, and partnering with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Product teams.
Providing guidance and best practices to analysts and report developers.
Defining and enforcing data standards, naming conventions and documentation, supporting data lineage and metadata management.
Ensuring compliance with security and privacy requirements.


Knowledge, Skills And Experience Required


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering or related fields.
Eligible for an IEFP Level VI Internship.
Good programming skills; knowledge of python, C#.
Machine learning model development and evaluation.
Data wrangling using libraries such as Pandas/Modin, Polars, NumPy.
Knowledge of multiple databases such as SQLServer, PostgreSQL, DuckDB.
API-based data ingestion.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Big Query, Redshift, SQL Server).
Hands-on with Power BI (semantic models, DAX, DirectQuery) and ETL/ELT tools (SSIS, ADF, Airflow, dbt, SSIS or similar).
Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Azure Foundry (Nice to have).
Knowledge of data modelling techniques (Kimball, dimensional modelling).
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data models and KPIs.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Organized, able to manage multiple priorities and share knowledge effectively.
Fluent in English, with good verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
Nice to have: experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), Python, DevOps/CI-CD for BI, data governance frameworks.


Apply by submitting your CV in English.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



The HR Reporting and Analytics Manager is responsible for managing HR data and analytics to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.



Responsibilities



Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.
Lead and mentor HR Reporting and Analytics team, ensuring effective task assignment, skills development and alignment with team and business goals. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and professional growth within the team.

Excellent leadership and project management skills, with a focus on driving results and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Digital savvy

Innovation

Title: Analytics Engineer Mid
Description:
As a Mid-Level Analytics Engineer, you will support the development of Körber’s marketing analytics and reporting capabilities in a modern, AI-driven environment. Working closely with the data team, you will complete defined tasks in Databricks, contribute to AI agents that let users ask natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, and support selected reporting work in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric when needed. The role combines hands-on implementation with ad hoc analysis. You will need to understand relevant business logic so that your work is accurate, useful, and aligned with the intended reporting outcome. Our technology environment includes Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AI/ML services, and a central data lake.

Your role in our team


Implement SQL queries, data models, and reporting components in Databricks based on defined requirements.
Contribute to AI agents for natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, including prompt design, retrieval, testing, and evaluation.
Perform ad hoc analyses and data checks, applying relevant business logic and documenting assumptions and results.
Support the migration of selected reporting use cases from Power BI to Databricks and occasionally maintain or enhance reports in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
Identify data quality issues, follow team standards for documentation and development, and collaborate with the data team to resolve open questions.


Your profile


Practical experience with SQL and Databricks or a similar cloud data platform.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, agent evaluation, or similar AI application patterns.
Genuine interest in AI, with the motivation to learn, experiment, and develop further in AI-assisted analytics.
Understanding of data analysis fundamentals and the ability to apply business logic to marketing, website, campaign, or CRM data.
Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including reports, datasets, or data models, to support occasional reporting tasks.
Reliable and collaborative working style, with the ability to complete assigned tasks, ask effective questions, and communicate clearly within the data team.


We offer you


Possibility of Working from Home – we care about results not locations;
Training Budget for each employee – we care about the growth of our people;
Private Health Insurance – we care about health on and off working hours;
3 Additional Vacation Days – we care about free time;
Fresh fruits – we care about your daily dose of vitamins;
Fresh coffee, tea or water – we care about boosting your day.
A home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do;
An environment where the team thinks and acts entrepreneurial;
An international and dynamic working atmosphere with cross-functional teams;
The opportunity to take more responsibility and develop your career.


Recruitment Team

For questions please contact us via Koerbercampusporto.recruitment@koerber.com Please apply exclusively via the “Apply now” button.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status.

This position is covered by the Collective Labour Agreement (Contrato Coletivo de Trabalho da FETESE).

Title: Senior Analytics Engineer
Description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Join our BI team and help us shape the business decisions and processes of TeamViewer based on the data of our customers experience, engagement and products usage. You will work with our BI platform team with the BI data science unit . You will build and maintain scalable, high-quality analytical data products that power decision-making across the company. You will enable teams through reliable data models, standardized metrics, and strong data quality, working on large-scale datasets for a global product used by billions of users worldwide.

Responsibilities


Maintain and improve data applications that optimize various business processes
Act as a key interface between platform analytics and data consumers, understanding their needs and translating them into reusable data assets
Ensure data quality, reliability, and freshness through testing, monitoring, and validation
Design and maintain standardized business metrics and KPIs to analyze trends, identify issues, and measure performance across key company activities
Optimize data warehouse pipelines and processes to efficiently handle large-scale datasets for a product used by 2+ billion users worldwide
Diagnose and resolve data issues and outages, participate in on-call rotations, contribute to post-mortems, and proactively suggest improvements to engineering excellence


Requirements


University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience with a strong data focus
3 - 5 years of relevant professional experience in Data, Analytics, or Engineering roles
Strong SQL expertise, including writing complex and performant queries
Basic knowledge of Python for data processing or automation
Hands-on experience delivering data handling and analysis projects
Familiarity with modern software engineering practices applied to data, including testing, modularity, and code reviews
Strong problem-solving skills and high motivation to tackle complex challenges collaboratively
Ability to communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders
Fluency in English with strong communication skills


Nice to Have


Hands-on experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks
Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift)
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau
Experience working with version control systems like Git


What We Offer


Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus or sales bonus, company stocks and regular salary reviews
Premiums for the private pension plan (BAV) up to the maximum amount are topped up by TeamViewer
Public transport friendly offices
Option to lease an e-bike (Germany only)
Special terms for local gyms
Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
Hybrid and Flexible work time with up to 50% home office
Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country


TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

Title: Sr Specialist GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management & Solutions reporting team is looking for a Senior Specialist Reporting Analytics to support the development and delivery of operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and contribute to self-service analytics through Power BI. The role combines hands-on reporting development, data analysis, problem solving, and stakeholder support. Working within established reporting processes and data products, the role collaborates with business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable and effective reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards using existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Support business stakeholders in gathering and clarifying reporting requirements and contribute to the translation of defined business needs into practical reporting and analytics solutions, with guidance from more senior team members for complex or ambiguous requirements.
Analyze and troubleshoot reporting and data issues, perform initial root cause analysis, and resolve issues within own area of support, seeking guidance or escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
Support the intake and coordination of reporting requests by gathering relevant information, clarifying requirements, and tracking progress in collaboration with more senior team members.
Provide support to Power Users and business users on Power BI reports, data interpretation, and established reporting practices, helping to promote self-service analytics.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI development standards across Supply Planning operational teams.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT), including test execution, issue documentation, and coordination of feedback.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Practical experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards.
Data & Technical Skills: Basic SQL skills with the ability to query, analyze, and validate data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate data and reporting issues and identify potential causes.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business requirements and processes and translate them into clear reporting requirements and practical solutions, with support where requirements are complex or ambiguous.
Problem Solving: Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues systematically, resolve straightforward problems independently, and know when to seek support or escalate.
Stakeholder Engagement: Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams. Able to explain reporting and data topics clearly to non-technical users.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams and contributing to the delivery of reporting enhancements. Ability to support UAT, document issues, and follow established delivery processes.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities, work independently on defined activities, and deliver high-quality outcomes while following established processes, standards, and development practices.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Basic to intermediate experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks).
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.

Title: Customer Data Specialist - F/M/NB
Description:
Cegid is a European leader in cloud management solutions for professionals in the fields of finance (treasury, taxation, ERP), human resources (payroll, talent management), accounting expertise, retail, and entrepreneurship.

In a constantly evolving world, our 5,000 employees help expand the realm of possibilities by supporting our 750,000 clients in realizing their projects and ambitions through useful and innovative solutions.

"Together, expanding possibilities" is the principle that guides our actions. It reflects our identity, our approach, and our motivation to serve our clients. Thanks to this, we can assert that we work every day to shape your future, ours, and that of our clients.

For years, we have been inventing solutions that revolutionize the way our clients work, with a focus on sustainable performance.

Data Specialist – Voice of Customer Program

As a Data Specialist, you will play a crucial role in supporting our Customer Experience team by analyzing and interpreting data to drive strategic decision-making. Your primary responsibility will be to lead and maintain a comprehensive Voice of Customer program, providing actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis. You will integrate a cross-responsibility team and collaborate closely with the multiple business teams to identify key performance indicators on customer satisfaction to uncover opportunities for improvement.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, consolidate, and validate customer feedback from multiple sources
Perform in-depth analysis of data to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Analyze customer feedback to identify trends, patterns, and pain points
Generate actionable recommendations from data findings
Create reports and visualizations to communicate key insights to stakeholders
Assist in designing customer feedback surveys and collection channels
Prepare and maintain customer contact databases; ensure data quality and completeness
Track program performance and support regular reviews
Collaborate with cross functional teams to prioritize and address top customer priorities
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyze significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Proficiency in creating interactive dashboards and reports using Excel and PowerBI.
Familiar with survey tools such as Qualtrics (pref) or Survey Monkey and CRM tools such as Salesforce or MS Dynamics.
Knowledge on Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation and automation is highly desirable.
Prompt engineering for extracting insights from customer feedback
Familiar with Customer Experience fundamentals and Voice of Customer methodologies and metrics (e.g., NPS, CSAT, Churn)
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex data findings in a clear and concise manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in English and Spanish


> Attractive and transparent remuneration from recruitment > Hybrid work model and flexible working hours > 22 days of vacation per year > Health insurance > Access to online learning platforms and internal academy > Integration into a dynamic, enthusiastic, and constantly growing team

Title: Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis in Portugal is currently seeking a Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI to join its BPCE SI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques) team, within the IT (Information Technologies) department, to work in a hybrid work model in the Porto office, to join a data team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and our Data teams (Data Engineers, Data Analysts). To succeed in this mission, you will not just gather requirements: you will actively dive into the data by writing queries and analyzing our Oracle database tables to understand their structure, quality, and underlying logic.

Key Responsibilities


Write SQL queries to directly query and analyze tables within our database.
Explore and profile raw data to understand its structure, underlying business rules, and to identify potential anomalies.
Work closely with Data teams (Data Engineers, BI, and Analytics) to translate functional business rules into technical requirements.
Draft clear functional and technical specifications (source-to-target data mapping).
Assist business stakeholders in defining their requirements by providing a realistic view of the data actually available in the Oracle systems.
Design and execute test plans (both functional and technical data reconciliation).


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL (Essential): Strong ability to write complex queries (JOINs, subqueries, analytical functions, etc.) to query databases.
5+ years of solid experience as business analyst.
Oracle Environment: Proven experience working with Oracle databases (using tools such as PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver, or SQL Developer).
Data Analysis: Ability to analyze data models (tables, views, primary/foreign keys).
Data Modeling: Basic understanding of data architecture concepts (Data Warehouse, Data Marts).
French: Minimum C1 level (fluent/advanced) is required, as you will interact closely with French-speaking business stakeholders and write functional specifications in French. A good level of English is also required.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
